chapters.title: Chapter 1401: Black Mission (2)
paragraphs: None of the ladies expected to find their targets that easily. They expected to look much deeper and waste valuable time to find them.
But they did, and their next move would be to take steps toward achieving them.
Lani and Adina would head to the mansion to kill the dark heir while Unity went to the training ground to rescue the Heavens Daughter.
It was that simple.
However, they knew the hard part of the mission had just begun.
"Big sister was right, I can sense the Heaven’s Daughter. This means she is indeed the reincarnation of her twin sister," Unity said.

"Good. You go do your thing. Just make sure you aren’t noticed, or even if they do notice you, it should be in the last second before you are gone. Use Alina’s talisman well," Lani cautioned, and Unity nodded to her words.
"The same applies to you, too."
After the two True Immortals admired the mansion for a few seconds, they left. The mansion isn’t that far from the training ground, so it took them 3 minutes to get to the training ground.
Just when they were about to enter, Lani jumped from the shadows and entered a shadow cast by a pillar.
"You are on your own now, Unity. Good luck."

"We all need it," Unity responded with a chuckle. She was now alone in the true immortal shadows and was led to the vast training ground. As they moved deeper into the training ground, her connection with Heaven’s Daughter started to deepen.
However, Unity wasn’t thrilled she had managed to locate the target she came to rescue. If anything, she started cursing her luck the deeper they headed into the training ground.

So far, she had seen over 40 Immortals, with half of them already at the True Immortal stage. And as they headed deeper, more Immortals could be seen. She didn’t know how she could rescue somebody under their nose.
So her mind started to spin, and as she moved deeper, the connection with Heaven’s Daughter also continued to strengthen.
A few minutes later, the two True Immortals whose shadow they rode into the city came to a stop in front of a small clearing. That was when Unity spotted her target, or targets.

Before her were 24 cages, each loaded with 10 individuals. The connection she felt was narrowed to the 2nd cage. She could even see the target clearly. However, she couldn’t materialize at that instant since she would be noticed.
So she relaxed and started to watch the activities happening around her.
The two True Immortals looked like they were enjoying the sight of pitiful souls crying and shaking from what would befall them soon.
Meanwhile, on the outside, Lani, with Adina still hidden in her shadow, started heading back to the mansion. Since the road was clear, they basically spent less than 2 minutes.

"Let’s scout first and see what we are dealing with," Lani suggested, and Adina had no objections. They soon moved closer to the building, and while still in their shadow form, Lani circled around the mansion first.

"There are no guards stationed around the perimeter aside from the three True Immortals at the gate. I also only sense four people inside the mansion, one a True Immortal and the others Root Immortals. Looks like this Dark heir is not that protected."
"Or heavily protected," Adina said. "Why don’t we circle back again, but this time, let’s focus on the two mansions east and north of this one?"
Lani didn’t object and went ahead with Adina’s plan. After 30 minutes, they returned to the mansion where their target lived.
"I suppose you are right. The mansion to the east has five Immortal Kings, same with the northern mansion. That is a bit disturbing. The slightest mistake and they would be upon us."
"All the more reason to be careful. We can enter through the back and get a better layout of the mansion before making any moves."
Lani headed to a window at the back. Making sure nobody was around, she jumped from the shadow of a tree and entered the shadow cast by the window.

The only time she risked exposing her location since the arrive in the Dark city was when she was out of the shadows. Just now, an Immortal King sensed something, so his senses swept through the mansion.
However, he found nothing. Even so, he continued to scan for a few minutes.
Luckily, a mouse came to Lani’s rescue when it suddenly jumped out the window. It failed to land on the ground since the Immortal King killed it just to be safe.
"That was close," Adina said, taking a deep breath inside Lani’s shadow.
"Indeed. But now we know just how tight that poor bastard’s security is." Lani made her way from the kitchen to the adjacent room, where she slowly moved in the direction of another room.
"Where are you going?" Adina asked. If anything, they should start looking for the room the Dark Heir lives in. However, aside from moving quickly, Lani seemed to be going in the same direction.

"There is a room, a few rooms away. Just now, when the Immortal King scanned here, he excluded that room from his scan. I took advantage of the moment to connect with the shadows, and so when he excluded that room, I knew the target lived there."
"That was impressive, but daring. How bold were you that he wouldn’t notice your senses in the shadows?"
"Stop looking down on me, Adina. I wasn’t known as the Silent Shadow in the past for nothing."
"Sorry. I assumed since you are now known as the Joker, making such a bold move wouldn’t be merely a joke to you."

Adina chuckled, a bit amused. Lani was the most daring person she had met based on what she had just done. Not many would be that daring to take advantage of an Immortal King, someone several realms above her.
However, she managed to find the location of the target they were after. Now, the only thing left was to infiltrate the room he was in and find a way to kill him without raising too much suspicion.
Slowly, they arrived at the direction of the room. It was airtight, as they expected. Of course, they were certain the target was inside the room.

However, there were no shadows leading in and out of the room. This meant that to enter the room, they had to be tangible. But the moment they became tangible, the Immortal King would notice and would make his move.
But since the Immortal King excluded the room in his scan, even if they became tangible, they wouldn’t notice.
"What next?" Adina asked.
"Let’s stay here for a few minutes. There will be an opportunity for us." Since she was connected to the shadows inside the room, she knew what was happening inside.
"We’re waiting then."
At the training ground, Unity remained in the shadow of the True Immortal. They remained there for a couple of minutes before they started to move away.
Just when they passed the shadow of a pillar, she jumped out of the shadow and entered the shadow of the pillar.
The shadow she jumped into had a clear path to the 24 cages. However, instead of moving, she relaxed and tapped into the connection with the tower.
The mission had now changed from rescuing a single person to rescuing hundreds of them. She couldn’t just turn away from the hundreds and rescue just one person.
So she connected to her sisters.
"Ladies, we have a problem."

chapters.title: Chapter 1402: Black Mission (3)
paragraphs: "What kind of problem, Unity?" Vexthra asked. To stay in sync with Lani and her team, they decided to pass the time in Gaiaville, where the time is the same as outside.
So, a couple of hours had passed, but to someone inside the harem tower, it had been over four days since Lani, Unity, and Adina left for the mission.

"Let’s just say we wouldn’t be rescuing only one person. In fact, we will be rescuing 200-plus people. However, that is going to be a problem since the location where they are kept is crawling with Immortals.
The moment I make my move, they will notice. So what do you suppose I do in this aspect?"

Finding the hundreds of Storm Humans and Red Foxes packed for slaughter isn’t something she can ignore. That is just not possible. She is the goddess of love, so there is just no way she would leave them to fend for themselves.
"And oh, I resonated with the Heaven’s Daughter, so I guess she is indeed Big Sister’s twin sister."

Vexthra and the rest of her sisters smiled. This was good for her, so they were happy for her. Naturally, that was just the best thing that could happen to her in this new life she had found with Kent and her sisters.
But there was also the issue of how Unity would handle the rescue.
"I have a question," Zaila said. Then she asked, "According to the mission description, Lani could only take two aids with her, right?"
"That was what the mission description said, yes."

"So, if hypothetically, Unity found a way to transport, say, all the prisoners and the Immortals that would sense her presence the moment she makes her move, would killing them inside the tower count as interference or not?"
The ladies raised their brows, a bit intrigued by what Zaila was hinting at. Basically, Alina gave Unity a talisman containing a transportation array that would take just anyone within its range.
It would take three seconds to activate, but when it did, anyone within its range would be sucked into the tower, specifically the Legion Tower where Alina left the marker.

This meant even if an Immortal Lord were to enter its range, they would be taken away. The only hard part was the three-second wait. The moment she activates the talisman, every last Immortal in the training ground would notice.
This means Unity will be in danger for at least two seconds. That is plenty of time for something bad to happen to her. A True Immortal needs just a second to make a move on someone weak like her.
Of course, there is also the time talisman Alina gave her. She can use it to slow down time for the Immortals. That would buy her some time. But the question here is, would that be enough?
It wasn’t a question any of them could answer.
But there was one thing she could do.
"Unity, here is what you are going to do..." Vexthra came up with a good plan, one that would give Unity a chance to rescue the prisoners and even escape with their lives intact.
Unity is no assassin, but Lani had taught her how to move through the shadows, so she slowly made her way to cage two, where her main target was.
Inside the cage, a young Red Fox sat in the corner, her eyes closed. She seemed to be more relaxed than the others. The vibe in the cage didn’t match the mood she found herself in.
This could only mean one of two things. Either she was confident she could escape and secure her freedom, or she had already given up hope. Either way, she seemed calm.
Suddenly, her eyes opened when a voice entered her head. "Don’t be afraid. Don’t shout who, and most importantly, don’t draw anyone’s attention. I am here to save all of you."

The young lady opened her eyes, but she made no sound. Given everyone’s mood, no one noticed her sudden reaction. It was a natural reaction, so not even the Immortals who might have been paying attention to the cages noticed.
"Good girl. Now, when I talk, and you want to respond, just think of what you want to say, and I will hear you."
"O-Ok."
"Good. You can call me Unity. What is your name?"
"Risana..."
"Risana, what a beautiful name. I am going to get you out of here, Risana."
"O-Ok," she replied, a bit apprehensive, which is normal considering the kind of situation she had found herself in. A stranger’s voice entering her head is the last thing she expected.
None of this moment feels real to her, but she seems much calmer, so that is a good thing.
"I am going to need your help, though..."
"How can I be of help?" Risana asked, sounding a bit optimistic. Maybe she wanted to give Unity a try. It is not like she would be losing anything from this. She already has a rope around her neck.
"I would like you to go to sleep for a few minutes, since I will need your body. To save you, I need to possess your body, but only for a few minutes."
The young lady raised her brow, taken aback by Unity’s demand.
"I-I am not sure I can fall asleep in these settings. I am not even sure I can fall asleep at all..."
"Well, we will have to find that out soon, that is, if you allow me to possess your body."

"If that is what it is going to take to rescue everyone, then sure. But I am telling you, there is no way I will fall asleep." Risana paused for a moment, then she added, "I have never fallen asleep for as long as I can remember."
"Just sit, relax, and let me handle the rest."
Risana sat there for a few seconds before turning her body to lean better against the metal bars of the cage. After stretching her legs, she exhaled and then closed her eyes...
"Now, I want you to imagine a beautiful pink cherry blossom tree seated perfectly atop a purple snow mountain, surrounded by a mist of grey ice."
Risana’s body suddenly deflated, her breath stabilizing instantly.

Inside the mansion, Lani and Adina continued to wait. They had been updated on the situation at the training ground. The new plan required them to take advantage of the commotion at the training ground the moment Unity makes her move.
But before she could do anything, they had to enter the room.

So they continued to wait. A couple of hours passed, but their chance remained shut behind doors. 6 hours later, the door to the room opened, and a Dark Elf male walked out wearing nothing but shorts.
Clearly, judging by the scent on him and the fact that he yawned and stretched his body when he walked out, it was clear he had just had sex.
In a way, it was good for him, considering he literally offered himself on a silver platter when he walked out instead of the three Red Foxes now passed out on his bed.
By stepping out of his room, his shadow came within range, so Lani did what she does best and slid inside. A minute later, he walked back into the room and shut the door.
"Unity, on your mark."

chapters.title: Chapter 1403: Black Mission (4)
paragraphs: The plan Vexthra came up with hinges on whether Unity can possess Risana’s body. If she were to suddenly appear inside the cage, it would cause fear and panic, which would then draw the attention of the Immortals.
That would take away her chance to activate the talisman.
So she had to possess her body, and since she was once Vexthra’s sister, she had the best way to put her to sleep.
They grew up in a garden city where cherry blossom trees are everywhere.
Vexthra hated them, but her sister loved them. She even came up with the perfect cherry blossom tree and the settings it should be in to qualify her aesthetic.
Every night, before they went to bed, she would imagine that tree, and after doing it for years, it became her bedtime story.
Vexthra knew deep within her that Risana was indeed her sister, so she made the call, and Unity went ahead with it.
"...Even if it isn’t raining, the mist around the cherry blossom tree should show signs of drizzling every now and then to keep the moisture alive."
Unity paused because Risana had fallen asleep.
"Hmm, all it took was four complete sentences..."
Unity transmitted to Vexthra, putting a smile on her face. A tear appeared, but she wiped it. The mission is too critical for her to become emotional right now.
Every last one of her sisters held their breath, knowing the moment of truth was about to happen.
Uncle Drew and the rest of the legion are seated and waiting for the poor souls who will be making their way into the tower with the prisoners.
Since the tower is not within the Immortal planet they are on, they would be meeting literal demigods and Void beasts this time around.
All Unity needs to do is activate the Talisman.
Lani and Adina remained in Gelen’s shadow as he made his way back to his bed. He pushed the three Red Foxes off the bed and sat down. Then he fell back and lay on the bed.
"Tomorrow, I will start my hunt again," he smiled, his expression filled with evil intent. He will be slaughtering defenseless mortals like they were nobodies.
Nobody knows what he gets from that, considering he gains virtually nothing from killing them. All he does is kill the poor souls, and that is all.
"I will enjoy myself for sure."

Suddenly, a faint air passed by his nose, causing it to twitch. His ears moved, and at once the feeling of lust overwhelmed his mind. He stood from the bed and followed the direction the air came from.
It came from one of the Red Foxes that he had pushed down. His body reacted almost on its own, causing him to move toward her.
The look on his face changed from a look of evil and was replaced with a look of lust and pleasure.
"Horny fucker," Adina’s voice entered Lani’s head.
Just when they entered the room, she jumped into the shadow of one of the Red Foxes and possessed her. Since she was already passed out, it was very simple for her to possess her body.

This allowed her to easily harness her charm abilities. But the moment she made her move, it was a go. As expected, the moment she activated her charm ability, Gelen was taken over by lust, dropping his guard rather quickly.
The rest was basically for him to move toward the passed-out fox lady.
However, as someone who is married to a jealous Chaos Dragon, Adina wouldn’t let another man touch her, even if she was possessing the body of someone else.
Even Lani wouldn’t allow that to happen, regardless of how that would work in their favour.
So just when the bastard got close to the Red Fox and reached to touch and turn her, a shadow fell on him followed by a sweet yet cold words...
"Peace out, bitch."
Lani’s dagger drew an arc in the air. The next second, a head fell to the ground.
RUMBLE
The moment the head touched the ground, the entire mansion trembled. In fact, the tremble came much faster than the head falling off.
Adina stood up and exited the fox lady’s body. She then touched the three foxes, and like smoke, they vanished from the room. At the same time, an Immortal Emperor appeared.
"NO..." His voice filled the room.
However, his nightmare didn’t end there. Just when he appeared inside the room, alarms rang from the training ground.
[Five seconds before the kill]
Unity possessed Risana’s body without raising any alarm. So she gave the signal to Adina and Lani, causing them to make their move.
Just as Adina made her move, she also activated the two talismans Alina had given her. The transfer array enveloped and marked the prisoners.

However, the moment the array opened, every last Immortal saw it, and so they moved. However, Unity had already activated the time talisman, slowing their movements. But even that wasn’t enough to stop them.
So, over 21 True Immortals entered the array’s range. When the timer reached three seconds, they were all pulled away.

Inside the Legion Tower, the 24 cages appeared, along with 21 True Immortals. But the moment they arrived, a terrible pressure fell on them, causing every last one of them to drop to their knees, some even falling flat on their faces.
The cages were pulled away, and Avotha flew over, pulling all 21 Immortals to one side. Since they had decided to intervene in the rescue mission, he would teach them a good lesson.
Lani and Adina appeared in Gaiaville since they didn’t use the talisman to re-enter the tower. Alina only pulled Unity and the rest into the tower. That was why they ended up in the Legion Tower.
However, because they used the tower connection, they appeared in Gaiaville.
If they had been 0.001 seconds late, the Immortal Emperor would have prevented them from escaping. Even the goosebumps on Lani and Adina showed they felt the danger just as they vanished.
In fact, they were very lucky.
But they succeeded. The mission ended since they are now inside the legion tower.
Meanwhile, back in the Dark City, everything became chaotic. The Dark Heir had just been assassinated, and worse, the slaves they had captured vanished along with 21 True Immortals.
That was just not something they could take easily.
So they started moving about, everyone panicking. The fact that this mission was pulled right under their noses made them all feel threatened.
A minute later, a powerful Dark Elf with the aura of an Immortal Lord appeared in the room where Gelen was killed.
He is the Dark Elf King, one of the most evil men on Planet Offin.
"Who dares kill my son?" His voice filled the mansion, spreading to the rest of the city. Everyone panicked, their backs breaking into cold sweat.
"My king, I found this by the bed." The Immortal Emperor, who first arrived on the scene, handed a white, perfectly rolled scroll to the Dark Elf King.
He unfurled it with an angry expression. However, after reading its content, a look of panic appeared on his face.
"Kent Madson was here."

That was the content of the scroll, but the fear it incited in him was clear. He lit the scroll on fire and vanished from the room. He appeared in another mansion and quickly made his way to a dark and narrow basement.
After walking for a few seconds, he arrived before a dark mirror.
"We have a problem... Dark Queen..."

So she had to possess her body, and since she was once Vexthra’s sister, she had the best way to put her to sleep.

chapters.title: Chapter 1404: Long Overdue Reunion
paragraphs: [Legion Tower]
Avotha stood in the air, his cold gaze falling on the 21 True Immortals. Every last one of them had been rendered immobile, none even having the strength to move their fingers.
Compared to an Immortal Lord, the power of a demigod is several times monstrous. Especially if the demigod is Avotha.
"Uncle Drew, what should we do with them?"
"Knock them out and throw them into the Tower Prison for now. Once everything settles down, we will find a use for them."
Avotha nodded and, with a flick of his hand, every last one of the 21 True Immortals lost consciousness. The tower pulled them away into the Tower Prison.
The next second, Vexthra and her sisters arrived in the Legion Tower.
She moved toward the second cage and grabbed the lock, yanking it off like it was mere paper. Unity, still possessing Risana’s body, walked out.
Once she was outside, she pulled her consciousness out of Risana’s body, causing the young lady, who was still asleep, to fall. However, Vexthra was there to catch her.
She hugged her tightly, tears rolling down her face. While Risana was still small and young, her face was the same as Vexthra remembered.
They were fraternal twins, so Risana looked nothing like her. But even so, as someone who had spent thousands of years with her, Vexthra could never mistake her appearance.
Right now, the lady in her arms looked just like her sister, and that alone was all she needed to know her sister had indeed reincarnated.
Even if Risana would never recall her life as Vexthra’s twin sister, she would be fine with that.
She resonated with the Love Dao Unity had, and she looked just like her dead sister. That was all she needed, and now that she had found her, nothing was more important than that.
Unity walked toward her, then the three of them vanished. Soon, more of them started leaving, each entering Unity’s love space.
In a span of 10 seconds, the only ones left were Dia, Yuyin, and Miryssa. The rest ran after their big sister to make sure she was okay.
Miryssa turned to Uncle Drew, but he gave her the go-ahead to handle things on her own. She was Kent’s wife, so there was no need to even question her authority.
She turned to Dia and Yuyin. "You can follow them if you want."
They smiled but shook their heads. "Let’s make these poor souls feel at home first."
Miryssa waved her hand, and the rest of the cages opened. "Everyone, welcome to your new home. My name is Miryssa, and these are my sisters and friends."
Already, every last person trapped in the cages was scared. But now, surrounded by people they had never seen before, they became petrified.

They were used to seeing Red Foxes, Storm humans, and the evil dark elves. In a way, they are used to that. So seeing humans, demons, dragons, and all kinds of people now surrounding them, they all became even more scared.
However, just as Kent’s name was used to take the blame from the Red Foxes and Storm humans, the same could be done with these people.
"Before you scare yourselves to death, know the one who saved you is none other than Kent Madson. I know most of you have heard about him."
As expected, many reacted when Kent’s name was mentioned. His fame has spread so far that even children have heard of him.
So hearing a familiar name calms them down a bit.
"Were we really saved by Lord Kent Madson?" a Red Fox asked, and Miryssa nodded.

"He sure did, and that is why I would want you all to know that, for now, your home on planet Offin is not safe for you to return to. But not for long. Very soon, if you want to return, we will gladly send you back.

However, you will be staying here for a couple of months, maybe a few years. If you need anything, feel free to ask, and well, if the time to leave comes and you wish to stay, we would not force you."
Many were a bit hesitant, but compared to where they were before they were rescued, at least they weren’t locked in cages now, so they would make do with that.
Of course, it would take some time to adjust, but Miryssa was sure that once they met the others in the tower cities, they would feel safer.

"In that case, why don’t we head to your new home?" Miryssa waved her hand again, and they appeared a couple of meters from Gaiaville. When their gaze landed on the magnificent city, they all became stunned.

"I will take you all through the cities we have here, and whichever one you wish to stay in, feel free to tell me." Miryssa started leading them through the cities, making sure she used the moment to make them feel safer and happier.
She is already aware that the more people living in the tower city, the stronger Kent becomes. So she is determined to make these poor souls stay.
Meanwhile, inside Unity’s Love Space, the ladies were all sitting around a bed, watching Risana sleep soundly. It was a bit weird to be staring at someone that intently while they slept.
However, none of them cared about their strange behavior. In their minds, they all wanted to be there when Risana woke up.

She would not remember Vexthra, but they would make her feel at home regardless of how she felt. She had been through a traumatic experience, and so the least they could do was ease her into this new chance at life.
"This is weird," Unity suddenly said.
"What is weird?"
"Us. What we are doing is creepy. We will be scaring her if she wakes up to the sight of us staring at her like crazy people. I know I would be scared."
They tried to come up with excuses, but after a few seconds of thought, it became clear that they indeed looked like a bunch of crazy ladies.
When it finally sank in, they decided to move away from the bed but remain inside Unity’s Love Space until she woke up.
The Love space was very large and beautiful, so there were a lot of places for them to do all kinds of things while they waited.
Days passed in the blink of an eye. On the outside, Miryssa had helped everyone settle in. All of the Red Foxes chose to stay in Skyjade City, where the Sky Foxes lived. They felt more at home there.
As for the Storm humans, some chose to stay in Gaiaville, while some went to Nature City, where the Elves lived.
They had heard the Elves were natural enemies of the Dark Elves, so they decided to stay there and perhaps learn something from them.
They were received with open arms, so they settled in quickly.
As for the 21 True Immortals, they all woke up to find they no longer had access to their cultivation bases.
The Tower Prison was a special place Gaia had built to keep those whom her big brother deemed unfit to die just yet, despite their sins.
For now, they would have to cool down and think of what was coming for them.
Uncle Drew was already making plans for them.
They are True Immortals, and as such, there are several ways to use them. Kent hated slaves, so they wouldn’t make them their slaves, but they would have a way to keep them on a leash.
After all, Yi Lai, Elaine, and Veera would have the best use for them.

chapters.title: Chapter 1405: The Reunion
paragraphs: As the days went by, the ladies started to worry about Risana. It had been two weeks since she arrived in the tower, but she had yet to wake up.
The other three Red Foxes that Adina brought with her had long since woken; even the one whose body Adina possessed briefly during their mission had woken after 5 days and had already settled in.
Just like the other prisoners, they too were slaves to the Dark Heir. Only that, instead of using them as target practice, he kept them as sex slaves.
So having the freedom to leave for themselves now was the best thing that had ever happened to them.
But Risana was still not up. This left the ladies on edge, especially Vexthra.
She had been restless the past week.
Thankfully, a week later, Risana woke up.
When her eyes opened, the most beautiful sight greeted her. The ladies, in their effort to make sure she woke up happy and safe, moved her to a garden filled with lush white plants and flowers.

So when she opened her eyes, the first thing she saw was a lush forest allowing rays of yellow sun to filter through the gaps in the leaves and branches. It was beautiful, so instead of panicking, she seemed a bit calm.
The girls had already role-played this moment many times, so they stayed back, scattered across the Love Space.

As Risana raised her small body and sat on the bed, she started to look around her. The last thing she remembered was Unity’s voice in her head telling her to use her vivid imagination to imagine a rather amazing scenery.
She passed out a few seconds into the narrative. But she can still remember that vividly.
It took a few turns to spot Unity, who wasn’t that far from her.
This caused her to move back to her bed, a wave of fear washing over her. However, as if her movement was loud, Unity turned and saw her wake up.
"Finally," Unity said with a smile before she started walking toward her. Risana panicked, but then she sensed some familiarity with the voice that spoke to her.
"U-Unity," she called out, and Unity nodded. In no time, she was standing beside her bed. "Glad to see you are finally awake. We’ve been worried sick."
"We?" Risana turned and looked around her.
"Girls, she is awake."
Vexthra appeared like a ghost, followed by Lilian, then Selene. In no time, they all appeared one by one, their expressions filled with smiles.
Risana frowned a bit, looking at the new faces that started appearing from thin air. In no time, she was surrounded on all sides.
Her eyes darted from one face to the next. One could see the fear in her eyes as she looked around. However, just when her eyes landed on Vexthra, she paused.
"It-It is you," she said softly...
Vexthra tried to keep her composure, but at the look on Risana’s face, her tears rolled down.
"Risana, do you know who she is?" Unity asked Risana.
"Yes. I don’t know how, but I know her. I don’t know her name, but she is inside my head and speaks to me sometimes."
The ladies turned and looked at Vexthra, then darted their eyes to Risana. Vexthra tried her best, but her tears continued to fall.
Risana had no idea what was happening. However, seeing Vexthra cry seemed to sour her mood. Unity, being the most in tune with emotion among her sisters, saw this and did what she knew was right.
She called away her sisters, leaving only Vexthra and Risana.
After standing there for a few minutes, Vexthra jumped on the bed and tightly hugged Risana. She was startled at first, but in no time, she started to enjoy the hug.
They remained in that position for a few minutes before Vexthra pulled back. She wiped her tears and caught her breath before she spoke.
"Sorry about that. I just miss you so much,"

"Oh, are you also having me inside your head?" Risana asked, her innocent expression melting Vexthra’s heart. She was already made aware by Uncle Drew’s words that, most of the time, the Heavens’ daughters suffer.
And since Risana was captured as a slave to be used for target practice, she knew she had suffered. She is about 20 years old, but she has never known happiness, not even once.
However, despite it all, her innocence still remained. That innocence was now melting the heart of a goddess who had missed her sister for millions of years already.
Vexthra’s sister died during the transition.
It was the point where the old era was ending and a new era was about to emerge. It was said that ascending to godhood during those times was easy, so many demigods chose then to become gods.

They had plans to become gods back then. But before that could happen, she was killed by the God of Alchemy. Thankfully, she had been reborn, and that was just not something Vexthra planned on taking for granted.
"You are more than inside my head, Risana. You are inside my heart and soul. I am so happy to see you again."
Risana nodded, her beautiful blue eyes looking into Vexthra’s.
"By the way, my name is Vexthra."
Risana nodded again.
They stared into each other’s eyes for a few seconds before Vexthra took her hand. "Let’s go meet the rest of my sisters."
They soon left the garden and headed to a waterfall, where the ladies were waiting for them.
Risana had no memories of her past life, but everyone was aware that she was indeed Vexthra’s sister. So naturally, she was their sister too.
"This place is so beautiful. There are so many beautiful flowers here."
"I know," Vexthra smiled. "You always loved flowers."
"Flowers are beautiful."
As they moved toward the waterfall, Vexthra asked about Risana’s life. From what she said, it was clear she had been through a lot of hardship.

To her, she had no parents because, for as long as she could remember, she had been on her own. She survived by helping wash plates in inns and restaurants. Sometimes she was paid with food, but most times she had to eat leftovers.

As she grew up, the businesses she worked for began to pay her some copper coins from time to time. She mostly spent them on food. But she saved some to buy a low-level cultivation manual since she learned cultivators don’t go hungry.
To her, feeling her stomach is what she lives for. But since she had no money for food, she might as well find a way to cheat hunger.
"It was the biggest mistake I ever made." Risana shook her head, a small, bitter smile playing on her lips.
"Why? What happened?"
"Let’s just say I wasn’t the only one hungry."
"So you were scammed," Vexthra laughed, causing Risana to pout.
"In my defense, I didn’t know the manual was fake. It was only later, when I snuck into a dojo and got caught, that the master there told me it was fake.
He made me sleep there for 3 years since I broke in. After that, he let me go with an authentic cultivation manual." She paused and sighed before adding, "That was 2 years ago. I am 20 now."
"Two years to reach the Root Ascension, huh?"
"Too low, I know. It was just that I had no money to buy treasures, so that was the best I could do." Mistaking Vexthra’s words, Risana defended her achievement by adding a more shocking reveal.
Vexthra just shook her head and smiled.
Using two years with no treasure to move from a mortal to Root Ascension doesn’t make her a prodigy. It makes her a monster...

Thankfully, a week later, Risana woke up.
When her eyes opened, the most beautiful sight greeted her.
The ladies, in their effort to make sure she woke up happy and safe, moved her to a garden filled with lush white plants and flowers.
So when she opened her eyes, the first thing she saw was a lush forest allowing rays of yellow sun to filter through the gaps in the leaves and branches.
It was beautiful, so instead of panicking, she seemed a bit calm.
The girls had already role-played this moment many times, so they stayed back, scattered across the Love Space.
As Risana raised her small body and sat on the bed, she started to look around her.
The last thing she remembered was Unity’s voice in her head telling her to use her vivid imagination to imagine a rather amazing scenery.
She passed out a few seconds into the narrative.
But she can still remember that vividly.
It took a few turns to spot Unity, who wasn’t that far from her.
This caused her to move back to her bed, a wave of fear washing over her.
However, as if her movement was loud, Unity turned and saw her wake up.
"Finally," Unity said with a smile before she started walking toward her.
Risana panicked, but then she sensed some familiarity with the voice that spoke to her.
"U-Unity," she called out, and Unity nodded.
In no time, she was standing beside her bed.
"Glad to see you are finally awake.
We’ve been worried sick."
"We?" Risana turned and looked around her.
"Girls, she is awake."
Vexthra appeared like a ghost, followed by Lilian, then Selene.
In no time, they all appeared one by one, their expressions filled with smiles.
Risana frowned a bit, looking at the new faces that started appearing from thin air.
In no time, she was surrounded on all sides.
Her eyes darted from one face to the next.
One could see the fear in her eyes as she looked around.
However, just when her eyes landed on Vexthra, she paused.
"It-It is you," she said softly...
Vexthra tried to keep her composure, but at the look on Risana’s face, her tears rolled down.
"Risana, do you know who she is?" Unity asked Risana.
"Yes.
I don’t know how, but I know her.
I don’t know her name, but she is inside my head and speaks to me sometimes."
The ladies turned and looked at Vexthra, then darted their eyes to Risana.
Vexthra tried her best, but her tears continued to fall.
Risana had no idea what was happening.
However, seeing Vexthra cry seemed to sour her mood.
Unity, being the most in tune with emotion among her sisters, saw this and did what she knew was right.
She called away her sisters, leaving only Vexthra and Risana.
After standing there for a few minutes, Vexthra jumped on the bed and tightly hugged Risana.
She was startled at first, but in no time, she started to enjoy the hug.
They remained in that position for a few minutes before Vexthra pulled back.
She wiped her tears and caught her breath before she spoke.
"Sorry about that.
I just miss you so much,"
"Oh, are you also having me inside your head?" Risana asked, her innocent expression melting Vexthra’s heart.
She was already made aware by Uncle Drew’s words that, most of the time, the Heavens’ daughters suffer.
And since Risana was captured as a slave to be used for target practice, she knew she had suffered.
She is about 20 years old, but she has never known happiness, not even once.
However, despite it all, her innocence still remained.
That innocence was now melting the heart of a goddess who had missed her sister for millions of years already.
Vexthra’s sister died during the transition.
It was the point where the old era was ending and a new era was about to emerge.
It was said that ascending to godhood during those times was easy, so many demigods chose then to become gods.
They had plans to become gods back then.
But before that could happen, she was killed by the God of Alchemy.
Thankfully, she had been reborn, and that was just not something Vexthra planned on taking for granted.
"You are more than inside my head, Risana.
You are inside my heart and soul.
I am so happy to see you again."
Risana nodded, her beautiful blue eyes looking into Vexthra’s.
"By the way, my name is Vexthra."
Risana nodded again.
They stared into each other’s eyes for a few seconds before Vexthra took her hand.
"Let’s go meet the rest of my sisters."
They soon left the garden and headed to a waterfall, where the ladies were waiting for them.
Risana had no memories of her past life, but everyone was aware that she was indeed Vexthra’s sister.
So naturally, she was their sister too.
"This place is so beautiful.
There are so many beautiful flowers here."
"I know," Vexthra smiled.
"You always loved flowers."
"Flowers are beautiful."
As they moved toward the waterfall, Vexthra asked about Risana’s life.
From what she said, it was clear she had been through a lot of hardship.
To her, she had no parents because, for as long as she could remember, she had been on her own.
She survived by helping wash plates in inns and restaurants.
Sometimes she was paid with food, but most times she had to eat leftovers.
As she grew up, the businesses she worked for began to pay her some copper coins from time to time.
She mostly spent them on food.
But she saved some to buy a low-level cultivation manual since she learned cultivators don’t go hungry.
To her, feeling her stomach is what she lives for.
But since she had no money for food, she might as well find a way to cheat hunger.
"It was the biggest mistake I ever made." Risana shook her head, a small, bitter smile playing on her lips.
"Why?
What happened?"
"Let’s just say I wasn’t the only one hungry."
"So you were scammed," Vexthra laughed, causing Risana to pout.
"In my defense, I didn’t know the manual was fake.
It was only later, when I snuck into a dojo and got caught, that the master there told me it was fake.
He made me sleep there for 3 years since I broke in.
After that, he let me go with an authentic cultivation manual." She paused and sighed before adding, "That was 2 years ago.
I am 20 now."
"Two years to reach the Root Ascension, huh?"
"Too low, I know.
It was just that I had no money to buy treasures, so that was the best I could do." Mistaking Vexthra’s words, Risana defended her achievement by adding a more shocking reveal.
Vexthra just shook her head and smiled.
Using two years with no treasure to move from a mortal to Root Ascension doesn’t make her a prodigy.
It makes her a monster...

chapters.title: Chapter 1406: Finally Settled In. New Friends
paragraphs: Some things are just meant to be, regardless of how much time has passed.
Risana had no idea she and Vexthra were sisters. However, in less than an hour, she had become comfortable around her.
She was smiling and laughing with her, something she had never done before, since she had never had the chance or even the moment to let herself feel joy and happiness.

After revealing everything about her life, while it is mostly filled with heartbreaking moments, it became clear that she was a cultivation genius. She went from nothing to the Spirit Ascension stage in two years using nothing but good old-fashioned low-level cultivation techniques.
She consumed no treasures, as most do.
She just absorbed spiritual qi from the air.

Basically, she had done what takes many decades, sometimes even centuries, in merely two years. That made Vexthra happy. This showed that her sister still had the talent and a chance to soon rise to the rank of a god.
If she could reach where she was now, then there was no telling what else she could do in the next two decades.
When they arrived at the waterfall, the rest of her sisters surrounded them and started asking questions. They were all happy that Vexthra’s sister was finally back.
So many questions were asked, and while Risana was overwhelmed at first, she soon adapted.
It was through the many questions that they learned Risana had no plans to become a martial cultivator. She didn’t want to fight or kill, so she had no plans on learning any martial arts techniques.
This, in a way, came as a surprise to most of the ladies. The universe is chaotic now, so choosing not to learn how to kill is a bit shocking.
However, Unity and Vexthra understood her completely. Unity could sense that a part of her hated battles. The part of her that was once the Goddess of Love hated bloodshed.
In that life, she was all about making sure people had happy endings. It was the reason why she had to sacrifice her life to make sure the Blood Spear King and his wife had a happy ending.
So she understood where Risana was coming from. She just wanted to make sure others were happy, even though she had never had a happy life.
She was destined to comprehend the Dao of Love and Passion, so she would never have the power to kill.
However, she never had to kill anyone to defeat them.
Vexthra had already told them that she and her sister planned to use their divinity to inspire. So, since she had already made up her mind, there was nothing they could do to change it.
Not that Vexthra would dare change anything.

Her time had passed. She had already formed her divinity, so her sister could have hers too. Maybe if she became the Goddess of Love and Passion one day, what she couldn’t do herself would be fulfilled through Risana.
It took the rest of her sisters a few minutes to come to terms with what Risana wanted. In the end, they saw that they had the power to kill for her, so she would always be protected.
Every last one of them had been a terrifying warrior, so she was in good hands.
"Let’s go out and show Risana around," Unity suggested, and they soon left the Love Space and arrived back in the Legion Tower.
They started the tour by introducing the legion to Risana. They had already told her Kent Madson had a hand in her rescue.
As they all expected, she had heard of him before, and upon hearing that this place belonged to him, she relaxed a bit and even asked if she could meet him.
They knew she would have to wait a bit longer since Kent was currently busy. After introducing everyone, they continued to Gaiaville and soon went on to the other cities.
The tower cities were just the most beautiful sight a person could ask for.
After spending an entire day showing her around, they retired to the Tower Garden, where Gaia and her minions were resting after building for years.

Gaia wanted Kent to reach Elina much faster, so she asked him for some more tower points, not because she wanted to cheat him, but because she wanted to build a space where time is several times faster than even inside the tower.
Inside the Harem Tower, a day is an hour outside. However, in the new space she built, a day there is instead an hour inside the Harem Tower.
Initially, she would need three years of outside time to build the portal. But with this new space, she would need less time to finish.

Gaia wanted to use the time to ensure Kent had safe travel, so, with the accelerated time, she and her friends had been working hard. To them, a couple of years had passed since they started working on the portal.
When they saw a youngster arrive in the garden with Vexthra and the rest of Kent’s wives, they quickly rushed to her side.
Risana was also small like them, so she fit in perfectly.
She was even a bit happier seeing these tiny ladies spending time on their own. Risana first asked Vexthra for permission, which she was granted, before joining the troublemakers.
Although she would at least grow up someday if she ate proper food, now that she was a loli, there was no better time than now to have some fun with girls her age.
Vexthra was happy for her, so she said nothing and let her join them.
Inside the tower, there was no danger, so she could do as she wanted. Vexthra also didn’t want to force her to cultivate. When or if she wanted, she could resume her cultivation.
It wasn’t like she would be going back outside for now. There were many things she could do inside the tower to pass the time.
Of course, since she was now with Gaia, Dori, and Akira, Vexthra knew they wouldn’t let her slack off on her training.
Aala was just a mortal when Kent brought her with the Sky Foxes into the tower. But because she had joined Gaia’s team, they had helped her with rare treasures to cultivate ahead of time.
She was now a Core Formation stage cultivator.
Another example was Li Hua, who had yet again entered seclusion since she had already reached the Spirit King stage and even become a Shadow Saint.
Although Kent was paying for the treasures, as long as one joined Gaia’s team, they would be taken care of for life. So after relaxing in the garden for a while, they left, and Risana followed them.
Vexthra actually was happy Risana left. Having her around someone like Selene was a risk she was not willing to take.
So it was better to let her go with Gaia, who at least would teach her a couple of things that would benefit her in the long run.
With that settled, they went back to the Legion Tower to handle the issue with the 21 True Immortals before climbing to the 9th floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon.

They couldn’t just kill them. That would be a waste, so the next logical choice was to make them work. But to do that, they must become their slaves, something Vexthra and the rest of her sisters are not willing to do since Kent hates slavery.
So they needed a different method. Thankfully, Yi Lai, Veera, and Elaine all had their own ways to get the best out of them, alive or dead.

chapters.title: Chapter 1407: She Is Back
paragraphs: [God Realm - Unknown Planet]
Somewhere in the God Realm, a True God quickly made his way through a stormy cloud, his body covered in divine energy. He seemed to be in a hurry to get somewhere and could not afford to be late.
He had travelled from a very far place to get where he was headed.

A few hours later, he arrived on a planet where, from the moment he entered, the smell of herbs assaulted his nostrils. Looking around, some of the most valuable herbs in the universe could be found there.
However, despite their value, the True God didn’t seem to have interest in any of them. He flew rapidly toward a small mountain where a beautiful mansion stood, its front doors open.
The smell of the pill could be felt, smelled, and seen escaping the vents of this building.
It wouldn’t take a genius to know this was a pill house, and judging by the value of the herbs around and the smell of the pill, the owner of this planet must be a legendary alchemist.
Just the smell alone showed that the person is pretty advanced on the path to pill-making.
When the True God landed on the mountain, he didn’t rush to enter. He stayed outside for ten hours before a voice came from inside.
"Come in."
He walked into the building and quickly made his way to a living room where a handsome Elf sat on a throne.
He was extremely handsome, and judging by the aura around him, he was without a doubt a recently ascended Universal God.
"Greetings, my lord," the True God bowed.
"At ease, Landon. You can sit." Landon nodded and raised his head before sitting in a chair opposite the Elf.
In the vast universe, he is known as the Eastern Pill God. There are many Pill Gods in the universe, just like there are many sword gods.
However, just like how the Immortal Realm is known by the five divisions - Eastern, Western, Southern, Northern, and Central - the God Realm is the same.
In the Eastern region, there are fifteen Pill Gods, with him being the best of them. His name is Pill God Brandon. But they mostly refer to him as the Eastern Pill God.
So his fame is wide, and his expertise as a Pill God is also undisputed. This is why a True God is bowing before him, as if his life were nothing significant.
But then again, even the Supremes would be respectful before him because of what he can do with herbs and flame.
His pills are legendary, and that is known by all.
"Well, why did you rush here in haste, Landon?" Pill God Brandon asked.
"She is back, my lord," Landon replied, sounding like he had been waiting for a while now to say those words.
"Who is back, Landon?"
"The Heaven’s Daughter."
"What..." The look on Pill God Brandon’s face changed. The initial nonchalant expression gave way to interest, hunger, and joy.
"Where is she?" he asked.
"We tracked her to an immortal planet. However, before we could go there, she was taken away."
"Taken away," Pill God Brandon gritted his teeth. "By who?"
"Kent Madson."
A frown appeared on Pill God Brandon’s face. He had been looking for one thing for the past millions of years, and just when he found it, she was taken away by someone he knew all too well.
"Do we know why he took her away? Did he know the kind of person she is, and most importantly, did she know the kind of person she is?"
"I am not sure any of them do. However, from what my people gathered, the Dark Elf King on the planet had a son who enjoyed putting arrows through defenseless people.

He captured a batch of slaves, in which the Heaven’s Daughter was one of them. However, the night before he could start what he called the hunt, Kent Madson appeared, killed him, and rescued all the people he had captured.
This means he had no idea that the Heaven’s Daughter was good fortune walking, and he most certainly didn’t know the kind of treasure he had rescued. He merely rescued slaves and killed a scum."
Pill God Brandon sat there for a few minutes, the frown on his face deepening.
During the transition period, he killed the Heaven’s Daughter not because she offended him; it was merely an excuse to get what he wanted.
That thing had propelled him to where he is now. However, every good thing comes to an end, and so he had been looking for her again to continue his winning streak.
Now that he had found her, the next thing was to get his hands on her. However, Kent had entered the scene, and that is just not something he saw coming.
To him, when he heard about Kent, he wasn’t interested one bit. He is an alchemist, so a swordsman making waves was nothing to him.
He had no interest in going after Kent. However, now that he has something he wanted, he knew he had no choice but to join the hunt.
The value of the Heaven’s Daughter is too important for him to allow her to fall into the hands of someone who has already gained the recognition of the Sword Dao.
That now felt like a threat, and he just could not allow it to happen.

"Pull all the strings you can to locate this Kent Madson. Remember, eliminating him and retrieving the Heaven’s Daughter is now the priority. He is a wild card that cannot be allowed to live for long.
So do that, and even if you have to call in the favor of some of the people who owe me, do that. I want him dead and the treasure retrieved alive."
"I will do as you say, my lord," Landon said with a nod.
"I know you will." Pill God Brandon sighed, then he asked another question, "How about that lady we tried recruiting a couple of thousand years ago?"
"Pill Immortal Flura?"
"Yes. Her. What is the progress so far?"

"She rejected our offer three times. However, recently, she had concocted a Tier 21 intelligent pill with two Violet Pill Rings. This drew much attention to her, so I sent three demigods to take her by force. But, they didn’t return.
I have no idea what happened, but I am sure someone extremely powerful is protecting her from the shadows."
Pill God Brandon smirked and retrieved a medallion from his space ring. "Take this to the Silent Shadow Tower. They will listen to whatever you want and grant it without any resistance.
She must be brought here at all costs. With her talent, refining her will push me closer to becoming a Pill Supreme."
"I will not fail, my lord." Landon took the medallion and stored it away. He stood up and, after giving a respectful bow, he flew away. He had received his mission, and so he had to get on it.
After he was gone, Pill God Brandon remained in his chair for a few minutes before a heavy sigh escaped his lips.

"Kent Madson, you have yourself to blame. Crossing me is the last thing you will ever do." He grinned and stood up from his chair. However, after taking three steps, he stopped, and his body shuddered.

"What in the hell was that?" Just now, he sensed a very terrifying glare lock onto his body. The glare was from a predator, one who had shed so much blood that just his gaze could make even a Celestial shit their pants.
He shook his body to wipe away the fear and continued on his way, unaware that he had already offended someone he shouldn’t have three times.

He is an alchemist, so a swordsman making waves was nothing to him.
He had no interest in going after Kent.
However, now that he has something he wanted, he knew he had no choice but to join the hunt.
The value of the Heaven’s Daughter is too important for him to allow her to fall into the hands of someone who has already gained the recognition of the Sword Dao.
That now felt like a threat, and he just could not allow it to happen.
"Pull all the strings you can to locate this Kent Madson.
Remember, eliminating him and retrieving the Heaven’s Daughter is now the priority.
He is a wild card that cannot be allowed to live for long.
So do that, and even if you have to call in the favor of some of the people who owe me, do that.
I want him dead and the treasure retrieved alive."
"I will do as you say, my lord," Landon said with a nod.
"I know you will." Pill God Brandon sighed, then he asked another question, "How about that lady we tried recruiting a couple of thousand years ago?"
"Pill Immortal Flura?"
"Yes.
Her.
What is the progress so far?"
"She rejected our offer three times.
However, recently, she had concocted a Tier 21 intelligent pill with two Violet Pill Rings.
This drew much attention to her, so I sent three demigods to take her by force.
But, they didn’t return.
I have no idea what happened, but I am sure someone extremely powerful is protecting her from the shadows."
Pill God Brandon smirked and retrieved a medallion from his space ring.
"Take this to the Silent Shadow Tower.
They will listen to whatever you want and grant it without any resistance.
She must be brought here at all costs.
With her talent, refining her will push me closer to becoming a Pill Supreme."
"I will not fail, my lord." Landon took the medallion and stored it away.
He stood up and, after giving a respectful bow, he flew away.
He had received his mission, and so he had to get on it.
After he was gone, Pill God Brandon remained in his chair for a few minutes before a heavy sigh escaped his lips.
"Kent Madson, you have yourself to blame.
Crossing me is the last thing you will ever do." He grinned and stood up from his chair.
However, after taking three steps, he stopped, and his body shuddered.
"What in the hell was that?" Just now, he sensed a very terrifying glare lock onto his body.
The glare was from a predator, one who had shed so much blood that just his gaze could make even a Celestial shit their pants.
He shook his body to wipe away the fear and continued on his way, unaware that he had already offended someone he shouldn’t have three times.

chapters.title: Chapter 1408: Value Of True Immortals
paragraphs: After parting ways with Risana, the ladies returned to the Legion Tower to address the issue with the twenty-one True Immortals.

For now, in the harem and legion, Vexthra knew Yi Lai could gain some dragon candidates from it. She is a necromancer who can only have dragon undead. She herself had become a dragon after her rebirth.
When she awakened this class and bloodline, she came with only one dragon undead. Later, she received another one when she sent the Hand into the dragon trial.
Back then, when they fought the Forsaken Race, they captured the Hand who was responsible for opening the Forsaken Door.
However, instead of killing her, she chose to send her into that trial where, if she failed to pass, she would be in pain for all eternity.
Thankfully, she passed and returned as a flame dragon. The best part: she returned as a Heavenly Ascension-stage cultivator with many powerful abilities.
Yi Lai may have only two dragon undead under her command, but she is terrifying. They are all top-quality undead.
So she can benefit from these Dark Elves by sending a few into the dragon trial.
The second is Veera, who had already begun her creation process after awakening her innate body and an innate talent.
So far, she, Ankaara, Yi Lai, and Elyndra had awakened their innate bodies.
Her own innate body awakening came with an innate talent that allows her to create a new generation of undead. This can be accomplished by using powerful treasures to refine her undead legion.
However, since she didn’t have those, she chose the next best option, which was to merge two or more undead together to form a more powerful and refined undead.
She had already started, and from the twelve new-generation undead she had created, in their next mission, if she was allowed the chance, none of her friends would even raise their weapons.
The next person who would benefit is Elaine, who also awakened an innate talent that allows her to utilize her death aspect to create what she calls Death Agents.
Inside her Life and Death Space, there is a section primarily dedicated to death. Inside that space are thousands of tombstones.
Initially, she could only use them to raise the dead and use them temporarily in combat.
However, after she consumed the Innate Talent Awakening Pill, she awakened the first ability for the tombstones, allowing her to sacrifice something to awaken the horror buried at each marked grave.
The description said that by sacrificing something of equal value, she can summon a Death Agent.
Initially, she could only summon one, but after she consumed the Innate Talent Booster Pill, that number shot up to three.
This means that if she were to sacrifice three True Immortals, she would receive three Death Agents. That is a good trade in her eyes, so the twenty-one True Immortals can be shared among them.
Avotha went for all twenty-one of them, making sure not even a single one had the power to move their finger. He placed them in chains fashioned from Death Qi.
They wouldn’t be able to break them even if they were left alone for thousands of years.

"I will be needing just five of them," Veera said with a thoughtful expression, then she added, "While having all of them would be great, I don’t have enough soul strength to handle more than five True Immortal undead. So five is just fine."
"Same here. I also need just five. The dragon trial at the moment can only accept five candidates. I would get more quota when I reach the Empyrean Stage," Yi Lai also said with a gentle smile.
"Well then. I will be taking three, bringing the total to thirteen," Elaine said. "This means we will have eight more." She turned to Uncle Drew. "Don’t you need some?"

"That won’t be necessary. All fourteen Night Agents only need Hell spirits or underworld souls to grow. I have loads of those, so we can keep the remaining eight for when you three need some more later."
Everyone nodded.

Adding thirteen True Immortals to their mix is worth more than having twenty-one slave True Immortals. Elaine would be getting three top-quality Death Agents, while Yi Lai, if they pass the dragon trial, would come out even more terrifying.

As for Veera, she had already drawn the schematic for the kind of undead she planned on creating. This means they are going to get more from what they would have had if they had gone ahead and enslaved the twenty-one True Immortals.
Because Kent hates that, they also have slavery. So the undead would be okay.
"I guess I will need one of them," Sylara said, her red eyes shining with buried hunger. "Well, I will be needing his blood essence to draw my first Blood Tattoo."
Vexthra nodded and turned to the four ladies. "You can select the ones you want."
Without having a say in anything, fourteen True Immortals were selected. Three went to Elaine, five each to Yi Lai and Veera, while Sylara took one.
She merely wanted the blood essence, so Avotha killed him by burning his body, leaving only the blood essence. The body became useless, with no blood essence left, so burning it was the best option.
After they were selected, the remaining seven were sent away.
With Vexthra’s assistance, Elaine took the three True Immortals to her Life and Death Space. She would need a couple of weeks to summon all three Death Agents.
Thankfully, her sisters are there to escort her in her endeavors.
As for Veera, Avotha killed the five True Immortals she selected. Taking their energetic bodies, she vanished into her Necro Space, where she started working on creating five legendary undead.

Yi Lai, on the other hand, opened five portals and sent the five True Immortals into each. Unlike Veera and Elaine, who are guaranteed to receive powerful subordinates, she can’t have the same guarantee.
That is because unless the five True Immortals pass their individual dragon trials, none will be returning as dragon undead. So she had no idea what would be happening at the end of the day.
She could only wait and watch what walked out of the five portals.
Uncle Drew and the rest of the legion chose to wait with her. If a portal closes, it means the one taking the trial had failed, and so their suffering will be eternal.
From what she learned when the Hand had her trial, when she entered that realm, she was transported to a Dragon Tower where her potential was measured.

She had a God-tier talent, so she entered the Dragon God Trial, which required her to battle three dragons. The first one was at the Peak Core Formation stage. The second was at the Peak Spirit Ascension stage, while the third was at the Peak Spirit King stage.
She barely managed to win.

However, from what she said, if she had awakened a Dragon Supreme talent, perhaps she would have failed. So while her future ends at the God stage, having someone like her by her side is all Yi Lai could ask for.
She would need Gods, Supremes, and even Celestials for what is coming, so having a God is not too bad. Now, it is her hope that the five True Immortals would return stronger than ever.

chapters.title: Chapter 1409: Progress
paragraphs: Several days passed, but there was no noticeable progress on either side.

Inside the legion tower, the five portals remained open, showing that the five True Immortals are still alive and taking their trials. This shows that every last one of them is still alive, which is a good thing in a way.ree
As for Elaine, she and her sisters are still inside her Life and Death Space. She had done all her preparations, but the summoning ritual is a bit complex, so she is working on some final touches.
And for Veera, she had started creating all five undead. The process is a bit demanding and dangerous if not done right, so she is making slow but steady progress.
The only person who had made some progress was Sylara, who had already drawn a Blood Tattoo below her left eye. It is called the Perception Blood Tattoo.
It amplifies her sight and reaction speed by 500 times.
Already, she is fast and very perceptive. However, after some battles she fought in the dungeons, she realized her perception and reaction speed were a bit lacking.
So, using half of the blood essence she got from the True Immortal, she drew the tattoo, and she is now working on the second.
She aims to redraw the Blood Tattoos she sacrificed during the battle with the Church of Destruction. Of course, there are many tattoos she can draw, but these ones are the most vital.
She is already under a heavy toll, so just these two would do for now.
But she wasn’t the only one who had made some progress in the past couple of days.
Inside the Alchemy Tower, Kent had been working diligently for days. The aim is to perform a perfect extraction of Tier 11 and 12 pill herbs.
He is required to concoct a Tier 10, 11, or 12 pill with an Azure Pill Ring. Naturally, that is just impossible. There is no way he can handle that with even a Tier 12 pill.
The essence he would require to refine such a Pill Ring can only be produced from Tier 13 pill herbs. So he was basically being asked to do something that had never been done before.
Even Pill Celestial Kevin Sage said it is impossible.
However, to become a Pill Monarch, he must reach that milestone and even exceed it. After all, he is now on the path of becoming the youngest person to ever become a Pill Monarch.
The requirement is harsh, but Kent is determined. So, over the past couple of days, he started the extraction process with Tier 1 pill herbs and quickly worked his way up.
On the first day alone, he had worked on performing a perfect extraction from Tier 1 pill herbs to Tier 8. His progress was rather fast for someone at his level.
Of course, he is a Pill Emperor, but that isn’t enough to make someone like him make such progress. He practically went overboard and did what had never been done before.
But he didn’t stop there. He went ahead and spent half a day completing Tier 9 and 1.5 days completing Tier 10.
However, when he reached Tier 11, he started hitting roadblocks. The process was a bit challenging. His first extraction took four good hours, but he came out with 20% impurities.

That was far from the impurity-free extraction he had hoped to achieve. Having 20% impurities isn’t something he found normal. But that didn’t kill his alchemical spirit. If anything, he saw it as a challenge that must be overcome.
So he went ahead and tried a second extraction. This time, after 4 hours, he managed to reduce the impurity level to 10%. That was a huge leap from the previous 20%.
However, that was also far from what he wanted, so with a dozen portions of ingredients at his disposal, he went in deep, and after four more trials, he managed to come out with only 5% impurities.

But that was when he finally hit a roadblock that he just could not see a way around. It was like he had finally met his first obstacle in that path of alchemy that the knowledge he had acquired from Pill Celestial Kevin Sage could not fix it.

That was a challenge he had to find his own creative way to fix. Kent took the challenge like his life depended on it, and over the past few days, he had been working to find a way to handle the last 5%.
He knew if he managed to figure out a way to do that, there was a good chance he would not struggle with Tier 12 pill herbs.

And also, as long as he manages to accomplish what comes next, then when it comes to making Tier 12 pills, he would have no issues. Making pills depended entirely on extracting the medicinal essence from the herb and burning off impurities.
Condensing and refining are also important, but without the first two steps, he wouldn’t have anything to apply the last two steps to before even thinking of refining pill rings.
So he poured his all into it, and as he worked diligently to find a solution, he slowly began to gain an even deeper understanding of alchemy.
It was now that he realised he had been relying solely on the knowledge from Pill Celestial Kevin Sage. He had to apply his own knowledge. He had to build his own understanding.

Thankfully, he was among the geniuses with a high IQ back on Earth. And now that he had used cultivation to evolve himself to the point he would be called a god if he were still on Earth, his mind had become even more powerful.
So, making sense of what he knew and what he had to do was coming along much faster than he would like to admit.

Although it was taking him days and several thousand tower points, he was making steady progress, and that alone went a long way to show he is much more committed and greatly knowledgeable when it comes to alchemy.
It took him several days to come up with a formula. He didn’t create a new technique, though; he merely cloned over a dozen techniques and merged them into a new one.

It is a bit complex, but he knew once he used it, he would be able to bridge the final gap he was missing. The next thing, however, was making sure he had covered all grounds before he dared apply this new technique.
A slight mistake, and he would be ruining not only his herbs but also his cauldron.
After that was checked and handled, he decided to take a day off to calm his mind and see if he had made any mistakes.
He spent the day inside the Alchemy Tower, moving from one location to the next. He also used the time to read the manual he received a few years ago about Pill Celestial Kevin Sage.
It talked about how he started walking the path of alchemy. It was rather a funny story, one that he had no idea would lead him to become a Pill Celestial one day.
After he had relaxed enough, he went back to extracting Tier 11 pill herbs once more, this time using a technique that had never been used before.
As to whether he would succeed, it would depend on how much knowledge he had put into developing the technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 1410: Success In The End
paragraphs: Kent started the new extraction with great confidence and high expectations.
He knew he had a lot to handle, and many things could go wrong. However, he disregarded all that and made sure he had all the variables in place.
Negative thoughts would only ruin his work, so he wasn’t about to give in.
His fire control, his precision, and his patience had been fine-tuned to the point that he had nothing to worry about. But when he started again, his worries came back.
The first worry, of course, was the fact that the new technique made everything a bit slow.

The flames inside the cauldron no longer roared with their usual aggressive rhythm. Instead, they moved like a breathing organism—expanding, contracting, thinning, then thickening again. Every pulse had to be controlled.
Every fluctuation had to be deliberate.
However, that was where the problem came in. Initially, he had to use one method to control the flame. That method had become stagnated at some point, leaving him at a 5% impurity level.
However, the new technique he had created was designed so that he would not follow a single method.
He had to switch between methods, which he managed to fine-tune to the point he desired, considering he was at Perfect Harmony mastery with his flame element.
The problem was the new variables he had started to encounter.

The first one concerned the rate at which the herbs were burning. Whenever he changed the method of flame control, a different issue arose, preventing him from actively switching between techniques without a backlash.
Because of this limitation, his first trial ended in failure.
He fixed the errors he had identified and tried again. However, that also ended in a rather heartbreaking way. His initial 5% impurity shot back up to 15%, something he never saw coming.
Kent had to spend two more days workshopping his technique and refining a few details before going back to extract his third batch of herbs.
This time, he managed to bring the impurities back to 5%. This progress taught him a lot, so he went ahead and tried again, applying what he learned.
Surprisingly, he removed 2% from it, leaving him with 3%. That, in a way, made him happy, and as he expected, his understanding also expanded.
It was like the path he had decided to walk had found its way of expanding his mind as he solved the problems afflicting him.
The more errors he fixed, the more his understanding expanded.
Slowly, he made progress, and after seven trials, he reduced his impurities to 2%.
Again, he took a few days off to think about other things. He even used the time to explore the tower store, and that was when he discovered a rather intriguing section that sold items from Earth.
Kent couldn’t help himself and took advantage of this discovery.
He served himself a few slices of pizza and a Coke. It took his mind off the alchemy and gave him something new to obsess over.
In the end, he decided to buy his own equipment and ingredients to make his own pizza. His success rate there was rather high, so taking that win, he dove back into alchemy.
This time, he took his time and reworked every last bit of the mistakes he had made. He ended up making so much progress that he even pushed the impurity level to 1%.
This progress left Kent happy. So he went deeper again, and after two more trials, he achieved 100% extraction.

He celebrated, then he started another extraction process. This time, he made sure he had more than enough time to focus on his technique and see how it improved with each extraction he had accomplished over the past few days.
He made so much progress, and when he was finally done with everything, he smiled and gave himself a pat on the back.
He had succeeded with Tier 11 herbs; his next challenge was Tier 12, which he started with great confidence.

By the time he was done with the first extraction using Tier 12 herbs, Kent smiled broadly, for he knew he had figured out a way that, if developed well, would catapult his alchemy skills to a whole new level.
But after the jubilation, his limitations surfaced. The first was the time it took him to achieve 100% extraction.
It took him close to 4 hours to extract the Tier 11 herbs, while it took up to 5 hours to handle the Tier 12 herbs. The process was just too slow.

In a pill competition, he would be required to accomplish everything within 5 hours. If he spent this much time extracting only the medicinal essence, he would be disqualified before he even made any progress.
So he had to reduce the time taken to extract just the essence. If he could lower it to just an hour, that would go a long way. So he started slow, and after 17 hours, he reduced the time to 2 hours.
He forced himself, and after improving his technique further, he finally managed to reduce the time to an hour.
That was another milestone that he became proud of. He had finally tried something that didn’t come from anyone, not even his past life memories

But through his boldness and knowledge, he managed to also open the door to a whole different path that, if he tread carefully, he would one day become the first alchemist to concoct a Celestial Grade pill with zero impurity.
That milestone was achieved by Pill Celestial Kevin Sage and a few others. However, none managed to achieve a 100% extraction even at the Pill God stage.
So, on the path he had started walking, if he dedicated himself to mastering it, there was a great chance he would open a new path for many one day.
After his achievement, which ended in his concocting a Tier 11 and Tier 12 pill, he decided to tackle the next task, which was refining an Azure Pill Ring.
This one refinement was the sole reason why he had to learn how to achieve 100% extraction. Now that he had achieved that, the next move was to refine the Azure Pill Ring.
Kent made a bold move by going with a Tier 11 pill despite the option to choose Tier 12.
He knew he had managed to perform 100% extraction of a Tier 12 herb.
However, comparing the essence he got from Tier 11, he knew attempting the Azure Pill Ring with Tier 12 would push him to his limits and might even fail.
He could later try that. But with what he was aiming for, he wanted to become a Pill Monarch first before doing many other things.
He arranged the ingredients for the Bone Tempering Pill. That was what he would be making his name with.
"Tower, this is the moment. Make sure every last second and angel is captured, for I will be sharing the video with the alchemy community one day."

[The master should rest assured that I will capture every moment. If the master manages to concoct a Tier 11 pill with an Azure Pill Ring, he would become the first person in history to accomplish that. So I will capture every last second.]
"You are the best, Tower."
Kent sighed, then he started the extraction process. Two hours later, the moment of the day came.
