chapters.title: Chapter 1411: Great Achievement
paragraphs: It took Kent an hour and 15 minutes to extract the essence.
That was a bit longer than he expected.
However, since he wouldn’t be burning impurities, considering he had achieved perfect extraction, he went ahead and, within 10 minutes, condensed the pill.
That was much faster than he anticipated.
Once these steps were out of the way, he moved ahead to the main event, which had to do with refining the Azure Pill Ring.

For that, he already had the [Nine-step pill ring refinement] technique. It is the best in the game, considering it was invented by the legendary Kevin Sage, so he tapped into that and started working his way up.
Basically, he would have to divide the essence for the Pill ring into 9 parts, refine each separately, and then merge them to form the Azure Pill Ring.
Technically, it was impossible. So, with what he had achieved in the past weeks alone, Kent knew he was on the right track. H wasted no time and started the refinement.
What he was attempting to do had never been done before, so he was giving himself all the time in the world to succeed.
The process started on the right track, and as each level was completed, the next was taken over until, after an hour and a half, all nine essences had been refined.
"Moment of truth."
Kent let a small smile appear on his lips as he slowly merged the nine essences and started refining the Azure Pill Ring.

What a few who were merely curious had attempted and failed was now being attempted by Kent Madson. As to whether he would succeed where others failed, it would depend on how badly he wanted to become a Pill Monarch.

If he were to fail right now, he would have to attempt it again using a Tier 12 pill. However, even though he had confidence in himself, simply being able to accomplish the perfect extraction of a Tier 11 herb as a Pill Emperor was all the motivation he needed.

He had already done what only a few could do while at the Pill Emperor stage. So he was ahead of many, and that alone was translating into what he had accomplished in these past few hours of pill-making, which was finally nearing its end.
A pill with an Azure Pill Ring would become 7 times more potent. So if Kent managed to make this pill, instead of its initial 100% potency, it would become 700% potent, since it was a perfect pill.
That was just too much to even consider.
But Kent was considering it, and after 30 minutes of refinement, he applied the last method needed to bring out the pill ring.
Kent held his breath like his lastborn was about to jump off a building. He knew the moment had arrived, and so when he made his move, the outcome became clear.
A faint, sweet, and wonderful smell escaped the cauldron, filling the alchemy tower in an instant. Kent didn’t dare breathe; he continued to refine the last part of the essence for five minutes.
With every minute that passed, the smell of the pill kept intensifying until it stopped when a white smoke escaped the cauldron.
The moment the smoke appeared, Kent sighed, for he knew white smoke meant a Grey Pill Ring. It was a bit heartbreaking, but he kept his composure.
However, a second later, blue smoke also escaped the openings in the cauldron. Kent’s heart skipped a beat for a moment, then a broad smile that came from the heart appeared on his face.
His mood brightened immediately because, at that moment, the process ended, and when the cauldron opened, the pill that came out was not what he expected.

The plan was to concoct a pill with an Azure Pill Ring. But what he was looking at now was a perfect Tier 11 Bone Tempering Pill with not one but two pill rings. The first, of course, was the Grey Pill Ring, which was much deeper compared to the previous ones he had refined.
The second was the Azure Pill Ring, which was also much deeper, all things considered. Basically, he was aiming for 7 times potency, but he achieved 10 times potency instead.
Kent reached for the pill; however, before his hand could touch it, his world darkened, and he passed out. His consciousness had entered enlightenment.
The Pill Dao saw his effort, and so he was being rewarded.
Messages flooded his vision.
[Pill Council - Pill Dao Tablet Update]
Just like how there is the Sword Council, the Ice Temple, or even the Celestial Council, there is also the Pill Council, where all decisions concerning the world of pill-making are made.
All alchemists who had ever stepped into it are legends or were legends.

This council is said to have existed since the dawn of time and has been working tirelessly to ensure the world of alchemists is secured and elevated to a level where pill-making would become the centre of everyone’s life.
Already, alchemy had secured its place as one of the professions nobody can do away with.
The Pill Council had brought out many recipes, some that had even raised the bar so high that the Pill Daos had recognised them.
Just like the Sword Dao Tablet, where those who have made a significant contribution in the path of swordsmanship will be recognised, the Pill Dao Tablet is also the same.
However, it is a bit special.
On the Sword Dao Tablet, only the swordsman’s name and rank are shown. However, with the Pill Dao Tablet, the name, rank, and achievement are displayed for all to see.
Whenever a Pill Dao Tablet records a name, it is broadcast to every last known branch of the Pill Council, be it in the Medium, High, Immortal, God, Supreme, or Celestial World.

So everyone became shocked when, 14 million years after the last name appeared, just now, the Pill Dao Tablet recorded another name, and this name, everyone had heard many times in the past couple of months alone.
In fact, he is the most famous person in the entire universe, and he has just become even more popular.

The Pill Dao Tablet only records the names of those who had done something incredible in the path of pill-making, so Kent, who was known for his name appearing on the Sword Dao Tablet and even the Ice Dao Tablet, was the last person expected to make an appearance here.
The reason is simple. Swordsmanship is a demanding profession. It takes every last ounce of one’s time to walk such a path.

So his name appearing on the sword dao tablet shows that he is one of the hard-working swordsmen in the universe. Similarly, he could also add an elemental affinity to his swordsmanship, which every swordsman does. So again, gaining recognition there was also possible.
However, taking on yet another demanding profession, such as alchemy, and gaining recognition from the Pill Dao is unheard of. It is impossible to walk such paths at the same time.
Now, he alone had gained the recognition of three Daos, and that alone was just something nobody saw coming.
He is like the outlier, the anomaly that nobody looks forward to, but when they least expect it, he swoops in and takes everyone by storm.
His name had appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet, and so yet again, he had become the most famous person in the entire universe. His name had started causing chaos yet again.

chapters.title: Chapter 1412: Pill Council
paragraphs: [Planet Yorumi - Celestial World]

The main headquarters of the Pill Council is located in a Celestial World, one of the few such Celestial worlds in the universe. It is a known fact that there are not many Celestials, or at least this assumption was reached due to the known Celestials.
Of course, many fell during the era-ending wars that plague the universe.
So for now, the known Celestials are fewer than a thousand, something that should be considered disturbing.
After all, when the attackers come, they will be bringing tens of thousands of Celestials. Once that day comes, there is just no way the universe will be able to stop them.
The Pill Council consists of a nine-member council. There is no supreme authority like the Celestial Council or the Soul Temple. All decisions are made by the Nine Council Members.
The nine members are all accomplished Pill Celestials.

They had been heading the Pill Council for billions of years. In fact, on the Pill Dao Tablet, their names are listed. This means they had, at some point in the past, done something great to gain the recognition of the Pill Dao.
When the Pill Dao Tablet announced Kent’s name, they dropped everything and rushed to an emergency meeting, one aimed at determining Kent’s fate.
After all, he had proven to the entire universe that, no matter the level of the herb, refining a pill ring is determined by the alchemist’s skill.
Kent had refined an Azure Pill Ring from Tier 11 pill ingredients. That is just over the top, and they most certainly would love to know how he had done that when he is merely a Pill Emperor.
He shouldn’t have had that much understanding of pill-making to refine such a pill ring.
Inside a large yet beautiful hall, sitting around a large table made from the rarest Celestial jade are the most powerful alchemists in the universe,
Four females and five males...

"I hope we all know why we are here, so why don’t we get down to it?" Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime spoke first, his presence almost invisible. In the vast universe, he is known as the Pill Dao Arbiter.
This title came about because of what he had accomplished that made the Pill Dao recognize him. He came up with a way to concoct pills from abstract concepts like "Fate," "Karma," and "Destiny."
He made the "Supreme Fate Binding Pill," one of the most dangerous pills ever created. It can be said that aside from the Pill Dao, other Daos recognized his brilliance.
"We all never slept and dreamt of a day like this. After all, when Kevin Sage decided to share his knowledge with all, the world of alchemy was ruined.
Alchemists now rely on what has been done before to rise up the ladder. Of course, he had done the right thing, but his intentions were ruined by how lazy man had become.

However, it ends today. Today, we all have witnessed something that I, when I was a Pill Monarch, couldn’t achieve. Refining an Azure Pill Ring from Tier 11 ingredients was something we all know is impossible.
It had never been done before, and I know you all can attest that, at some point, you tried something like that. I was able to achieve that when I became a Pill Sovereign.
This means we have just witnessed history, and I, for one, would love to hear how he achieved that. This kid must be located and brought here for proper guidance."
"Aren’t you a little too excited, Prime?" Pill Celestial Nyxaris Vel, the Poison Sovereign of Balance, stepped in, her expression calm, but there was danger behind her eyes.
"We both know that before the Pill Dao recognized you, it meant you had done something that impressed them. Kent Madson’s name had appeared because he accomplished a great feat.
"Don’t get me wrong. I am not downplaying his achievement or anything. I am just a bit concerned with how fast you want to run this down the chain.
The kid is merely a Pill Emperor. He has to go through the Monarch, Sovereign, Legend, and Divine stages before reaching the point where it all matters, the Pill Immortal stage.
So maybe we should take a step back and see this from a new angle."
"I can’t believe I am saying this, but I think Vel is right," Pill Celestial Braegon Titanforge said, his expression filled with a defeated sigh...
"What is that supposed to mean, Braegon?" Vel asked, her eyes narrowed a bit.
"Nothing. Just that I think you made a point. From where I sit, seeking him out right now will only put a target on his back.
My name appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet when I became a Pill God. But even so, if it wasn’t for Prime and Selphira, I would have died or, worse, become a slave for the Soul Temple.
The kid had already appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet and the Ice Dao Tablet. From what I have learned in the past few months, there is a manhunt out for him.
If we also join the fray, I am afraid he would become overwhelmed really quickly. We both know if we make a move, it would trigger the others, and who knows what they would do.
So instead of seeking him out and bringing him to the light, we keep him hidden for now. He is brilliant from what I can tell, but he is not ready for the ball game we are playing."
Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime nodded. He is a reasonable person, so he understood what his colleagues were saying. However, he is also an overachiever.
He had dedicated his entire life to studying alchemy, so when he sees talent, he always feels a sense of devotion to ensure their talent is not wasted.

Many years ago, he met a street talent who lost a bet to a lady because he was in love with her. As a price for losing, he was meant to challenge a Pill King to a duel or work as a slave for 200 years.
Obviously, he liked to be a free man, so despite his status as a Pill Saint, he took on the challenge, and after 10 hours, he emerged as a winner.
Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime took him in as his first and only disciple. Many years later, his disciple would be known far and wide as the most intelligent person in the universe.
Many called him Pill Celestial Kevin Sage; others called him the Thinker.
However, those who know him personally know he became the legend that lives on to this day because of one person. That person is Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime.

Later, when Pill Celestial Kevin Sage gave it all away to lead the battle against the Calamity Beasts and fell in that battle, Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime secluded himself, and for years, he shut himself off from the universe.
Just now, when Kent’s name appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet, the pride he felt when he witnessed Sage’s win against the Pill King resurfaced, and so he wanted to find him and nurture him.
He promised himself he would never dedicate himself to another disciple again after Kevin died. But Kent’s name appearing on the Pill Dao Tablet had shattered that.
"He had already walked into the realm of danger when his name appeared on three Dao Tablets. So I suppose the question we should be asking is, how are we going to protect him?"

He made the "Supreme Fate Binding Pill," one of the most dangerous pills ever created.
It can be said that aside from the Pill Dao, other Daos recognized his brilliance.
"We all never slept and dreamt of a day like this.
After all, when Kevin Sage decided to share his knowledge with all, the world of alchemy was ruined.
Alchemists now rely on what has been done before to rise up the ladder.
Of course, he had done the right thing, but his intentions were ruined by how lazy man had become.
However, it ends today.
Today, we all have witnessed something that I, when I was a Pill Monarch, couldn’t achieve.
Refining an Azure Pill Ring from Tier 11 ingredients was something we all know is impossible.
It had never been done before, and I know you all can attest that, at some point, you tried something like that.
I was able to achieve that when I became a Pill Sovereign.
This means we have just witnessed history, and I, for one, would love to hear how he achieved that.
This kid must be located and brought here for proper guidance."
"Aren’t you a little too excited, Prime?" Pill Celestial Nyxaris Vel, the Poison Sovereign of Balance, stepped in, her expression calm, but there was danger behind her eyes.
"We both know that before the Pill Dao recognized you, it meant you had done something that impressed them.
Kent Madson’s name had appeared because he accomplished a great feat.
"Don’t get me wrong.
I am not downplaying his achievement or anything.
I am just a bit concerned with how fast you want to run this down the chain.
The kid is merely a Pill Emperor.
He has to go through the Monarch, Sovereign, Legend, and Divine stages before reaching the point where it all matters, the Pill Immortal stage.
So maybe we should take a step back and see this from a new angle."
"I can’t believe I am saying this, but I think Vel is right," Pill Celestial Braegon Titanforge said, his expression filled with a defeated sigh...
"What is that supposed to mean, Braegon?" Vel asked, her eyes narrowed a bit.
"Nothing.
Just that I think you made a point.
From where I sit, seeking him out right now will only put a target on his back.
My name appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet when I became a Pill God.
But even so, if it wasn’t for Prime and Selphira, I would have died or, worse, become a slave for the Soul Temple.
The kid had already appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet and the Ice Dao Tablet.
From what I have learned in the past few months, there is a manhunt out for him.
If we also join the fray, I am afraid he would become overwhelmed really quickly.
We both know if we make a move, it would trigger the others, and who knows what they would do.
So instead of seeking him out and bringing him to the light, we keep him hidden for now.
He is brilliant from what I can tell, but he is not ready for the ball game we are playing."
Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime nodded.
He is a reasonable person, so he understood what his colleagues were saying.
However, he is also an overachiever.
He had dedicated his entire life to studying alchemy, so when he sees talent, he always feels a sense of devotion to ensure their talent is not wasted.
Many years ago, he met a street talent who lost a bet to a lady because he was in love with her.
As a price for losing, he was meant to challenge a Pill King to a duel or work as a slave for 200 years.
Obviously, he liked to be a free man, so despite his status as a Pill Saint, he took on the challenge, and after 10 hours, he emerged as a winner.
Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime took him in as his first and only disciple.
Many years later, his disciple would be known far and wide as the most intelligent person in the universe.
Many called him Pill Celestial Kevin Sage; others called him the Thinker.
However, those who know him personally know he became the legend that lives on to this day because of one person.
That person is Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime.

Later, when Pill Celestial Kevin Sage gave it all away to lead the battle against the Calamity Beasts and fell in that battle, Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime secluded himself, and for years, he shut himself off from the universe.
Just now, when Kent’s name appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet, the pride he felt when he witnessed Sage’s win against the Pill King resurfaced, and so he wanted to find him and nurture him.
He promised himself he would never dedicate himself to another disciple again after Kevin died.
But Kent’s name appearing on the Pill Dao Tablet had shattered that.
"He had already walked into the realm of danger when his name appeared on three Dao Tablets.
So I suppose the question we should be asking is, how are we going to protect him?"

chapters.title: Chapter 1413: The Best Plan
paragraphs: The question asked by Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime left the others in a bind. None had a tangible answer. After all, they know Kent is already in danger.
His name appearing on the Pill Dao Tablet made him an asset anyone would love to get their hands on. If they can’t ally with him, then they will suppress and force him to do their bidding.
They are aware of his existence, and so is the rest of the Universe. So there is just no way he would be safe even if they choose to maintain their distance.
The Soul Temple has always had its eyes out for talent, so there is just no way they won’t make their move on Kent once they find out where he lives.
So if that is the case, they must come up with a way to ensure Kent’s safety while also keeping him out of the spotlight.
They must maintain their distance, but they also cannot allow the Soul Temple to get their hands on him.
"There is only one solution, and that is to ensure he isn’t found by the Soul Temple or any of the dark organizations that have been hiding out from the universe’s eye for a while now.
I know he is meticulous. After all, it has been over a year since he became famous, yet no one has managed to make contact with him. This shows he knows what he is doing.
Of course, from what I have gathered, he seems to be in the High World, so maybe that was why. The High Worlds are highly restricted.

However, once he reaches the Immortal World, there is a good chance his anonymity would become useless there. So if we want to help him, we must put measures in place in the Immortal Worlds to ensure he is safe from danger, at least to the best of our abilities," Pill Celestial Korvane Draxil said, and his words seemed to resonate with everyone.
He made some sense, and after digesting what he said, they all knew he was right. Kent is safe now, so they must prepare for when he becomes an Immortal.
"I believe what Drax said is a good move. If our signature starts spreading to the High Worlds, there is a chance the others will become bolder and make dirty moves.
So we should let him be for now. There is no need to add more oil to the fire right now. He is safe and will remain so as long as he remains in the High World.
If anything, we should reach out to the Sword Council and the Ice Temple and see if we can form some alliance on how best to protect such a treasure.
The future of Alchemy is in his hands, and we both know it. So for once, we should drop our pride and make sure the safety of such a talent comes first."
Pill Celestial Tharos Embergrave also made his mind known.
In the end, they all nodded to his words.

Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime accepted their inputs. The end always justifies the means. If he wants to protect Kent, he must allow him to be for now. Once he reaches the stage where he can’t move on his own, they can come in and offer their help.
The last thing any of them wanted was to be the reason a talent like Kent found himself in trouble he couldn’t handle.
Pill Celestial Elyndra Myrr and Vaelith Moonshade gave an even better recommendation... They wanted to use the Midnight Shadows to protect Kent.
Pill Celestial Vaelith Moonshade has a connection with one of the Shadow Supremes in the Midnight Shadows. He owes her a favour, so she wants to call in that favour to help Kent.
After all, the Midnight Shadows are everywhere. They are in every High, Immortal, God, Supreme, and Celestial World. So with their help, Kent will be safe.
"Do that, Vaelith. They are discreet, and they most certainly hate the Soul Temple, so they would be of great help." Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime liked the idea.
"I like Vaelith’s idea also. The farther we stay from him, the better, so using the Midnight Shadows would come in handy," Pill Celestial Arkanis Solmere also added his voice.
In the end, a decision was reached, and so Pill Celestial Vaelith Moonshade immediately headed out to handle the task.
In no time, all of them left except Pill Celestial Zathoriel Prime and Elyndra Myrr.

They are the oldest members of the Pill Council, since both of them reached the rank of Pill Celestial during the Primordial Era. They lived through many eras, witnessed many wars, and through it all, preserved the legacy of Alchemy to this day.
They can be said to be the father and mother of Alchemy, as their contributions to the path span several generations.
"It is just like Kevin’s time all over again," Myrr said, her expression softening.
Many years ago, when Prime returned with Kevin Sage, she was one of the few who objected to the idea of him imparting the knowledge he had carried with him for years to such a brat.

In her opinion, Kevin Sage is spoiled and not serious enough to be entrusted with such a responsibility. Fast forward, and she was among the many who gave their all to make sure Kevin became one of the best.

The brat was so intelligent that they even questioned what goes on in his head sometimes. He had developed thousands of ways to concoct pills that to this day seem to have an impact in the world of Alchemy.
Kent showing he could do what had never been done before brought back past memories.

Prime smiled. "You are right. It is just like that brat’s time all over again." He chuckled and continued, "Back then, he always seemed to jump from one trouble to the next, always picking fights when he could just keep that mouth of his shut.
If only he had kept that mouth of his shut and minded his own business, his end wouldn’t have been that tragic. Maybe he would have by now taken the next step."
Myrr sighed.
"It is all in the past now, Prime. The past is the past. All we can do now is move forward and hope that one day, what Kevin couldn’t accomplish will be accomplished by Kent Madson.
Gaining recognition from the Pill Dao this early only shows that he is destined for great things. So for now, let’s allow the Midnight Shadows to protect him.
One day, we will meet him and see if he can carry the task we failed at."

Prime nodded and looked out the window. "Though we have to make contact with him somehow in the next 100 years. I can sense something terrible coming, something that would take the Immortal World by storm, so we should get to him and protect him from that."
Myrr looked at Prime for a few minutes, then smiled. "I guess you never change, huh. Since when did you resume divination again?"

Prime smiled. "Ten thousand years ago, when I sensed two immortals with a much deeper connection to fate. If I were to get my hands on them, then hopefully one day, the Universe Fate Eye, or should I say Eyes, will be opened again. Their destiny is much bigger than even mine."
Myrr stood up. "I am leaving. An old friend of mine needed help, so I will be away for a few decades. Don’t call for me..."
She flashed a smile and then turned into countless golden leaves. Soon, they drifted away.
Prime was left alone to reflect.

chapters.title: Chapter 1414: Cashing In a Favour
paragraphs: [Planet Zakani]
Planet Zakani is one of the seven Supreme Worlds owned by the Midnight Shadows. It is one of the most protected Supreme Worlds in the universe, primarily because of who lives on it.
Many years ago, long before the Faceless Assassin witnessed his battle with the Mountain Wardog and later recruited him to become the first Midnight Shadow, he was known as Titus Elorm.
Now, he is known as Crimson Dagger.

He is a Shadow Supreme who is not far from becoming a Shadow Celestial. Five million years ago, he killed 10 Celestials in one night when a Calamity Gate opened all of a sudden and Calamity Beasts poured out.
Since that night, nobody who values their life has dared to mess with him. Not even the Soul Temple dares step on his bad side.
So with him guarding a planet, nobody with enough brain cells will dare break in.
However, Pill Celestial Vaelith Moonshade entered such a planet as if she owned it. In fact, when she arrived, nobody aside from Crimson Dagger noticed her presence.
"You do know it is impolite to break into someone’s home like you own the place," Crimson Dagger spoke, his body materializing from a shadow nearby.
Pill Celestial Vaelith Moonshade smirked and sat on a chair under a tree like she was mundane. In natural senses, she is someone who sits at the peak of the universe, yet here she sat looking normal.
Crimson Dagger shook his head and sat in the opposite chair. He looks human, but with deep-set eyes, slightly long ears, and short, dark hair.
"What do you want, Vaelith? And before you start talking too much, know I am on my way somewhere before you came."
Vaelith smirked. "What’s with the attitude, Titus? Can’t you give a small part of your time to a lady in need?"
"You are a Celestial, Vaelith. You are basically beyond my help and attention, so why don’t you cut to the chase and tell me why you are here?"
"Honestly, when that Faceless Guy recruited you, didn’t he teach you how to show compassion?" Vaelith gave another smirk before she got down to business.
"Have you heard of the name Kent Madson?"

Titus furrowed his brow. "Can’t say I haven’t heard of him before. After all, everyone is after him, the last I checked." He paused and gave Vaelith a suspicious look. "Don’t tell me you also want to look for that kid?"
"As a matter of fact, I want him found. After all, his name had just appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet."
"Again?" Titus was left dumbfounded. The last he heard about Kent was when his name appeared on the Ice Dao Tablet. And that was just a few months ago.
How then did he manage to register his name on yet another Dao Tablet?
"Trust me, I was equally shocked when I saw his name. However, that is beside the point. He has already become famous, so I’m coming here today to cash in the favour you owe me."
Titus nodded. "Go ahead."
"I want you to find Kent Madson and protect him using the Midnight Shadows. He must be protected till he reaches the Immortal World, and under our protection."

"Hmm, that is a tough ask, Vaelith. The kid I last checked had only been seen a few times, but he vanished before anyone could get close to him. It is like he has his own private world he vanishes into."
"Oh come on, Titus, I know what you and the Midnight Shadows are capable of, so don’t for one thing think I would believe anything you say."
Titus smirked. "Believe what you want, Vaelith. I have already told you what I know; the rest will depend on what you choose to believe."
Vaelith looked at Titus for a few seconds before she sighed, "I know he is in the High Worlds, so keep an eye out for him, and when he finds himself in danger, he can’t wiggle his way out, aid him."
"That I can do. Also, if I find out something more, I will let you know."
Vaelith nodded, and then she stood up. The next second, she turned into a star in the sky and was soon gone from Planet Zakani.
After making sure she was gone, Titus sighed, "What a headache."
He walked back inside and made his way underground, where a green portal, protected by a rather complex array, shimmered.
Standing before the portal was none other than Thousand Blade, the same Shadow Immortal who placed the formation on the Void Forest.

When he left Planet Bayla a while back, he came straight here to report on the Faceless Assassin’s return. Titus was supposed to leave with him back to Planet Bayla, but before they could leave, Vaelith arrived.
Now that she is gone, they can finally leave. If indeed Faceless is back, then he must as well want to see him with his own two eyes...
"Let’s depart."
Titus said, and Thousand Blade nodded. He stepped into the portal, and soon he was gone. Titus also stepped inside, and soon he was gone. A few seconds later, the portal closed.
They first have to travel to the God World, then to the Immortal World, before finally arriving on Planet Bayla.

It would take them about a month to get there since the travel between planets is a bit technical. Also, Titus is a Supreme, so moving that far, even if his intentions aren’t bad, would still need to be done slowly in order not to break the planet they are traveling to.
Meanwhile, all over the universe, every last Alchemist who had heard what Kent had achieved started scrambling yet again to find him.
It is a known fact that the universe hangs by a thread and that only the best would have a shot at surviving when it all comes crashing down.
Kent had proven to be among the best when his name appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet and the Ice Dao Tablet. Those were acceptable parameters.
Many even said he must be an Ice Human to gain the recognition of the Ice Dao. However, when his name appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet, the narrative changed.

Some say he has an ancient master whose knowledge in Alchemy is unmatched. In a way, they were right; Kent does have an ancient master. It is just that his master happened to be himself from the past.
But even if he has a master’s, the recognition came from his own efforts.
Some also say he had inherited the legacy of an ancient master. Yet again, they are right. Kent indeed has memories from his past life, which, in a way, have given him an edge over many.
But yet again, he gained this recognition through his own effort. He took advantage of what he had and, using his own thinking, made it something that caught the attention of the Pill Dao.
But people don’t know that, so they all want to find Kent and make sure he shares what he knows. Yes, people are that shameless. They behave as if everything should be theirs.
But the only downside was that they had no idea where Kent was. Nobody does, and so all their intentions for now will remain in their heads until they find him.
Of course, they would learn the hard way once they find him and decide to show their true colors.

Kent indeed has memories from his past life, which, in a way, have given him an edge over many.
But yet again, he gained this recognition through his own effort.
He took advantage of what he had and, using his own thinking, made it something that caught the attention of the Pill Dao.
But people don’t know that, so they all want to find Kent and make sure he shares what he knows.
Yes, people are that shameless.
They behave as if everything should be theirs.
But the only downside was that they had no idea where Kent was.
Nobody does, and so all their intentions for now will remain in their heads until they find him.
Of course, they would learn the hard way once they find him and decide to show their true colors.

chapters.title: Chapter 1415: Pill Immortal Flura’s Determination
paragraphs: [Planet Qilin - Everlasting Pill Mountain - Pill Immortal Flura’s POV]
Pill Immortal Flura had done many amazing things in the past few years, and even in the past few months alone.
She went from concocting a Tier 21 intelligent Pill with two violet pill rings to refining the same pill but with three violet pill rings and a single azure pill ring.
This achievement had pushed her closer to the stage where she could start to concoct Tier 22 pills.
She had been having a good streak the past few years, thanks to the knowledge she had acquired years ago when the Pill Ascension Realm opened.
This was why whenever she achieved something great, the thought of how much Kent had helped her always came to mind.
He had helped him greatly, and for that, she is eternally grateful.
However, she wasn’t prepared for the news that came when she was just about to attempt to concoct the pill of her dreams.
This morning, she woke up with big dreams of finally being ready to concoct the Life Ascendence Pill.
It is a pill said to have the power to extend the life of anyone, even a mortal. It was said to even have the power to bring someone back from the brink of death.
However, before she even began to prepare for the concoction, the news of Kent’s name appearing on the Pill Dao Tablet arrived, and she just couldn’t keep calm.
She experienced different types and stages of shock.

The first shock was how much she had missed Kent. It has been over 300,000 years since they parted ways. While it may look like she is an immortal and can live for millions of years, 300,000 years is such a long time for them to be apart, especially when she has feelings for him.
So hearing Kent’s name again made her happy and shocked at the same time.
The second came in the form of Kent revealing his brilliance in the path of Alchemy, yet again.
When they met back at the Pill World, she saw firsthand what Kent was capable of. He defeated her quite easily, and that was just too shocking and eye-opening for her.
So the past 300,000 years had been her waiting for when Kent would make his debut in the world of Alchemy.
Of course, about a year ago, when he resurfaced, he was a swordsman. That revealed soured her mood and made her a bit disappointed.
She expected Kent to become famous through Alchemy.
Today, the pride she felt when she witnessed Kent’s firm belief as an Alchemist was ignited, and that just made her even happier.
But the main shock came from what Kent had achieved. Many years ago, when she was a Pill Monarch, she tried what Kent had just accomplished, but she failed just like the many who came before her.
She had the zeal, but she lacked the determination to achieve that. Now, Kent had achieved it, and that just left her world spinning for a moment.
Suddenly, the pill she was about to concoct became a secondary thing to her. Kent’s coming into her life again, even if only through his achievement, had left her wondering if she had done enough.
Ursa, the Phoenix that Kent had given her for protection, remained by her side all day, making sure she was alright.
After all, Flura had always admired Kent and had been working very hard for the past thousands of years, mainly to win against him when they met again.
However, if Kent had already gained the recognition of the Pill Dao, then what kind of monster would he become when he finally reached the rank of a Pill Immortal?
"Little sister, you are not actually letting this shake your resolve, are you?" Ursa asked, holding her hand.

Flura sat there for a few seconds, then she shook her head and smiled. "I am fine, Ursa. You have nothing to worry about. It was just that I never expected him to make such a comeback, not when he had been absent from my life for all these years."
"I know that, sister. However, I think we both know how much you admire him. You are a Pill Immortal, but every last second, you work hard simply to impress him when you meet again.
So there is bound to be some form of emotion hidden beneath. I am afraid that if you don’t address that, there is a chance it might affect you negatively."
"You worry too much, Ursa. I was worried he had given up the path of Alchemy when his name appeared on the Sword Dao Tablet.
However, now that he has made his debut, I have to be ready for him. There is no telling what kind of surprise he has for us next, so I have to be ready for him."
She stood up and started walking toward the Pill House. Although her name had not yet appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet, she was determined nonetheless.
Soon, she would look for ways to impress the Pill Dao.
For today, she wants to cement her stance as a Pill Immortal proficient in the art of making perfect Tier 21 pills.
The target is a Tier 21 Life Ascendence Pill with three Violet Pill Rings. If possible, she would add two Azure Pill Rings and one Grey Pill Ring.

If she can accomplish that, it would raise the potency of the Pill from the initial 100% by 53 times. That would, without a doubt, put her name on top of the list of Pill Immortals to have recorded such high potency.
Watching her leave, Ursa smiled and shook her head. "I have already done my best; the next will depend on how much you really want to defeat him."
She let out a deep sigh and muttered, "Of course, if possible, I should meet Lord Kent first and make sure he loses when you two meet next."
Pill Immortal Flura entered the Pill House with great determination and started working on the pill. Such a pill would take over two weeks to make.

It requires 24 major and 12 minor ingredients. She would have to take her time and work diligently to make sure she made no mistakes. After all, it took her 30 years to gather the ingredients. If she were to make a single mistake, there would be no do-overs.

However, the meticulousness she had to put into the concoction process would pay off. After two and a half weeks, she would walk out of the pill room with a perfect Tier 21 Life Ascendence Pill with 3 violet, 2 azure, and 2 grey pill rings.
This achievement would catch the attention of millions, for whenever a Life Ascendence Pill is made, the response is always fierce.
Everyone wants their hands on it, and so for the next couple of months, she would have a whole lot of drama to navigate.
This would trigger the Pill God to make his move even more fiercely now. However, with the secret helper that neither Flura nor Ursa is aware of, she would be protected.
Soon, the one she seeks to defeat will arrive, and whether she has what it takes to win against him will be determined by how much she has grown while they were apart.
Meanwhile, after spending three months in enlightenment, Kent finally opened his eyes, a smile playing on his lips.

He had become a Pill Monarch, and on top of that, he had received a special gift from the Pill Dao. All this, combined with the fact that he had finally received the first set of memories of his life as Pill Celestial Kevin Sage, added to his joy.

chapters.title: Chapter 1416: Pill Monarch
paragraphs: Kent had finally become a Pill Monarch, where he would be required to master the concoction of Tier 13 and 14 pills.
This stage is the final barrier that separates mundane pills from Divine pills.

Starting from Tier 15, the Pill Dao would judge every pill made and determine if its quality is worthy to be considered a pill. So, to all alchemists, their chance to call themselves that name ends at Tier 14.
Many see the next path as risky and dangerous. Judging a pill comes with a tribulation, so even as an alchemist, one is required to have the means to withstand it.
It is also the stage where one determines a secondary path to walk so they can handle the tribulations.
Kent had no problem with that. However, he had only become a Pill Monarch, so he had to go through the process again.
He had received the Pill Monarch knowledge as usual.

The enlightenment had opened his mind and eyes to quite a lot. Aside from creating a unique method for achieving perfect extraction, the enlightenment had given him a path to tread that would one day enable him to make this method a technique worthy of recognition.
For now, it was merely him jumping from one technique to another, making sure that with every change, a new method was added.
It may sound like he had created a new technique. However, the truth is, he had only copied what already existed and made it into something worth what he was after.

He would have to make it his own later, the moment he finds a way to ensure the method was not merely him jumping from one technique to the next, but actually one that automatically adapts to every change.
It may sound simple. However, when put into focus, there is more to it than a normal person could see. Kent spent a whole month comprehending the path, and now that he was out, he would handle that.
Aside from that, the Pill Dao gave him a unique gift that allowed him to view the Pill Dao Mission Board, which only a few were allowed to see.

It turns out all the Daos in existence have missions for those they deem worthy. Many years ago, a mission was given to Pill Celestial Kevin Sage, a mission that opened the first path to what many consider the next stage of alchemy.
A stage above the Celestial stage.
This time, he was allowed access. However, before he could view such a mission board, he had to reach the Pill Legend stage.
He was still too weak to see something like that. However, even if he could view it now, having no idea what he had to do was better than knowing and having no means to accomplish it.
However, away from the progress he had made, when he opened his eyes, memories of his life as Kevin Sage flooded his mind.
It was memories of his childhood up to the point he started walking the path of alchemy.
It turned out he was born as a half-elf. His mother was an Elf, and his father was a human. Naturally, he was rejected by his mother’s side, so he lived with his father.
His father, however, was a con artist. He was someone who had mastered the craft of using his cleverness to deceive even a king.
It can be said that his father was a very brilliant person, and Kevin liked him more than anything. Getting rejected by his mother swayed his emotions, making him see his father as his hero.
And thanks to genetics, he also took after his father’s cleverness. Long before he reached the age to start cultivating, he and his father had run many cons, some even involving bandits and demons.
His greatest grift was when he and his father, in a bid to pay back the Elves for rejecting him, decided to steal a precious artifact from the Mother Tree.
They succeeded, but after that day, everything changed.
The Elves cast a curse on the thief, and it affected his father. It took just a few days for his father to die, despite his trying his best to cure him.
He even asked for help from the Elves after he returned the stolen item, but they did not bat an eye. So he watched his father die, and that was when he swore to avenge him.
This meant he had to become a cultivator, and a powerful one. And to achieve that, it meant he had to join a sect.

However, as the son of an infamous con artist, no sect was willing to accept him. Nobody wanted to associate themselves with him, not when the youngest heir of the Elves made it his mission to destroy him.
For a couple of years, he had no help and faced many roadblocks, until one day he met an unlikely master who was the reason he began walking the path of alchemy.
This man was once praised as a genius. However, because of a single mistake, the entire world became his enemy. He was cast out and riddled with many bad names.
However, when he met Kevin, the look of ridicule that many had given him wasn’t seen in Kevin’s eyes. This made him like his character instantly.
So he took him in after learning of his worries and decided to pass down his knowledge. It wasn’t the path Kevin wanted, but he knew it was a start.

In just a few months, Kevin learned all the basics and even managed to finally step onto the path of alchemy. The memory ended at the part where he concocted his first pill, which, to his shock and his master’s, came out as a 95% pure pill.
It was at that moment that he discovered he was born to become an alchemist. But while he was thinking that way, his master also realized his chance for a comeback had arrived.

Kevin was the key to everything, and so he made him a proposal. If Kevin could become a Pill Saint in two years, he would give him all he had acquired over the years, and in return, he would help him get revenge.
The revenge, in a twist of fate and destiny, was on the same person. Kevin wanted the Elves to feel his pain, and so did his master, who lost everything because of the Elves.
Kent took a deep sigh and laughed. "I can’t believe I was a con artist back in the day."
He shook his head, the look of amusement appearing on his face. So far, his past had been dark from the start. Chaos had no parents. Jest was born a slave whose mother died the same day he was born.
Faceless also lost his mother in an attempt to protect him. And finally, the Ruthless Bandit had to kill his own family as a way to free them from their suffering.
However, here comes Kevin, whose father was a con artist, so he chose to be one too. That just left Kent stunned and unsure of what to even think about.
Although his mother rejected him and his father later died, he can be said to have had the best childhood yet. His father was a con artist, but he loved him with all his heart.
So his death triggered him to become somebody. That path was what he started walking again, only this time, instead of killing Elves, he was doing it to kill a god.

chapters.title: Chapter 1417: Requirements
paragraphs: "Now I am intrigued. I need to know more of Kevin’s life," Kent muttered, a smile tugging at the corner of his lips.
It wasn’t often he recalled his past and came back with amusement. He most certainly didn’t expect Kevin Sage’s past to be this colourful and full of mischief.
Now that he had seen how that life began, he would most certainly love to see how it ended. However, he had no memory key for that yet, so all he could do was focus on the next item on his schedule.
Once a memory key appears, he would get down to it.
He shifted his attention to the requirements he had to complete if he wanted to become a Pill Sovereign.
⟦Requirement to become a Pill Sovereign⟧
↠ Concoct a Tier 13 pill with an Azure pill ring
↠ Concoct a Tier 14 pill with an Azure pill ring
↠ Concoct a Tier 13 pill with Two Azure Pill Rings and a Grey Pill Ring
↠ Concoct a Tier 15 pill
This time, there are four requirements he must fulfill compared to the previous ones. It can be said that this is a much steeper step he must take.
Of course, he already had plans to master the concoction of Tier 13 and 14 pills. However, Tier 15 isn’t something he prepared for just yet.
The requirements said nothing about whether or not he should concoct a perfect Tier 15 pill with pill rings, so he could concoct any purity level and be done with it.
However, the chance of the Pill Dao approving such a pill is very low. There is just no way the Pill Dao would allow him to pass the requirement with an impure pill.
This means he must exceed all expectations. He could get the recipe and ingredients, but it would take him another level of genius to be able to come up with a pill that the Pill Dao would approve.
Tier 15 is out of his level, and he knew that.
"There is always a catch to everything, so I can only work hard and come out with a perfect pill," Kent smirked and stood up.
"Tower, any updates?"
[Yes, Master. While you were away, a lot actually happened that I am sure you are going to love to hear.]
"Oh really?"
[Yes, Master.]
Kent grinned and purchased a bucket of popcorn from the Tower store. "Take me through everything, Tower."
Three hours later, Kent was left with his jaw hanging.
"I knew someone was plotting evil against me. But who would have thought my own wives were the ones who did the plotting?"
[It was the only way they could save Goddess Vexthra’s sister without causing a war between the Dark Elves, the Storm Humans, and the Red Foxes.]

"I guess that was brilliant thinking. With how famous I have become, my name would indeed carry all suspicions away. However, who knows what kind of evil these Dark Elves are planning for my head by now?"

Kent smirked. "There is even a good chance they have already cursed me thousands of times, knowing the kind of people they are. Maybe I should take Axiom and the others and eradicate them from the face of the universe just to be safe."
[That would be ideal. But the Master has some missions lined up. The first being your meeting with the Midnight Shadows. Afterwards, you are to head to Planet Brymrr to go see that lady.
Gaia and her sisters are making progress much faster than initially expected. They are on track to finish the portal in less than two years, so you don’t have much time.]
Kent nodded, but he said nothing. He knew rescuing Safira was a must. She is the only solution to his growing heart demon. This means she needed that hateful lady’s help.
However, going to see that lady is not something he can take lightly. There is just no easy way to handle it.
"What are the girls doing right now?"
[They are waiting for Lady Yi Lai to finish her Dragon summoning ritual, then they will head to the 9th floor.]
"Good. I will join them on the next mission. Once that is handled, I will head back to Planet Bayla to meet with the Midnight Shadows. The rest will be handled after that."
After relaxing for a day, he started over again.
He first had to update the pill recipes he had received with what he has now. This way, he would know the changes that occurred and what had to be done to fix them.
It took an entire day to do just that. Afterwards, he started working on Tier 13 pills.

Meanwhile, inside the Legion Tower, everyone was waiting diligently for the last portal to close. Already, four of the five True Immortals Yi Lai had sent into the dragon trial returned as full-fledged undead dragons.
The past few weeks inside the tower had been one shock after another.
The first shock came when Elaine summoned three Death Agents, each at the peak of the True Immortal stage. They each had five Immortal Qi and powerful bloodlines.
It was after this summoning ritual that the girls realised that the grave inside her Life and Death Space holds so much terror than what she could describe.
Even Vexthra was shocked when the summoning ritual ended, and three terrifying beings walked out from their graves.

It was something none of them saw coming. She is now extremely powerful since her Primordial Spirit can aid her in combat.
Aside from her, Veera had also created her five undead, each coming out as a True Immortal. The limit of the high world didn’t affect them. They all came out powerful, as one would expect.
Then came Yi Lai, who also received four True Immortal undead dragons. The outcome was in their favor, and thus far, only one dragon was left to come out.
"Maybe he is dead," Kaizo muttered, already bored. He wanted to have a duel with Elaine’s Death Agents or Veera’s undead, but Vexthra said no.
She knew just how persistent he could be, so she prevented him from having some fun. This soured his mood, so he was already pissed.

The only chance he would get to fight is when they enter the dungeon. However, they had been stuck inside the tower for weeks now, all because one of Yi Lai’s potential undead dragons had yet to come out of the trial.
Everyone ignored his comment.

Since the portal was still active, he must still be alive. It was just that he had not yet finished his trial, and so, for as long as he remained inside, there was a good chance he was facing a much more dangerous challenge.
Thankfully, four days later, the portal shimmered, and a handsome dragon with pure white hair walked out, exuding the power of an Immortal King.
That was a bit over the top, but watching him walk out made everyone sigh in relief. He had become even more powerful than he was when he was still a Dark Elf.
The others emerged as True Immortals, but he returned as an Immortal King, terrifying at that.
"Finally," Kaizo muttered, jumping down from the tree he was sleeping in.
"Let’s gather around. Once we enter the dungeon, we won’t be coming out until we reach the 15th Floor."

chapters.title: Chapter 1418: The Ninth Floor - The Damned Prison (1)
paragraphs: Kaizo was the first to get in line.
He was bored beyond measure, so hearing Vexthra’s words, he jumped down and rushed to the front. The others quickly gathered around to listen to what Vexthra had to say.

"I have reasons to believe that from the 9th floor upwards, we will start meeting Immortals that can threaten some of us. Of course, considering we have demigods and gods among us, we can somehow ignore this threat.
However, the mission details are always strict on the strength level required for each mission. So, despite having the strength, we will be limited to only a small part of what we can utilise.
This means you all should be careful. The dungeon is a dangerous place, and so, regardless of what you think, when it comes to immortals, anything is possible."
They nodded.

"In that case, let’s go. We have floors to clear and rewards to claim." She opened the portal, and they started entering. Just when Miryssa entered, and Vexthra was also about to enter, Kent appeared in the Legion Tower.
"I will tag along for this one. Afterwards, I will leave to handle other things."
She nodded with a smile, already happy that Kent had decided to join them. They knew he had been busy the past couple of months, so they left him undisturbed.
However, since he had decided to join them, allowing him to wasn’t too bad.
They entered the portal together, and it closed behind them.
[Planet Kenai]

"Hmmm," Kent hummed, his expression calm, though the look of intrigue appeared in his eyes. He appeared in a rather thick forest, one in which he could sense thousands of powerful creatures locking onto his location.
He appeared alone despite entering the portal at the same time as Vexthra.
This meant Vexthra may have also appeared somewhere completely different, which, in a way, meant the others may be in similar situations.
There was no mission description.
However, Kent wasn’t afraid. He had something way better.

He activated the soul map, and at once, a large part of the forest came within his sensing range. His brow raised slightly, seeing the thousands of beasts, some already at the True Immortal stage, moving toward him.
He wanted to see if he would find any of his wives or legion within an 80,000 km radius. However, all he saw was danger.
He also could not reach the tower, his legion, or his wives.
"I guess I have to fight my way out then." Gaap appeared in his firm grip, and then he moved, starting a massacre while he waited for the mission description to show.
Meanwhile, far away in a large desert, Vexthra stood, her expression filled with questions. She entered the portal with Kent, but they seemed to have been separated.
Even worse, she had no idea why her strength was suppressed to the True Immortal stage.
She tried to scan her surroundings but found nothing. Also, the mission description hadn’t shown up yet, so she started walking toward the west of her location.
She tried to contact her sisters using the harem connection, but there was no response. It was as if the connection with her sisters and Kent had been severed.

This was the first time something like this had ever happened, so she was a bit in shock while also contemplating why she was suppressed to such a level when she had already risen beyond the rank of a god.
[Dim Cave - Planet Kenai]
Inside a dim cave, hidden somewhere on Planet Kenai, sat a Goblin whose entire body was coated in dark metallic armor.
His chest was slashed open, blood oozing from it. However, he seems to be healing at an unnatural speed, something that is a bit bizarre.
Around him, the aura of blood filled the air. A large, broad sword rested beside his chair, its blade coated in all kinds of blood.
His breathing was ragged, and from the look in his eyes, one could tell he was both furious and afraid.
He remained hidden in the cave, his attention sharp, almost as if he was on the lookout for something or someone.
400 km away, Unity stood on the surface of a large flat stone, her bow firmly gripped in her arms. Just as Kent and Vexthra did, she also tried to contact her sisters, but none responded.
She immediately realized she was on her own, so she quickly reached out to her Primordial Spirits, making them aware of the situation and how best they could help.
In another part, too, Lilian appeared on a fresh battlefield, where the smell of blood hung in the air. The remains of thousands of beasts and humanoids with beastly body parts littered the ground.
Neomi also appeared on a small island, one where she could see a vast expanse of water spanning several thousand miles.

She scanned the island but found no one, not even her sisters. She tried contacting them, but nothing happened. So she found a good spot, sat down, and began meditating. In her mind, until the mission details appeared, she would make no move.
Thankfully, an hour later, the mission description appeared.
⟦Name: Planet Killer Dungeon⟧
⟦Floor Name: The Damned Prison (9th)⟧
⟦Power Level: Immortal Emperor⟧
⟦Description:⟧
↠ Planet Kenai was once a vibrant planet full of people. There was love, peace, joy, and happiness at every corner. There were smiles on every face and hope in all hearts.
↠ However, it all came crashing down when the seven Calamities appeared with their horror and curse. Overnight, Planet Kenai became a haunted planet, one where no one would dare set foot.
↠ When it was discovered that the once vibrant planet had now become hell, those with power saw an opportunity to take advantage of it. And so, the Damned Prison was built.
↠ The entire planet was converted into a prison where the vile and twisted criminals are sent to spend the rest of their days.
↠ Those with the will to live survived. Those who lost hope died in the most gruesome way possible.

↠ Twenty years ago, it was revealed that Planet Kenai was about to enter its first evolution phase, where once it is done, it would become a gateway for the Calamity Beasts to find their way back to the known universe.
↠ Once that happens, many worlds will be in danger.
⟦Your mission is to locate the seven Calamity Beasts and kill them. Note that the kill missions will be assigned at random and must be completed by the person assigned to them.
Also, there will be special rewards for everyone assigned a mission. Lastly, this is a criminally infested planet. Assume there is danger in every corner.⟧
⟦Rewards⟧
↠ 70 Billion Tower Points
↠ 800 Billion Soul Essence
↠ Limit Breaker Key (Everybody)
↠ Innate Talent Awakening Pill
↠ Bloodline Strengthening Elixir
Unity furrowed her brow, reading through the second message only she had received. It turned out she is among the seven who would be facing the seven calamity beasts.
"Looks like I have been assigned a mission."
[Mission Name: Kill the Goblin King]
[Location: 400 km due east]

[Description: The Goblin King is one of the seven Calamity Beasts. He is a Spirit Immortal and uses the Broad Sword. He is proficient in close combat and can harness the elemental power of Earth and Metal.
Treat him with extreme caution because he is dangerous, and he has already sensed your presence.]
Unity sighed, then her gaze turned toward the east. The look of determination appeared in her eyes. "Are you ladies ready?"
"Ready," Blossom replied, her paintbrush and a fresh canvas also ready.
"Let’s go ballistic," Feisty also said. Around her, different types of arrows hovered, ready to be summoned and used against the Goblin King.

chapters.title: Chapter 1419: The Ninth Floor - The Damned Prison (2)
paragraphs: [Neomi’s POV]
Neomi, just like her sisters, found herself alone on an island. However, instead of panicking, she decided to calm her mind by meditating while she waited for the mission description to show.
An hour later, it came, and with it was a special mission assigned to her alone.
"No wonder I appeared here. Looks like I will be going for a swim," she smiled as she read through the details of her special mission.
She is one of the seven.
[Mission Name: Kill Thalassara, The Abyssal Leviathan]
[Cultivation: Spirit Immortal]
[Location: 40 km due west]
[Description: Thalassara dwells in the depths of the Sea. She commands tidal pressure and abyssal currents capable of crushing immortals. No enemy was ever able to escape her wrath.]
Neomi sighed, her expression turning dark. There is nothing about the mission that inspired confidence in her.
The mission is a tough one, and she sees that.
First of all, while she had no problem fighting underwater, the mere fact that her opponent has this much control over the water reeks of danger.
Aside from that, she is also five realms above her. Neomi is a Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator, while her opponent is a Spirit Immortal.
While she had broken over 12 limits already on her body and even awakened some innate abilities, the mere fact that her opponent had entered the Immortal Stage said it all.
There is just no way she can underestimate her. Winning would be extremely hard.
However, she must kill whatever horror is dwelling beneath the sea.
Looking at the spear in her hand, she couldn’t help but smile. "Linsy, are you ready?" she asked, speaking to her spear.
The silhouette of the 6-armed lady, who is her weapon spirit, appeared and nodded. "Ready when you are, my lady."
"In that case, let’s go swimming." Neomi moved, and soon she was underwater, moving toward the Abyssal Leviathan.
It is going to be a harrowing battle for sure, considering her opponent sensed her presence the moment she entered the water.
[Vexthra’s POV]
Vexthra had also been walking in the scorching hot dune for an hour before the mission description appeared.
To her shock, she received a special mission too.

She was already in shock when her cultivation was suppressed to the True Immortal stage. However, seeing that she had received a mission which required her to fight like an ordinary warrior came as a surprise to her.
There is just no way she expected this to happen, not when they are still not in the god realm.
However, while it was unexpected, she couldn’t help feeling happy that she had finally gotten a chance to help her sisters and friends.
She had watched her sisters fight on the last eight floors. All she did was stand and watch. However, now, she gets to fight, too.
[Mission Name: Kill Dune Revenant, The Sand Tyrant]
[Rank: Immortal Emperor]
[Location: 800 km due west]
[Description: He is the king of the desert, holding supreme command over the sand. Once a soul wanders into his domain, the only thing that remains is their bones.]
"Two realms above me, huh?" Vexthra smiled and continued on her way. She was already heading west long before the mission arrived.
She, just like Unity, also uses the bow.
However, she is also proficient in Array combat, so seeing that she was already fiddling with her rune knife, there is a big chance she will be using arrays and formations for the battle.
[Lilian’s POV]
Lilian stood on the blood-soaked battlefield, reading through her special mission. She is also among the seven who have received special missions.
[Mission Name: Kill the Bloodhowl Devourer]
[Rank: Spirit Immortal Peak]
[Location: 30 km due east]
[Description: The more blood he devours, the stronger he becomes. For any cut he inflicts, there is thrice the pain.]
"Hmm. This is going to be a crazy one," she sighed and then started moving just like what Unity and the others did. The mission is simple: the target they were assigned must die.
That is the only way they can leave this place. Until all seven calamity beasts die, none would be able to leave.
Their connection to the tower at the moment had been severed, so they are on their own.
Of course, even if the others were to come to them, the mission stated that they should kill their targets themselves.
So, knowing this, she prepared both mentally and spiritually to end this battle with her life intact.
[Kaizo’s POV]
After he ceremoniously jumped into the portal, he found himself alone atop a mountain. Around him in every direction were giant rocks.
Kaizo became alert and was ready for battle the instant he arrived on this mountain. However, as the minutes went by and no target came to him as they did with Kent, he started to get bored.
He came to fight only to find himself stuck in one place, unable to reach out to his pals or have any opponent to battle.
The least he could do was throw stones off the mountain. Thankfully, that helped him survive long enough for the mission description to appear.
The moment he saw that he had received a special mission, he smiled broadly.
"Finally. I was bored to death," he grinned and opened the description of his special mission.
[Mission Name: Kill the Gravemaw Colossus]
[Rank: True Immortal]
[Location: Below the Mountain]
[Description: Forged from undying stone, his skin is as thick as the strongest metal, and his control over gravity is unmatched.]
"Well, I know only one thing, and that is he will be shattered into chunks of stone soon," Kaizo spoke with confidence and a slight grin.
While Neomi and the others are dreading their opponent, Kaizo seems a bit more excited to be facing someone already at the True Immortal stage.
Kent already knows Kaizo is different compared to the other undead under his command. His bloodline came from an ancient race that lived long before the Primordial Chaos Dragon appeared.
So if there’s anyone he can trust to create miracles, it would be Kaizo. Of course, his opponent is 7 realms above him, but that wouldn’t shake his resolve.
He had been waiting for this moment for a while now.
He activated his wings, allowing all four pairs to spread, their metallic golden color painting the space around him.
"Here I come."
Taking a nosedive, he plunged into the darkness below, heading straight for his opponent.
[Veera’s POV]
Veera, however, found herself in an abandoned city, appearing atop a tall mansion. From the moment she arrived, the feeling of being watched overwhelmed her senses.
However, no matter where she looked, there was nothing in sight that would suggest where the danger was coming from.
So she kept watch, and an hour later, her mission came.
[Mission Name: Kill the Bone Plague Matriarch]
[Rank: Immortal King]
[Location: Center of the Rotting City]
[Description: She commands swarms of insects and spreads necrotic corruption everywhere her insect swarm goes.]

The moment she saw the rank of her opponent and what she was capable of, Veera summoned her five True Immortal Undead. The mission said she must kill her opponent herself. However, since she is a necromancer, she is allowed to use her undead summons.
"We should get this handled quickly." A smile appeared on her face, causing her five Undead to furrow their brows.
"Of course, don’t destroy their bodies. I feel like they would be perfect for what I have planned after this mission."
They nodded and moved away, heading toward the center of the city. Veera stayed back, but she could see everything through the eyes of her Undead.
