However, instead of panicking, she decided to calm her mind by meditating while she waited for the mission description to show.
An hour later, it came, and with it was a special mission assigned to her alone.
"No wonder I appeared here.
Looks like I will be going for a swim," she smiled as she read through the details of her special mission.
She is one of the seven.
[Mission Name: Kill Thalassara, The Abyssal Leviathan]
[Cultivation: Spirit Immortal]
[Location: 40 km due west]
[Description: Thalassara dwells in the depths of the Sea.
She commands tidal pressure and abyssal currents capable of crushing immortals.
No enemy was ever able to escape her wrath.]
Neomi sighed, her expression turning dark.
There is nothing about the mission that inspired confidence in her.
The mission is a tough one, and she sees that.
First of all, while she had no problem fighting underwater, the mere fact that her opponent has this much control over the water reeks of danger.
Aside from that, she is also five realms above her.
Neomi is a Heavenly Ascension stage cultivator, while her opponent is a Spirit Immortal.
While she had broken over 12 limits already on her body and even awakened some innate abilities, the mere fact that her opponent had entered the Immortal Stage said it all.
There is just no way she can underestimate her.
Winning would be extremely hard.
However, she must kill whatever horror is dwelling beneath the sea.
Looking at the spear in her hand, she couldn’t help but smile.
"Linsy, are you ready?" she asked, speaking to her spear.
The silhouette of the 6-armed lady, who is her weapon spirit, appeared and nodded.
"Ready when you are, my lady."
"In that case, let’s go swimming." Neomi moved, and soon she was underwater, moving toward the Abyssal Leviathan.
It is going to be a harrowing battle for sure, considering her opponent sensed her presence the moment she entered the water.
[Vexthra’s POV]
Vexthra had also been walking in the scorching hot dune for an hour before the mission description appeared.
To her shock, she received a special mission too.
She was already in shock when her cultivation was suppressed to the True Immortal stage.
However, seeing that she had received a mission which required her to fight like an ordinary warrior came as a surprise to her.
There is just no way she expected this to happen, not when they are still not in the god realm.
However, while it was unexpected, she couldn’t help feeling happy that she had finally gotten a chance to help her sisters and friends.
She had watched her sisters fight on the last eight floors.
All she did was stand and watch.
However, now, she gets to fight, too.
[Mission Name: Kill Dune Revenant, The Sand Tyrant]
[Rank: Immortal Emperor]
[Location: 800 km due west]
[Description: He is the king of the desert, holding supreme command over the sand.
Once a soul wanders into his domain, the only thing that remains is their bones.]
"Two realms above me, huh?" Vexthra smiled and continued on her way.
She was already heading west long before the mission arrived.
She, just like Unity, also uses the bow.
However, she is also proficient in Array combat, so seeing that she was already fiddling with her rune knife, there is a big chance she will be using arrays and formations for the battle.
[Lilian’s POV]
Lilian stood on the blood-soaked battlefield, reading through her special mission.
She is also among the seven who have received special missions.
[Mission Name: Kill the Bloodhowl Devourer]
[Rank: Spirit Immortal Peak]
[Location: 30 km due east]
[Description: The more blood he devours, the stronger he becomes.
For any cut he inflicts, there is thrice the pain.]
"Hmm.
This is going to be a crazy one," she sighed and then started moving just like what Unity and the others did.
The mission is simple: the target they were assigned must die.
That is the only way they can leave this place.
Until all seven calamity beasts die, none would be able to leave.
Their connection to the tower at the moment had been severed, so they are on their own.
Of course, even if the others were to come to them, the mission stated that they should kill their targets themselves.
So, knowing this, she prepared both mentally and spiritually to end this battle with her life intact.
[Kaizo’s POV]
After he ceremoniously jumped into the portal, he found himself alone atop a mountain.
Around him in every direction were giant rocks.
Kaizo became alert and was ready for battle the instant he arrived on this mountain.
However, as the minutes went by and no target came to him as they did with Kent, he started to get bored.
He came to fight only to find himself stuck in one place, unable to reach out to his pals or have any opponent to battle.
The least he could do was throw stones off the mountain.
Thankfully, that helped him survive long enough for the mission description to appear.
The moment he saw that he had received a special mission, he smiled broadly.
"Finally.
I was bored to death," he grinned and opened the description of his special mission.
[Mission Name: Kill the Gravemaw Colossus]
[Rank: True Immortal]
[Location: Below the Mountain]
[Description: Forged from undying stone, his skin is as thick as the strongest metal, and his control over gravity is unmatched.]
"Well, I know only one thing, and that is he will be shattered into chunks of stone soon," Kaizo spoke with confidence and a slight grin.
While Neomi and the others are dreading their opponent, Kaizo seems a bit more excited to be facing someone already at the True Immortal stage.
Kent already knows Kaizo is different compared to the other undead under his command.
His bloodline came from an ancient race that lived long before the Primordial Chaos Dragon appeared.
So if there’s anyone he can trust to create miracles, it would be Kaizo.
Of course, his opponent is 7 realms above him, but that wouldn’t shake his resolve.
He had been waiting for this moment for a while now.
He activated his wings, allowing all four pairs to spread, their metallic golden color painting the space around him.
"Here I come."
Taking a nosedive, he plunged into the darkness below, heading straight for his opponent.
[Veera’s POV]
Veera, however, found herself in an abandoned city, appearing atop a tall mansion.
From the moment she arrived, the feeling of being watched overwhelmed her senses.
However, no matter where she looked, there was nothing in sight that would suggest where the danger was coming from.
So she kept watch, and an hour later, her mission came.
[Mission Name: Kill the Bone Plague Matriarch]
[Rank: Immortal King]
[Location: Center of the Rotting City]
[Description: She commands swarms of insects and spreads necrotic corruption everywhere her insect swarm goes.]
The moment she saw the rank of her opponent and what she was capable of, Veera summoned her five True Immortal Undead.
The mission said she must kill her opponent herself.
However, since she is a necromancer, she is allowed to use her undead summons.
"We should get this handled quickly." A smile appeared on her face, causing her five Undead to furrow their brows.
"Of course, don’t destroy their bodies.
I feel like they would be perfect for what I have planned after this mission."
They nodded and moved away, heading toward the center of the city.
Veera stayed back, but she could see everything through the eyes of her Undead.

chapters.title: Chapter 1420: The Ninth Floor - The Damned Prison (3)
paragraphs: [Kent’s POV]
Kent stood on a mountain of bodies that he had built from the complete massacre he had committed inside the forest he appeared in.
He was unfortunate or, in this context, fortunate to appear in such a place. He had the perfect welcome, which he took advantage of in its entirety.
When the creatures attacked, he responded like a warrior.
It was a good warm-up after spending weeks concocting pills. In all, it took him about 45 minutes to slaughter every last one of them.
Of course, some ran off when they saw their opponent was abnormally strong. However, after the massacre, Kent was elated when he saw the mission description appear.
Even better, he received a special mission.

However, when he saw the rank of his opponent, he became stunned. While he managed to read between the lines and realize why this mission was given as their task to clear the 9th floor, he wasn’t prepared to face an Immortal Emperor, not when he had yet to form his sword realm.
The mission was given to them because the seven calamity beasts aren’t fully awakened yet. In fact, the first six are all normal beasts, so the danger they were meant to have isn’t there.
If the planet evolves and they are still alive, they would awaken their true selves. Once that happens, they will be able to open the Calamity Gate, allowing their kin to invade this universe again.
So they all must die.
However, Kent had no plans to fight a Peak Immortal Emperor when he decided to join this mission.
While his opponent was no Spatial Beast like the ones that he would soon be facing once Gaia is done with the portal, this one is a partially awakened calamity beast.
This means it is a danger to him, and Kent knew it deep down.
[Mission Name: Noctyrr, The World Shackle]
[Rank: Immortal Emperor Peak]
[Location: 400,000 km due south]
[Description: The only Calamity to have partially awakened his true nature. Be careful when facing him in combat; his curses aren’t something to joke around with.]
Compared to spatial beasts, these ones are children.
But Kent is also a child. He may have combat power comparable to a True Immortal. However, that doesn’t mean he can battle just anyone above the True Immortal stage.
Even he has his limits.
"I guess now might just be the best time to test how fast I can fly using the Jade Void Wings." He smiled and started moving toward the direction of his target using the soul map.
With the distance he can move using the soul map, he quickly closes in on the 400,000km distance.
It took him just 5 teleportations to sense his opponent. He came to a stop to have a better look at who he would be fighting.

"Looks like you have been waiting for me," Kent said, stopping before a vast field filled with dried grasses. 400 meters away stood a 3-meter-tall humanoid. He was clad in leather armor lined with chains, which hung loosely at his side.
He held a spear in his right hand while a circular disc hovered in his left hand.

"I saw you slaughter all the beasts in the Evermore Forest, so I got curious. Who would have thought you would be coming to me of your own accord?" His tone was human and a bit deep; however, it was within human standards.
"So were you initially planning on coming after me?" Kent asked.
"You are here now, so that isn’t important."

"I see. In any case, I didn’t come of my own accord. I came because I was asked to kill you. So in order to make things simple and easy for both of us, why don’t you drop dead where you stand?" A teasing smile appeared on Kent’s face.

He could tell he was about to face the biggest obstacle he had faced so far in his journey as a warrior. Why that is a bit scary, he wasn’t even a bit scared. If anything, he was more pumped for the battle ahead of him.
"Can I call you Noctyrr?" Kent asked again; however, the response was a sudden stab toward his chest.
The speed at which the attack came was so fast that just when he saw it, its deadly blades were only an inch away from his skin.
Kent summoned the scale shield, merging it with his skin.
CLANG

The spear bounced off his chest, sending him flying back. While his scales saved him from being impaled through the chest, the force contained within the spear was too powerful, and he was sent flying back like a rag doll.
"Oh shit."
While in motion, Noctyrr moved and appeared behind him, attacking again. Kent used the same method to block the second attack, too.
However, he clearly didn’t account for the force Noctyrr used in his second attack. He was already in motion, meaning the initial force was still acting on his body.

So the moment a second force acted against him, per the law of motion, there would be a collision of forces. This collision sandwiched Kent. Both forces crashed into his body, causing him to cough up a few mouthfuls of blood.
Some bones cracked, and some rattled.
"Fuck...this bastard is Newton’s reincarnation."
Seeing and feeling how brilliantly Noctyrr used his mind to overwhelm him with his two attacks, Kent changed his initial assessment of his opponent.
"Time to make a run for it."
BUZZ
His Jade Void Wings appeared, and with a buzzing sound, he moved, and Noctyrr took after him.
He threw the circular disc he held in his left hand into the air, transforming it into ten colossal razor-sharp discs, each deadly to even look at.
They moved ahead of him, chasing after Kent, who had activated all 120,000 flame veins. His speed was just too great that in a span of five seconds, he had moved over 100,000 km.
There is just no way he can face him in close combat. The bastard is superfast, and with how brilliantly he had executed his opening moves, Kent knew he had to kill him while on the move.
The ten colossal razor-sharp discs sliced through the air with terrifying precision, trailing faint arcs of dark energy as they pursued Kent.

Each one spun faster than the eye could follow, their edges glinting with deadly intent. Kent was moving rather fast, but the more distance he put between them, the closer the Razor Discs came in on him.
"I am going to enjoy having this treasure after I kill you," Kent said out loud, the wind carrying his words into Noctyrr’s ear.
This caused him to move even faster. However, Kent kept putting distance between them. The [Void Drive] technique was keeping him afloat, so for now, he was out of arm’s reach.
But how long could he keep away from the deadly discs or Noctyrr?
The answer came much faster than he would have loved.
Kent suddenly twisted sharply left, then right, then dove low enough that the dried grasses below whipped against his boots.
Just then, the first disc came close to him and attacked. However, it missed by centimeters, carving a trench fifty meters long into the earth before curving back toward him.
Kent used the soul map to move, evading the attack completely.
The second and third came in right after the first, one high, one low.

Kent rolled sideways in midair, the high disc shearing off several strands of his hair while the low one grazed his calf, drawing a thin line of blood that immediately healed thanks to how monstrous his healing had become recently.
"Oh Damn...I am fucked"

chapters.title: Chapter 1421: The Ninth Floor - The Damned Prison (4)
paragraphs: Kent glanced back, hoping to find something useful that he could use against the bastard.
However, all he saw was Noctyrr, still pursuing, spear held casually at his side, expression calm as if this were a leisurely jog rather than a life-or-death chase at supersonic speeds.
He wasn’t taking the battle as seriously as Kent was. That, in a way, was a clear indication that he saw Kent as no threat.
Considering he is a peak Immortal Emperor, he has the right to appear nonchalant. He is several realms above his opponent after all.
Kent’s mind raced, running multiple calculations to determine the best course of action. He can’t just take any path without weighing all options.
In the end, he realised that running forever wasn’t an option.
The discs were gaining on him with every curve he made, and Noctyrr himself seemed to be closing the distance without visible effort.
Whatever technique the calamity beast was using to move, it ignored conventional physics. It was as if whenever he curved to the side, Noctyrr got a boost that pulled him closer.
And if he ignored the discs by choosing to keep moving forward in a straight line, losing his limbs and even getting cut in half wouldn’t be far from happening.
’Time to change the game.’
Kent abruptly killed his forward momentum, causing shockwaves to ripple outward. He spun 180 degrees in place, facing his opponent head-on.
The ten discs hurtled toward him like a swarm of guillotines.
Kent opened his palm, causing bone-chilling ice to pour out. He used his finger to draw three runes in the air, then with a sudden clap, the entire surrounding area became frozen.
Every dried grass froze, and then, with a wave, pillars of ice started rising from the ground. The discs suddenly had to curve around the pillars, slowing them down a bit.
It was as if the moment the pillars rose up, Noctyrr’s control over the discs started to wane. However, even if that was the case, the mere fact that they kept moving told him all he had to know.
’He is overexerting his mind to control the discs. This means I have to keep his mind engaged long enough to find the perfect opening.’
With this thought in mind, Kent did the only logical thing he could think of.

He first activated his sword intent, filling the air with its sharpness. Then he retracted his Blood Aura and activated the blood sword aura instead. In an instant, he went from a bloodthirsty maniac to a bloodthirsty swordsman.
The sharpness in the air made it so that movement by his opponent would be restricted to a certain degree.
He decided to fight like a swordsman instead of a Slaughter King.
"Sword Clones,"
In an instant, 9 more copies appeared and made a run for it. Just like that, ten copies of Kent filled the 80,000 km radius, each clad in the same armor and wielding the same sword.
Noctyrr’s eyes narrowed. He tried scanning the ten copies to find the real Kent, but he came up empty.
’How is that possible? They are all the same person.’
His mind started to spin like a turbine, unsure of how to even make sense of what was happening.
Every last version of Kent had the same energy signature, something that shouldn’t have been possible considering clones and the main body should have a different aura.
However, since Kent was only using his sword intent and sword aura, all he could sense was those energies.
That just made no sense, however, as he continued to attack Kent with his discs while he used his numbers to his advantage, Noctyrr started to sense his mind grow more engaged.
That was bad for him but good for Kent.
Kent’s plan was to overwhelm Noctyrr’s mind by using his ten bodies to his advantage. The more divided Noctyrr’s attention becomes, the better for him.
Slowly, he started to see the effect of his attacks. This gave him the confidence to move much closer, closing the gap between them.
If he could get within 10 km of him, there was a good chance he would be able to turn things around.
BUZZ
His Jade Void Wings buzzed as he made a sudden 180-degree turn, evading a disc only for a second one to come. He quickly used the swap function of his sword clone technique to evade.
He swapped with a clone opposite his location. But just when he moved closer to Noctyrr, hoping to activate the [Void Cleave], the air turned quiet.
At once, all sound was sucked out of the air, replaced by an unsettling feeling.
Kent, who was getting ready to retaliate, activated his Blood Seals just in time when a rather heavy feeling fell on him.
All the sword clones he had activated were blasted to smoke along with the ice domain he had created. In an instant, he went from gaining some advantage to being sent crashing to the ground.
The crash created a small crater in the ground, showing he was undead a heavy load.
However, before he could lift himself up, a spear appeared from the ground, stabbing through his side. His [Chaos Scale Shield] saved him, but the force behind the spear cracked a few ribs.
"Oh shit.."
Kent jumped back, attempting to evade the second spear, only to be surrounded by over three dozen spears.
"This Motherfucker can also use the metal element?" The realization left Kent unsure of what to even think. So far, he had noticed three things about his opponent that just didn’t make sense.
First was the cuts he had sustained. They healed, but the pain that came with it seemed to only grow as time passed. It was as if the longer Noctyrr remained breathing, the more severe the pain.
But that wasn’t all, as the pain intensified, his stamina seemed to start to deplete.
That made no sense. Kent has a monstrous healing and regenerative ability, so even if the pain intensifies, that shouldn’t affect his stamina.
But considering the description of the mission said Noctyrr’s curses are dangerous, Kent was inclined to believe he had been cursed, and that was why his stamina was depleting.
The second thing he noticed that he believed would make it impossible to kill Noctyrr without external help was his Immortal Qi. So far, he had not revealed how many he had.
Vexthra had already warned him that when facing an Immortal above the True Immortal stage, he must look out for how much Immortal Qi they have. If it was more than two, he must do one thing: run.
Kent wasn’t one to run. His opponent was dangerous, but so is he. He is a mortal with the power of a True Immortal. That is all the confidence he needs.
However, as time passed, he started to see why he might just die if he were to go beyond an hour with this bastard.
If in the next 30 seconds he couldn’t turn things around, he might as well make a run for it as Vexthra advised.
But as if that wasn’t enough, the bastard had just revealed his third ability, and that was Metal Affinity.
In his memories of Jest, he had also learned the metal element, which played a pivotal role in forming his Genesis Sword Realm.
Because of that memory, he knew all too well just how dangerous the metal element really is. So, looking at the dozens of spears aimed at him, his heart skipped a beat.
They surrounded him on all sides. He thought about teleporting away, but he found out an invisible domain had been activated.
This made him stop because if he were to try, the chance of him finding himself in even more danger is just too much.
Kent closed his Jade Void Wings, creating a small force field around himself.
It was one of the many abilities of the Jade Void Wings.

However, considering he was facing an Immortal Emperor with mastery of the metal element, he knew just the force field wouldn’t be enough, so he went a step further and activated 40,000 blood runes and used them to reinforce the force field.
His body was still coated with the scale shield.
The spears moved, and as he expected, when they met the force field, they came to a halt. This made him sigh in relief.
But he knew something had to change because just when he sighed in relief, 4 immortal Qis flared around Noctyrr.

Just like that, ten copies of Kent filled the 80,000 km radius, each clad in the same armor and wielding the same sword.
Noctyrr’s eyes narrowed.
He tried scanning the ten copies to find the real Kent, but he came up empty.
’How is that possible?
They are all the same person.’
His mind started to spin like a turbine, unsure of how to even make sense of what was happening.
Every last version of Kent had the same energy signature, something that shouldn’t have been possible considering clones and the main body should have a different aura.
However, since Kent was only using his sword intent and sword aura, all he could sense was those energies.
That just made no sense, however, as he continued to attack Kent with his discs while he used his numbers to his advantage, Noctyrr started to sense his mind grow more engaged.
That was bad for him but good for Kent.
Kent’s plan was to overwhelm Noctyrr’s mind by using his ten bodies to his advantage.
The more divided Noctyrr’s attention becomes, the better for him.
Slowly, he started to see the effect of his attacks.
This gave him the confidence to move much closer, closing the gap between them.
If he could get within 10 km of him, there was a good chance he would be able to turn things around.
BUZZ
His Jade Void Wings buzzed as he made a sudden 180-degree turn, evading a disc only for a second one to come.
He quickly used the swap function of his sword clone technique to evade.
He swapped with a clone opposite his location.
But just when he moved closer to Noctyrr, hoping to activate the [Void Cleave], the air turned quiet.
At once, all sound was sucked out of the air, replaced by an unsettling feeling.
Kent, who was getting ready to retaliate, activated his Blood Seals just in time when a rather heavy feeling fell on him.
All the sword clones he had activated were blasted to smoke along with the ice domain he had created.
In an instant, he went from gaining some advantage to being sent crashing to the ground.
The crash created a small crater in the ground, showing he was undead a heavy load.
However, before he could lift himself up, a spear appeared from the ground, stabbing through his side.
His [Chaos Scale Shield] saved him, but the force behind the spear cracked a few ribs.
"Oh shit.."
Kent jumped back, attempting to evade the second spear, only to be surrounded by over three dozen spears.
"This Motherfucker can also use the metal element?" The realization left Kent unsure of what to even think.
So far, he had noticed three things about his opponent that just didn’t make sense.
First was the cuts he had sustained.
They healed, but the pain that came with it seemed to only grow as time passed.
It was as if the longer Noctyrr remained breathing, the more severe the pain.
But that wasn’t all, as the pain intensified, his stamina seemed to start to deplete.
That made no sense.
Kent has a monstrous healing and regenerative ability, so even if the pain intensifies, that shouldn’t affect his stamina.
But considering the description of the mission said Noctyrr’s curses are dangerous, Kent was inclined to believe he had been cursed, and that was why his stamina was depleting.
The second thing he noticed that he believed would make it impossible to kill Noctyrr without external help was his Immortal Qi.
So far, he had not revealed how many he had.
Vexthra had already warned him that when facing an Immortal above the True Immortal stage, he must look out for how much Immortal Qi they have.
If it was more than two, he must do one thing: run.
Kent wasn’t one to run.
His opponent was dangerous, but so is he.
He is a mortal with the power of a True Immortal.
That is all the confidence he needs.
However, as time passed, he started to see why he might just die if he were to go beyond an hour with this bastard.
If in the next 30 seconds he couldn’t turn things around, he might as well make a run for it as Vexthra advised.
But as if that wasn’t enough, the bastard had just revealed his third ability, and that was Metal Affinity.
In his memories of Jest, he had also learned the metal element, which played a pivotal role in forming his Genesis Sword Realm.
Because of that memory, he knew all too well just how dangerous the metal element really is.
So, looking at the dozens of spears aimed at him, his heart skipped a beat.
They surrounded him on all sides.
He thought about teleporting away, but he found out an invisible domain had been activated.
This made him stop because if he were to try, the chance of him finding himself in even more danger is just too much.
Kent closed his Jade Void Wings, creating a small force field around himself.
It was one of the many abilities of the Jade Void Wings.

However, considering he was facing an Immortal Emperor with mastery of the metal element, he knew just the force field wouldn’t be enough, so he went a step further and activated 40,000 blood runes and used them to reinforce the force field.
His body was still coated with the scale shield.
The spears moved, and as he expected, when they met the force field, they came to a halt.
This made him sigh in relief.
But he knew something had to change because just when he sighed in relief, 4 immortal Qis flared around Noctyrr.

chapters.title: Chapter 1422: The Ninth Floor - The Damned Prison (5)
paragraphs: [Kaizo’s Battle]
The Rock Titan that Kaizo was supposed to fight became stunned when, out of nowhere, Kaizo descended with a devastating punch.
BOOOM
He was pushed back, crashing into a mountain 20 km away. The punch came with deadly force, and the impact was as he expected.
But Kaizo didn’t slow down at all. He moved, and before the Titan could move back or dodge, a second punch landed on his chest, creating a crack that spiderwebbed toward his neck.
He was sent flying again.
"That name is Kaizo; do well to remember that before you die," Kaizo grinned, then he moved his body again, radiating an intense golden lightning.
At once, his speed tripled. He closed in on his target, and before he could dodge again, Kaizo landed another punch. He was sent flying back even further now.
The 4th punch came, and he tried to dodge. However, Kaizo grinned and, using the same momentum, he attacked with a devastating force.
He tried hard to dodge, but in the end, the punch landed on his body, something that took him aback. There was just no way he expected the punch to land on him.

He had all the time in the world to dodge, but it seemed that whenever he dodged, Kaizo always found a way to land his punch. Even more annoying, whenever he lands a punch, the grin on his face widens.
After the 10th punch, Titan activated his three immortal Qi, hoping to change the scene of battle. However, the next punch again landed on his body, leaving him in great shock.
"I advise you to face me like a man because no matter how fast you dodge, I will always land a punch."

Titan narrowed his eyes, the cracks on his chest healing at a rapid pace. He is deeply connected to the Earth Element, so as long as his leg is touching the ground, healing his broken body is as simple as breathing.

However, he seemed to be underestimating what Kaizo said. Instead of going on the offensive or boosting his defense, he continued to dodge, which, after the 35th punch, he finally realised he had wasted too much time.
And by wasting too much time, he had let Kaizo gain the upper hand.
"And now, you are dead." Golden metallic armor and gauntlets appeared around Kaizo’s body, and in an instant, his body surged with so much energy.
What followed was a total beatdown, one that was made possible thanks to his two innate abilities.
Kaizo had taken about 4 Innate Talent Awakening Pills, which, thanks to them, had awakened some powerful abilities.
Two of the abilities are the [True Punch] and [Unhealing Punch]. They both are innate passive abilities.
The [True Punch] allows him to always land a punch. It doesn’t matter how fast his target is; whenever he attacks, his punch will land on his mark.
The only way to defend against it is to use a robust defensive strategy or to take the initiative and go on the offensive first.

Titan was arrogant, or more like was made to become arrogant, since he decided to take Kaizo on like the titan he is. Unfortunately for him, Kaizo came from a race of Ancient Angelic Titans. he is crazier than any titan still living.
And to make matters worse, the [Unhealing Punch] took effect after the 20th punch. These innate abilities make it so that all damage dealt by Kaizo cannot be healed.

Even if one has a terrifying healing ability like Kent, their healing speed will drop by at least 90%. So Kaizo wasn’t punching because he liked to punch things. He was punching so his [Unhealing Punch] innate ability would activate.
The moment the ability takes effect, the winner is determined.
The cracks in his body aren’t healing, and the more Kaizo punches, the wider the cracks seem to grow.
"As the saying goes, arrogance is bliss," Kaizo landed an uppercut, sending Titan flying up. He jumped up, appearing overhead with a downward kick.
BOOM
He was sent flying to the ground with a thunderous boom.
"In my entire life, there is only one person I know who can be arrogant in the face of danger but still win. His name is Kent Madson."
He stomped on Titan’s rocky jaw, creating a crack. He followed up with a dangerous kick that sent him flying back.
"You are not Kent Madson."
The more punches, kicks, and stomps he unleashes, the stronger he becomes. After all, his third innate ability, which is also passive, has to do with his strength and stamina.
[Unyielding Might]: The more True Punches you land, the stronger and more energetic you become. The effect is temporary.
Basically, Kaizo has awakened three passive abilities that seem to align perfectly with his nature.
[Unity’s Ability]
Unity advanced steadily toward the direction the mission description took her. Along the way, she started formulating the perfect formation she would be going for.

Feisty, who came from her incarnation as Artemis, the goddess of the hunt, came up with the perfect formation. And thanks to Blossom, the goddess of love’s strategic and insightful thinking, the formation was refined to the best possible form.
By the time she had everything perfectly handled, she was 4 km away from the cave.
But she came to a halt and split her body in half just when a powerful sword arc closed in on her.
One of her innate abilities allows her to split her body in two, with one part taking the form of Artemis (Feisty) and the other of Blossom.
This allowed her to evade, but before she could merge her body back together, the Goblin King appeared overhead, attacking with a wide swing, aiming for Blossom’s head.
Blossom moved back, and in a smooth motion, she painted a block of metal.
CLANG

The sword landed on it, creating a metallic sound. She quickly painted a bat, and then, with a casual hand seal, the painting became real and multiplied, filling the entire space with thousands of bats.
They swarmed the Goblin King in an instant, causing him to be blinded for a second. That split second of blindness allowed Artemis to unleash a powerful arrow aimed at the cut on his chest.
"AaaaaggGGGG"
He was sent flying back, blood oozing from his chest. Unity seized the moment and merged back.
However, instead of attacking with an arrow, a paintbrush appeared in her hand, and with a few strokes, a large arrow, about 400 meters long, appeared from the clouds and locked onto the Goblin King.
"Blossom Giant Armament Descent"
RUMBLE

The heavens shook as the giant arrow descended, its deadly tip locked on the Goblin King. Inside Unity’s primordial space, Blossom formed a couple of seals, and at once, the Goblin King found himself locked in place.
"What..." he tried to move his leg, but it seemed to be locked down.
"Feisty," Unity rose into the air, her bow crackling with lightning. Pulling on her bowstring, a 3-meter-long arrow materialized on it.
Then, from her primordial space, Feisty appeared and augmented the arrow. This gave the arrow a deadly soul attack quality.
Just then, the giant arrow landed on the Goblin King’s defense. This created a single opening, one that Unity was ready for.
"I expected a good fight, but you were already injured, so I guess this is where we end our battle. So long, Goblin King."
She released the arrow, which vanished from sight in an instant. The next second, it appeared. It was going through the Goblin King’s head.
A few seconds later, his defense shattered, and the giant arrow finished him. His chest was pierced through, and he was impaled to the ground.
An orb flew from his chest the moment he died and merged with Unity’s forehead. She fell back and passed out.
A minute later, her body was cocooned in a golden shell.

chapters.title: Chapter 1423: The Ninth Floor - The Damned Prison (6)
paragraphs: [Vexthra’s Battle]
Unlike how Kent and the others began their battle with little to no words, when Vexthra faced her opponent, things played out differently.
Her opponent, just as she expected, was a towering skeletal titan made of sand and obsidian metal. Its skin was sandy, constantly falling off while new sand rose from the ground and merged with it.

In a way, he was just like the Titan Kaizo was facing; the only difference here was that this titan was made of pure sand and a bit lean compared to the towering, muscular, rocky titan Kaizo was bombarding with countless punches.
"A True Immortal, really?" the Sand Titan said, looking strangely at Vexthra.
He was an Immortal Emperor, yet his opponent was a mere True Immortal. If that wasn’t an insult, then perhaps insults were overrated these days.
"I should be the one saying that. You see, I am actually a god, but I was suppressed so I can fit the narrative. In most cases, I wouldn’t even have to walk all the way here just to kill you.
With a snap of my finger, I could kill you from thousands of light-years away. But now that we are here, I suppose this is the universe’s way of making me have some fun."
The Sand Titan narrowed his brown eyes at Vexthra, then he lifted his right hand, causing a brown sabre to appear in it.
It formed from the sand, taking on a brown metallic color.

"I guess delusion can stem from being bombarded by the heat inside my domain. You came all this way just to die at my sword." He pointed his sabre at Vexthra and added, "I will make sure it ends painlessly."
He moved, and the sand moved with him.

In an instant, he was standing before her, his sabre stabbing toward her chest. Vexthra smiled and pointed her index finger forward. A green energy materialized at her fingertips just when the sabre struck it.
There was no sound, no blood, or even a push. Considering the amount of force behind that stabbing attack, she was at least expected to move back a few steps.
However, not even her finger moved an inch. The sabre just stopped.
"How..." The Sand Titan’s expression turned ugly. He pulled back, using the sand as a medium to distance himself.
"I already told you I am a god, but you didn’t believe me. I may appear a True Immortal at the moment, but I have the memories of a god.

This means I have already passed the Immortal stage, and while you would have had a good chance fighting me if this were when I was a true Immortal, I have already mastered Immortal Qi to the point that no immortal, regardless of rank, can defeat me."
Vexthra poked the air with her still green-coated finger, and lines started appearing in the air.
"Impossible. Immortal Qi is not used like that." The Sand Titan moved back again, fearing the lines appearing in the air.

"I suppose you are right. Immortal Qi cannot be used like this. However, if you had already mastered Divine Essence and knew the law that goes into converting Immortal Qi into Divine Essence, then sealing a space would be as simple as a snap of the finger."
SNAP
The Sand Titan’s body suddenly froze in place. Then it cracked, and before long, the sand on the ground began to cool.
"What are you doing?" he asked, feeling the coldness seeping deep into his body.

"I suppose, since you are counting on the sand to kill me, why don’t I rewrite the laws around us so that I can transform the sand into water? This way, even without doing anything, you will just slowly melt away."
As she said that, the ground began to turn to mud. Then slowly, it started turning watery. The Sand Titan tried to fly up, but he found out that jumping off his feet was even a struggle.
"The laws have been rewritten, buddy. No need to struggle."

The desert began to turn into a river. Slowly, the Sand Titan was left standing in water. But to make a mockery of the moment, despite standing 4 meters tall, as the water began to appear, his height slowly decreased.
Vexthra remained on the side, a smile playing on her lips as she watched all this unfold.
If Kent were to be present, he would finally understand why Vexthra always says that when he gets to the Immortal Realm, he shouldn’t just offend anyone.
Vexthra had been suppressed, but there was no way Kent would be able to defeat her.
She knew too much and could do quite a lot, so even if Kent had the means to face an Immortal Lord, the chances of him losing against someone like Vexthra were very high.
It was all about the laws.
The deeper one’s understanding of the laws of the Universe, the greater their control in battle.
Gods don’t fight using skills and techniques. They use the laws they have mastered. They can create any concept using the laws.
She only needed one Immortal Qi to rewrite the law of an Immortal World. How much more could she do if she were to use three Immortal Qis?
Five minutes later, the Sand Titan’s body had completely dissolved into water. Vexthra looked at the small river she had created and smiled.
"Transformation of Life, I suppose."
She smirked and walked away, heading further west. With the laws rewritten, there will now be a river in the desert.
[Neomi’s Battle]
Meanwhile, as Neomi sank deeper into the ocean, she started to feel the water around her heat up. Initially, she didn’t place much emphasis on it.
However, as she got closer to her target, her skin began to turn red. This told her what she needed to know.
"I suppose dual affinity is normal."
It seemed her opponent had both water and fire elemental affinities, so instead of merely attacking her with water, it was using fire too.
Neomi knew she had to see what she would be dealing with before making any move. So despite the heat, she moved deeper until she came face-to-face with a colossal serpent.
Its entire body was covered in an obsidian carapace, and strangely, it had over a dozen pairs of spider-like legs. Its eyes were green, and with every breath it took, smoke came out of its nostrils.
"Well, I should have expected that," Neomi sighed, feeling a bit overwhelmed from merely laying eyes on her target.

The abyssal leviathan locked eyes with her for a few minutes before the water around it started to boil. Neomi moved back—not too much that it would suggest she was trying to run, nor too little that it would suggest she wanted to retaliate.
She merely wanted to have a better look at her opponent and the changes happening around it.
The moment she was far enough, she retrieved a ball-like item from her space ring and smiled, showing it to the abyssal leviathan.
"I have sealed the 2km radius around us, meaning whatever happens here will not affect the space outside the 2km radius containment.
So if I were to drop this poison, in no time, the water within a 2km radius will be affected, and as such, we will both suffocate and die. However..."
Neomi flicked her wrist, and a green pill fell into her palm. "If you were to have a Tier 19 antidote prepared by a Pill Immortal, then you can do this."
She swallowed the pill and then clenched the ball of poison, and at once, the water started turning green.
The abyssal leviathan moved, and Neomi responded with a fierce spear attack.

They use the laws they have mastered.
They can create any concept using the laws.
She only needed one Immortal Qi to rewrite the law of an Immortal World.
How much more could she do if she were to use three Immortal Qis?
Five minutes later, the Sand Titan’s body had completely dissolved into water.
Vexthra looked at the small river she had created and smiled.
"Transformation of Life, I suppose."
She smirked and walked away, heading further west.
With the laws rewritten, there will now be a river in the desert.
[Neomi’s Battle]
Meanwhile, as Neomi sank deeper into the ocean, she started to feel the water around her heat up.
Initially, she didn’t place much emphasis on it.
However, as she got closer to her target, her skin began to turn red.
This told her what she needed to know.
"I suppose dual affinity is normal."
It seemed her opponent had both water and fire elemental affinities, so instead of merely attacking her with water, it was using fire too.
Neomi knew she had to see what she would be dealing with before making any move.
So despite the heat, she moved deeper until she came face-to-face with a colossal serpent.
Its entire body was covered in an obsidian carapace, and strangely, it had over a dozen pairs of spider-like legs.
Its eyes were green, and with every breath it took, smoke came out of its nostrils.
"Well, I should have expected that," Neomi sighed, feeling a bit overwhelmed from merely laying eyes on her target.
The abyssal leviathan locked eyes with her for a few minutes before the water around it started to boil.
Neomi moved back—not too much that it would suggest she was trying to run, nor too little that it would suggest she wanted to retaliate.
She merely wanted to have a better look at her opponent and the changes happening around it.
The moment she was far enough, she retrieved a ball-like item from her space ring and smiled, showing it to the abyssal leviathan.
"I have sealed the 2km radius around us, meaning whatever happens here will not affect the space outside the 2km radius containment.
So if I were to drop this poison, in no time, the water within a 2km radius will be affected, and as such, we will both suffocate and die.
However..."
Neomi flicked her wrist, and a green pill fell into her palm.
"If you were to have a Tier 19 antidote prepared by a Pill Immortal, then you can do this."
She swallowed the pill and then clenched the ball of poison, and at once, the water started turning green.
The abyssal leviathan moved, and Neomi responded with a fierce spear attack.

chapters.title: Chapter 1424: The Ninth Floor - The Damned Prison (7)
paragraphs: [Lilian’s Battle]
Lilian is a no-nonsense kind of gal.
When she is with her sisters, she can be sweet and lively. However, when in battle, there is no gentleness about her.
In fact, when locked in battle, she always goes for the kill, regardless of what or who her opponent is.
This time around, her opponent is a maniac who values torture over killing their target.
Her opponent is the Bloodhowl Devourer, a hybrid wolf-humanoid stitched with beast remains. Most of its body parts seem to want to fall off.
From the moment she laid eyes on her opponent, she knew the battle could end in one of two ways.

The first plan would be to use her innate ability to create a sub-zero-degree domain where her ice abilities would be unmatched, or a superhot domain where her flame abilities would grow devastating as the temperature rose.
Lilian immediately knew which one to use.
After all, she had no plans of letting her opponent die the easy way, so she put away her staff and transformed into a flame dragon instead.
The moment she turned into a dragon, the wolf became a dwarf before her. It sensed the danger immediately and tried to attack; however, Lilian had no intention of delaying the battle.
She flapped her wings and took to the air. The wolf followed, but soon realized that, despite being a Spirit Immortal, Lilian was superior in aerial combat.
So it stopped pursuing her.
However, while it chose to stop pursuing its prey, Lilian had no plans of letting it off. So she went ahead and unleashed her innate ability, instantly setting the forest on fire.
In no time, the wolf found itself trapped in a burning region, one so superheated that the very ground began to melt.
ROAR
Lilian let out a powerful dragon roar and took a nosedive, her claws coated in flames. She came with a deadly speed, landing a powerful kick on the wolf’s hide.
BOOM
The wolf lost its balance.

The impact tore a chunk off its back, causing blood to pour out. However, because the surroundings had become so hot, the blood began to sizzle, producing a painful sound and sensation that traveled deep into its body.
It tried to run back, but Lilian was already upon it with a breath attack.
HOWL
It let out a painful howl as its entire body was set on fire, one that couldn’t be put out easily.
Standing 4km away, Elsa and Mara smiled, enjoying the battle.
Unlike Kent and the others, who appeared alone in random spots due to the special missions, the two of them appeared in the same place.
They tried reaching out to the others, but it was made painfully clear to them that this mission was not as simple as it seemed. So they started roaming about.
Along the way, they encountered a few dangers, but with the two of them working together, they easily handled those threats.
A few minutes ago, they saw smoke and felt the heat in the air when Lilian activated her innate ability. So they moved toward it, and lo and behold, it was just who they suspected.
"I guess she was among the seven who received the special mission," Mara said, a smile playing on her lips.
Elsa nodded. "It seems so. However, to think she had become this powerful already when she hadn’t even reached the Immortal stage. What a monster."
"Oh, please, as if you didn’t just kill a Root Immortal with a mere glare."
Elsa laughed. As the Soul Sentinel, she could easily mess with the soul however she wanted. So killing a Root Immortal wasn’t that much of a struggle for her.

"Maybe before you talk about mine, why don’t you reveal your sword realm? I held back when we fought the two-headed lion, hoping you would reveal it, but I guess a monster doesn’t need their sword realm to take down a Spirit Immortal."
"I guess we all have become monstrous."
"I guess we did. And after this mission, I am sure we will all become even more powerful."
Mara nodded.
"What are you two talking about?" Mara’s sword appeared in her hand instinctively when a voice came from behind then.
Turning around, their gaze landed on a white-haired lady whose resemblance to Lilian is uncanny.
"LILIAN..." they exclaimed, turning back to look at the battle where Lilian was still bombarding the wolf with deadly attacks.

"How are you here when you are locked in combat with that wolf?" Elsa asked, completely bewildered. She is Lilian’s mother, so despite them having the same man as their husband, she still sees herself as a mother figure when Lilian needs it.
They share secrets together and reveal all they have gained whenever they both make a breakthrough. So seeing two Lilians appear two left her in shock and a bit betrayed.
"Sorry, I didn’t tell you. I was hoping to surprise you, which now that I did, I feel terrible I didn’t tell you earlier on."
"So you can separate into your elemental affinities now," Mara asked, also stunned.
"Yes. The me fighting is my flame dragon form. This is my ice dragon form. I was keeping watch, making sure nobody snuck up on me, only to find you two here."
"We sensed your flame, and as your mother who knew everything about you—or at least I thought I did—we decided to come protect you."
"Oh, come on, Mom, no need to be angry about this. I am sorry." Lilian hugged her, planting a kiss on her cheek.
Elsa pouted but smiled a second later. "You are lucky, you are my second favourite person."
"Who is your first?" Lilian now had a pout on her face.
"You are my daughter and all, but until you can grow a dick as beautiful and perfect as Kent’s, he will always be my favourite person."
Mara giggled, and Lilian smirked. "I guess you are also my—"
Elsa covered Lilian’s mouth, making sure she didn’t end the sentence.
4km away, Lilian kept bombarding her opponent with all kinds of flame attacks. After ten minutes, the wolf became charred but still alive.
Lilian roared and transformed into her redhead form. She summoned her staff and, with a casual wave, a large ball of flame, about 200 meters in diameter, formed in the air and descended on the wolf.
Its entire body was incinerated, leaving not even a bone behind. She waved her staff again, and the fire around receded. The only thing that remained was the smoke and heat.
She flew away and joined Elsa, Mara, and her ice body.
Looking at how identical they looked, a question formed in Mara’s mind.
"I am not Selene, but I have to ask, can both of you have sex with Kent and feel what the other is feeling?"
"Yes and no," redhead Lilian answered. "I can make it so if I am having sex with Kent, the other me won’t feel a thing."
"How envious," Elsa said, pouting again. "So, if I am to get you straight, you have the means to make it so only one version of you will have sex while the other remains oblivious."
Lilian nodded.
"So in other words, if redhead you were to grow tired, whitehead you can take over."
"Yes."
"Damn it."

chapters.title: Chapter 1425: The Ninth Floor - The Damned Prison (8)
paragraphs: Kent remained locked in place, his Jade Void Wings creating a force field around him.
Thousands of spears, formed from the metal element, kept bombarding him with deadly attacks, each impact creating cracks in his shield.
He had already summoned all his blood runes, but under the assault of a Peak Immortal Emperor, his defence slowly started to crumble.
Noctyrr started using his four Immortal Qis to reinforce his attacks, so while Kent’s defence was strong, the continuous assault seemed to slowly start to eat away at his force field.
’This is an eye-opener,’ Kent said inwardly, feeling thankful he was experiencing this battle firsthand.
Once he returned from Planet Brymrr, he would head to the Star Gateway, where he would be facing Immortal-level spatial beasts.
He knew it would be a dangerous journey. However, before this battle, he had this confidence that he would be able to handle an Immortal King and even go toe-to-toe with an Immortal Emperor.
He didn’t place much emphasis on his target since he knew he had become powerful over the last few months.
However, from what he had already seen and was experiencing, he knew that if he didn’t prepare even more, there was a good chance he would be walking to his death.
He could see it loud and clear now. This is a Pseudo-Calamity beast, but he was struggling to hold it back.
Even if he were to face an ordinary Immortal Emperor, just a small mishap, and he would die like a fish.
Unfortunately for Noctyrr, the Chaos Dragon had been working on some powerful stuff over the past couple of weeks and even years.
Before coming on this mission, he received a message that his [Death Star Cannon] was ready for use. He was happy to hear that, but he certainly didn’t expect to need it now.
He had no plans to fire it right now, but he needed its containment feature because he planned to use a soul attack against Noctyrr.
"At the end of the day, I created these tools for battles, so it is not bad to use them when I find myself in a slight pickle."
Although he would have loved to use nothing but his sword to win, it became clear he was way past that, so he tapped into his soul universe, and at once, the planet shuddered.
Up in the air, over 20 meteors appeared through the clouds, burning with an incendiary might.
Noctyrr felt the danger, so he turned away from Kent, sending all his focus to the colossal stones falling from the sky.
Kent used that chance to distance himself. Watching the meteorites fall with overwhelming might, he felt regretful that they were being used against a single opponent.
He created them purposely to be used against multiple targets.
However, since he had already made the call, making it count was the next best thing he could do.
"RISE."

He commanded, and a colossal gate rose from the ground, casting a giant, eerie shadow over the place. In an instant, the entire space turned cold. The feeling that appeared couldn’t be described in words. No amount of words would do it justice.
However, seeing the expression that appeared on Noctyrr’s face, everything could be summed up in only one word: fear.
Kent saw fear in his eyes, and that made him smirk. However, as they say, there is no mercy for the damned.
"OPEN."
CRACK
The gate swung open, and from within, waves of water poured out, filling the air with all kinds of agonizing screams.
Noctyrr was drowned in an instant, his scream blending with the resentful screams coming from the Hell River.
After using it during his mission to the Void Forest, it had become even more terrifying.
On top of that, Kent had become even more powerful, so adding to the resentful souls that were absorbed, it could be said the [Underworld Soul River] had become even more dangerous.

Kent kept count, waiting for the pressure to come. Ten seconds into the activation, he felt it. However, the [Death Star Cannon] activated on its own and started channeling the pressure into the containment.
Kent gritted his teeth, his mind getting overwhelmed. Sixteen seconds later, a drop of blood fell from his nose, then it seeped from the corner of his lips.
He endured for three more seconds before deactivating it. A second later, and he would die or worse, sustain a soul and mental injury.
He dropped to his knees, gasping for breath. The water receded back into the gate, and it vanished back into his soul sea.
He retrieved a Tier 13 pill and swallowed it. A wave of energy washed through his body, causing him to take a big breath.
"That was crazy," he said, but then he laughed.

Looking ahead, he saw Noctyrr sprawled on the ground, his face pale like a white sheet. He was also gasping for breath, but looking at how pale and broken he had become, it could be said even a Root Saint could end him.
Kent didn’t waste the chance. He threw Gaap forward, who moved with precise speed and stabbed through Noctyrr’s head, ending him in an instant.
"HAAAA."
Kent let out another deep sigh, then sat down in a lotus posture and closed his eyes. Gaap transformed into his humanoid form and stood guard.
He sustained more than one injury. By using the [Underworld Soul River] that intensely, he sustained both mental and soul injuries.
Though not that grave, it was still deep enough to warrant immediate care.
So he needed to heal them before taking any step.
Thankfully, he managed to kill Noctyrr when he did. If he had failed to gain the advantage as he did, things wouldn’t have ended the way they did.
But he won in the end, so that is all that matters.
Kaizo stood on Titan’s body with one leg, his expression filled with disdain.
"How weak. I expected Calamity Beasts to be strong, but I guess I expected too much." Looking at the wrecked body he stood on, it was clear he had done a number on him.
Titan was supposed to be the opponent Kaizo had been waiting for his entire life. However, when they finally met, the outcome was rather disappointing.
Having the ability to heal and reform his body from sand and rocks should have made him a perfect counter to an undead like Kaizo.
However, he became arrogant from the start. So when he should have gone on the offensive or bolstered his defense, as Kaizo had advised, he stuck to his speed.
By the time he realized he was wrong, it was already too late.
"Before you die, know you have been a great disappointment to all brutes out there," Kaizo smirked. "Now die."
He raised his leg, and with a thunderous stomp that caused cracks to appear in the ground, he stomped on Titan’s face, crushing his head into chunks of rock.
There was no surviving that, not when he had absolutely no way of healing.
"Master was right. If I want to have the battle of my life, I must hit the road," he sighed. "When we are done with this dungeon, I will go on vacation."

His wings appeared behind him again, and he took to the air, speeding toward the south of his location. A couple of minutes ago, he sensed a powerful fluctuation coming from there, so he wanted to check it out.

From another location, Eliane was also heading in the same direction. She also sensed the fluctuation, so since they cant chat using the Tower, heading there might give her some answers to what had happened.
From other locations, a few others who sensed the fluctuation also headed in that direction.

The leviathan let out a powerful roar, its body radiating heat.
"No need to struggle. The poison has already taken effect, so regardless of what you do, I will win in the end."

Neomi pointed her spear at the leviathan. A wave of spear Qi coated it, then with a sudden dash, she closed the gap between them. The leviathan tried to attack with a breath attack, but Neomi was already a step ahead.
She used a movement technique that enabled her to teleport to the Leviathan’s tail. She stabbed her spear forward, and a 300-meter-long manifestation of her spear appeared, stabbing into the tail.

The creature let out a powerful roar and shook its body, causing the space to vibrate. It whipped its tail back, hoping to swat Neomi away; however, she was long gone, appearing overhead with yet another attack.

However, just when the attack was coming toward the leviathan’s head, another version of her appeared at the tail of the leviathan and attacked using the same stabbing attack she had used a couple of seconds ago.
Even better, the attack was aimed at the spot she had just attacked.
The spear landed, carving deep wounds into the leviathan’s already injured body.
The same attack had been used many times, which, judging by how deep the wounds on its body were, suggests that Neomi had used the same technique each time.
Whenever she attacks, the previous attacks come again.
The same thing happened when she went in for another attack.
She aimed for the side of the Leviathan; however, a version of her appeared at the tail and another at the head, which she had just attacked.
All three attacks landed on the colossal body of the leviathan, causing the injuries to become much deeper.
Neomi used the advantage she had to her benefit. She went in again, and as she expected, things played out the same way.
After managing to land dozens of attacks, she moved back, gasping for breath.
Just like how all of her sisters had awakened powerful innate abilities, she had also awakened quite a few.
One of them is called [Repeat]. It allows her to repeat an action she has been performing for the last 10 minutes continuously for as long as she can.
Neomi knew she was no match for this leviathan, especially while in the water. So she used the poison that Princess Lovina had prepared for her to poison the water.
This was so that they could take the battle outside. However, while inside the water, she activated the [Repeat] innate ability, which aided her in inflicting more injuries on the leviathan.
Since an attack can be repeated, she had the chance to attack the same place continuously, hence the deep wounds on its body.
She also sustained some injuries, but with the leviathan poisoned, she slowly gained the upper hand. As time passed, the poison took effect, paralyzing it bit by bit.
Of course, with such a dangerous target, Neomi had no plans to be complacent, so she made sure that no matter what, as long as the leviathan still breathed, she would not slow down.
From several locations, her sisters and friends started to appear. Kaizo was the first to arrive and stopped 4 km away, watching as Neomi slowly devastated the leviathan with her attacks.
Elsa, Mara, and Lilian arrived next, followed by Miryssa and Yuyin.
The two of them also appeared in the same place; however, unlike Elsa and Mara, who had to fight their way toward Lilian, they faced no opponents.
Also, unlike with Vexthra, Miryssa did not suppress her cultivation from the Universal God stage to True Immortal; she remained a god.
Maybe that was why they were never attacked.
After them, Selene and Yi Lai arrived, riding on one of Yi Lai’s undead dragons.
They had their fair share of opponents. However, with how much power they were both packing, even the last True Immortal they met was defeated in under a minute.
A few others soon arrived, each wearing a shocked expression at the sight of Neomi single-handedly inflicting such gory wounds on the leviathan.
"I guess it is normal since, when all things are considered, she can be said to have the most experience when it comes to combat," Mara said...
In the harem, Neomi can be considered a wild card. She has no fancy abilities, but when it comes to combat, she is dangerous.
She had never lost in a duel against any of her sisters, so over time, they all came to the conclusion that she was a dangerous person to face in battle.

Even Vexthra recognized her battle intelligence, so seeing her run circles around the leviathan, while shocking, considering she is but a bug before such a colossal beast, the mere fact that she single-handedly dealt all this damage is both shocking and admirable.
"I wonder just what kind of monster she would become once she becomes an immortal," Lilian said with a smile.
They all wanted to find out. Neomi is not the most talented, not when there is someone like Kent running around. But they want to see what she could accomplish when she becomes an immortal one day.
They know she was once a general who led the campaign against the Calamity Beasts in her past life. So they want to see what would become of her in this life, too.
After a couple more minutes, the leviathan couldn’t hold on much longer and died. Neomi drove her spear through its thick skull, ending its pitiful existence for good.
Elaine quickly rushed over and started healing her.
"That was awesome, Lady Neomi. Maybe we should have a duel one of these days," Kaizo said, walking toward the leviathan’s body.
The first thing that came to mind when he arrived on the scene was how much fun it would be to punch the leviathan until it dropped dead.

He still hadn’t recovered from how disappointing Titan was, so the leviathan’s colossal and hard-skinned body got to him. Unfortunately, he could only watch as it was brought down a peg until it couldn’t hold on much longer.
"Kaizo dear, maybe pick a fight with big sister Vexthra first before you seek out Neomi. Trust me, she is more dangerous than she looks," Elsa said, applying her own healing abilities to Neomi.
"Elsa is right, Kaizo. Neomi is not an opponent you can handle, not when she can kill you without you knowing how."
The ladies around laughed. Kaizo, on the other hand, merely shook his head and smiled. He had seen what Neomi can do, but nobody had seen what he is capable of as well.
"Where are you, ladies?" Suddenly, Vexthra’s voice entered her sisters’ heads. The next second, she appeared beside them on the island.

chapters.title: Chapter 1427: Mission Completed
paragraphs: The moment Vexthra arrived, the others began to appear one by one. Some came in pairs and others alone. However, in no time, everyone except Kent, Unity, and Veera appeared.
Vexthra reached out to Veera, who replied and said that she was in the middle of something and that they shouldn’t worry about her.
Vexthra believed her. After all, she has 5 True Immortals as her guards. Even if an Immortal Lord were to ambush her, she would have ample time to make a run for it.
She was one of the seven selected to kill the Seven Calamity Beasts. Her opponent was an Insect Queen who had thousands of subordinates to fight for her.
Unfortunately for her, Veera also has thousands of undead under her command. Even better, she has five True Immortals and two Core Immortals under her command.
When she sensed her opponent’s location and sent her five True Immortals after her, the Ant Queen had already made a move on her by sending over a hundred Ant Warriors after her.
However, while a Heavenly Ascension Stage warrior would find those ants threatening, Veera remained very calm when they arrived.
She sent out her two Core Immortal undead, which she created by combining fifteen Heavenly Ascension Stage undead Angels. The ones formed are, in fact, powerful beyond normal understanding.
She is sure that one day, the Angel Race will come after her for creating a new breed of angels.
In less than a minute, they killed over thirty ants each within the ranks of Heavenly Ascension Stage and Core Immortal.

The moment they died, Veera used her necromancy powers on them, bringing them back from the dead. They came back with the ranks they had before dying. This gave her the power to easily handle the ants attacking her, and she quickly dealt with the rest.
In under twenty minutes, she killed all the ants, and one of her undead True Immortals killed the Ant Queen.
When she died, instead of leaving, Veera decided to take advantage of the bodies of the ants she and her undead had killed.
They are powerful, and considering what she is capable of, she can create powerful undead warriors from them.
Later, while exploring the abandoned city, she discovered something huge.
There, hidden underground, were thousands of eggs, each housing a powerful Metallic Jade Ant. The ones she had killed were metallic in nature, and hidden underground were thousands more of them.

Veera grew excited, so she entered and began experimenting. She started by taking control of two eggs. Then, channeling her necrotic Qi, she merged them together, which hatched into a unique kind of ant, one that was both alive and dead.
It came out as a Death Stage ant. That was something she never expected to happen. However, with that success, she started working on creating a new breed of undead.
Until she is done, she won’t be going back.
Vexthra reached out to Kent, who told her he was fine and would be coming over in a couple of minutes.
The only person who didn’t reply was Unity. However, since the tower connection had been reestablished, she used the harem connection to sense her location.
She teleported there only to find Unity cocooned in a golden shell. Knowing she was in no harm, she created a containment formation around her before leaving.
She realized Unity had already received what this floor had for her, so the least they could do was wait for her to finish whatever she had going on before they climbed to the 10th floor.
A few minutes later, Kent joined them on the island.
He was happy to see that everyone was safe and happy.
This mission had been a weird one. However, after hearing what they all went through, he realized that, if they had not come in time, this mission would have created an even bigger problem.
The Calamity Era was just like any other era. However, when the Calamity Beasts came, the universe wasn’t prepared.
Unlike the Dark Era and many others that saw the Universe prepare for an invasion, the Calamity Era brought the universe to the brink of extinction.
Had it not been for brave warriors like Rakshasa, Runnatu, and Grim Singer stepping in, the universe would have fallen into the hands of the Calamity Race.
In the end, just like what happened during the Primordial Era, the Calamity Beasts were driven back to where they came from.
However, since they once found their way into this universe, nothing is stopping them from coming back. In fact, they will return, and this time with deadly force.
This mission was to prevent them from coming back. The seven Calamity Beasts they had killed were like keys meant to open the gateway to the Calamity Realm.

If the planet had undergone its evolution with them on it, it would have been too late for Kent and his team to do anything. If they had been twelve years later, things would have turned out differently.
Thankfully, he and his legion came just in time to prevent a calamity.
But how many more calamities are out there waiting to happen? They prevented one from happening this time, but would they be present for the next one?

"Let’s take the win this time. Who knows, one day we will find a way to put a stop to all kinds of invasions this universe will go through," Kent said, putting the minds of his ladies and legion at ease.
"Hopefully."
"Master, would you be joining us when we climb to the 10th floor?" Kaizo asked, already prepared for the next floor.
"No, buddy. I have some business to handle out there, so the rest will be handled by you and the others."
He nodded.
"So are you leaving?" Velyra asked, holding Kent’s left hand while Lilian cuddled in his right arm.
"Yeah. The sooner I get that stuff out of the way, the faster I can come back here and clear the remaining floors with you."

Kent had already made plans for the next couple of months, so he was already prepared to go back. He had mastered Tier 13 pills. The only thing left was refining the Azure Pill Ring for it, then he would move to Tier 14 and hopefully Tier 15.
Once he was back from Planet Brymrr, he would resume that and make sure he became a Pill Sovereign before ascending to the Immortal World.
After spending a couple of hours with them, he left. He first checked on Unity before heading back to the tower.

Before heading to Planet Bayla to meet the midnight shadows, Kent decided to check out the Death Star Cannon he had created and his Soul Warriors, for whom he had received confirmation that they were done being created.
Calix only underwent a breakthrough to the Root Immortal Stage. However, the last two were new creations that he had yet to name and review their abilities and Aspects.
So he entered the Soul Universe to handle that.
After he was gone, Vexthra led everyone back to where Unity’s cocoon was and handed them the reward for clearing this floor. They had already used the rewards from the previous floors.
This time around, they received three rewards: Limit Breaker Key, Innate Talent Awakening Pill, and Bloodline Strengthening Elixir.
She shared them, and they all got busy. Since Unity was not finished with her cultivation, they would stay inside the planet until she finished, then they would head to the 10th floor.
Meanwhile, in an unknown place on the planet, an Immortal Monarch slowly opened his eyes, an evil smile tugging at his lips.
Hovering beside him was a sword coated in blood. If Unity were to see this sword, she would recognize it as the one that left the cut on the Goblin King’s chest.
It was that cut that gave her an upper hand in her battle with the Goblin King.
He looked into the distance and muttered, "Let the hunting begin."
He vanished from his chair, and the sword vanished along with him.
Back in the forest, Axiom grinned and secretly sent a message to Kol and Kailan. A few seconds later, they snuck away, making sure nobody saw them leave.

chapters.title: Chapter 1428: Calix’s Upgrades
paragraphs: When Kent entered the Soul Universe, he moved toward the location where Calix had entered seclusion. He wanted to see what he had become after reaching the Root Immortal Stage.
When he first created him, he found out that a Soul Warrior is more than a tool for battle. They are real living beings that can make their own decision and handle their own evolution.
Calix came out as a [Soul Reaper].
This made him someone whose main strength lies in soul battles. But that wasn’t all; his job class came with one innate ability called [Bind].
This ability allows him to draw strength from Kent’s Soul Universe. This meant that, just as Kent draws strength from his Blood Sea, Calix draws his energy from his Soul Universe.
In return, he produces something called [Soul Crystals], which, so far, Kent knew could be used to strengthen his soul.
When he created Calix, his soul cultivation went from Tier 16 to Tier 19. That was quite a leap from merely creating one Soul Warrior.
However, now, even without reviewing his profile, Kent could sense his soul had become even more powerful. He cannot move past Tier 19, but that doesn’t mean his soul can strengthen and expand.
Even better, the Soul Universe seemed to have become even bigger and stronger. He knew that the [Soul Crystals] were the reason for the change.
Away from that, he also came with three affinities: [Soul Affinity], [Shadow Affinity], and [Fire Affinity].
These affinities gave him so much power that Kent couldn’t even bring himself to form an understanding of them.
They have so much potential that if Calix uses them well, he will become unstoppable.

Then, finally, he also came with four Aspects. The first is the [Battle Master]. This aspect allows him to adapt quickly in battle and learn from his opponent, using their battle style to refine his own.
The longer he remains in battle, the stronger and more experienced he becomes, making him someone who grows during battle. On top of that, whatever changes he goes through remain with him forever.
So after every battle, he will gain something, unless, of course, his opponent chooses to fight in long-range style. If that were to happen, then he wouldn’t gain anything.
However, as long as they engage in close combat, even if for a minute, he would gain something.
The second is the [Soul Master] aspect.
Kent had yet to determine the extent to which this aspect goes. However, from what he learned the last time he checked it, the [Soul Master] aspect allows Calix to engage in all kinds of soul combat.

This meant that, be it soul manipulation, transformation, augmentation, and whatnot, Calix can do it. And even better, with the [Battle Master] aspect, he can easily incorporate soul attacks into it, giving him a new direction to take his soul attacks.
Basically, with this aspect, he can be likened to being on the same level as the Soul Sentinel.
The third aspect is the [Shadow Master], which allows him to manipulate the shadows as if they were an extension of his body. He can do as he pleases with the shadows in ways most assassins couldn’t.

This aspect is perfect for when he wants to fight on the physical plane. His strength is in soul battles, but with the [Shadow Master] aspect, he can easily fight anyone by messing with their shadows.
As for the last aspect, it allows him to forge any weapon he wants using soul spirits. The [Forge Master] aspect made him the perfect blacksmith. Kent contracted him to make some weapons for him.
Now, as he drew closer to his cultivation ground, he could hear metal striking metal coming from a room he had built. It wasn’t there the last time he was there.
"Calix, buddy, do you have a minute?" Kent asked when he appeared within talking range of the building. The metallic sound stopped, and from the entrance, Calix walked out, wiping sweat off his brow.
"Looks like you’ve been busy,"
