chapters.title: Chapter 1439: Plan to find Black Widows’ whereabouts
paragraphs: Catching up with Crimson Dagger and learning about the rest of his friends sure brought Kent some form of happiness he never expected.
Learning how some of them are faring put him at ease. Of course, some of them may have ventured into uncharted territories over the past million years, but knowing they are alive put him at ease.
At least they are alive and will one day reunite with them, as he did with Crimson Dagger.
But hearing the one called Black Widow had gone missing and possibly ventured into a calamity zone left him wondering just why she would do something like that.
There are about 7 calamity zones in the universe. Legend has it that they existed long before the primordial era fell, so there is a good chance they were formed at the dawn of time.
Over the several eras that have passed, no one can boldly say they have ventured into a Calamity Zone and explored everything it contains.
Many tried, and many didn’t return, not because they were incapable. Most legendary warriors tried to uncover the secret of these calamity zones, but were not heard from again.
So, for a friend of his to venture into such a harrowing place left him wondering why she made such a decision, and even worse, why she didn’t tell any of her friends and teammates.
The Midnight Shadows were formed on the idea of how a family should be. So she should at least have made them aware she planned to do something this reckless.

"Knowing the kind of person she is, I am sure she wouldn’t waste her time chasing after someone in the high world," Kent suddenly said. "So this can only mean she had indeed ventured into the Nameless Temple and left the mark for you to find since she knew you would have prohibited her from entering."
"I arrived at the same conclusion. However, why would the Cult of Wisdom hide her whereabouts?"
"That is a bit strange indeed. It is like they are hiding something."

"They are always hiding something. However, to the rest of the Cult of Wisdom, I am someone important to the Black Widow. They respect her because of her intelligence. So if they hold her in such a high regard, what then is preventing them from telling me where she is?"
Kent thought for a moment, but nothing came to mind.
He also found it strange that such a person would go on a mission without her own people knowing. It just doesn’t make sense, not when everything is considered.

To the Cult of Wisdom, Black Widow is Scholar Nania. She rose through the ranks, becoming a Supreme Scholar, something only a few had achieved, so there is just no way they wouldn’t keep track of such a person.
The Cult of Wisdom knows something about everything. So there is just no way they wouldn’t know where Scholar Nania had gone.
"You mentioned they are looking for a gem they discovered in a high world, right?" Kent asked, and Crimson Dagger nodded.
"Is there a chance this person is named Jest?"
"How do you know that?"

"Let’s just say I accidentally passed a test they put out and became an accidental member." Kent smiled weakly. "I initially wanted to ignore them, but from what I have discovered these last few days, it seems I must go to them."
Crimson Dagger stared quietly at Kent for a few moments before a smile appeared on his face. "Looks like you came back with more mysteries, Jaqen."
He paused for a moment and then asked, "Does this have something to do with your suspicion that you had lived other lives before the Faceless Assassin?"
"Yes. But I can’t tell you, Titus. You know, Karma and all."
"I understand."
"Good. Of course, one day you will know more, but for now, we have to find Black Widow’s whereabouts."
"Since the Cult of Wisdom is saying nothing, we can only turn to the next option, which is for you to become a member and find out from within their ranks."
"How do I go about that, then? I already told you I will embark on a dangerous mission soon, so I need to prepare."

"I learned they will be opening the 12 Knowledge Seals five years from now. You can make your name known any day, but when the time comes, you must place in the top three to become a member, a respected member.
You must also become an Immortal before then, so you have to work hard to ascend to the rank of at least a Root Immortal in the next five years."
"I can manage that."
In five years, he would be back from Elina’s galaxy and be ready to ascend. The only way to get information from the Cult of Wisdom is to become a respected member.
Kent had not yet made any advances or had any ambition to become a member. However, when the issue with the Dark Queen surfaced, he knew he had to join them.
This would give him access to some hidden knowledge not available to just anyone. From what he had learned about the Cult of Wisdom, even the Universe Council usually comes to them for information.
So they know a lot, and he wants his hands on all of it.
"Another thing, have you heard of a Unique Planet called Brymrr?"
His next destination is the home of the Lord Genesis, which is Planet Brymrr. It was where he grew up and started walking the path of the sword.
So he plans on returning home after being away for billions of years.
"Planet Brymrr is or was once the home world of a legendary swordsman who lived during the Divine Era. From what I learned over the years, a Sword Supreme rules over it now.
Recently, word even started to spread that she has awakened and returned home after being away for billions of years."
Kent furrowed his brow. "This Sword Supreme, do you happen to know her name?"
"Unfortunately, no. But I know she is a dangerous person and the only god in the universe to have attained the rank of a Sword Supreme without actually reaching the rank of a Supreme.
There are some other rumours about her, but most are just people trying to make her appear more mysterious."
Crimson Dagger paused and gave Kent a hard look. "Don’t tell me you plan on going there."

Kent laughed. "What, you think I am that crazy? I just want to have a look and perhaps seek out a friend of mine or maybe an enemy from the past. Regardless, I have to go there, so if you have something else to say, now is the best time."
"Unbelievable."
In the end, Crimson Dagger started telling him all the dangers of a Unique world, specifically, the dangers of Planet Brymrr.
He offered to accompany him, but Kent said no. His reason is simple. If he were to appear in such a place with a Supreme as his bodyguard, he would draw too much attention.
So he will go alone. If there is a danger that he can’t wiggle his way out of, Vexthra will be on call to come to his aid.

He could have decided to wait and first go to Elina’s galaxy before seeking out Inaya. However, knowing the kind of danger waiting for him, he knew he had to use this journey to prepare for what awaited him at the Star Gateway.

To the Cult of Wisdom, Black Widow is Scholar Nania.
She rose through the ranks, becoming a Supreme Scholar, something only a few had achieved, so there is just no way they wouldn’t keep track of such a person.
The Cult of Wisdom knows something about everything.
So there is just no way they wouldn’t know where Scholar Nania had gone.
"You mentioned they are looking for a gem they discovered in a high world, right?" Kent asked, and Crimson Dagger nodded.
"Is there a chance this person is named Jest?"
"How do you know that?"
"Let’s just say I accidentally passed a test they put out and became an accidental member." Kent smiled weakly.
"I initially wanted to ignore them, but from what I have discovered these last few days, it seems I must go to them."
Crimson Dagger stared quietly at Kent for a few moments before a smile appeared on his face.
"Looks like you came back with more mysteries, Jaqen."
He paused for a moment and then asked, "Does this have something to do with your suspicion that you had lived other lives before the Faceless Assassin?"
"Yes.
But I can’t tell you, Titus.
You know, Karma and all."
"I understand."
"Good.
Of course, one day you will know more, but for now, we have to find Black Widow’s whereabouts."
"Since the Cult of Wisdom is saying nothing, we can only turn to the next option, which is for you to become a member and find out from within their ranks."
"How do I go about that, then?
I already told you I will embark on a dangerous mission soon, so I need to prepare."
"I learned they will be opening the 12 Knowledge Seals five years from now.
You can make your name known any day, but when the time comes, you must place in the top three to become a member, a respected member.
You must also become an Immortal before then, so you have to work hard to ascend to the rank of at least a Root Immortal in the next five years."
"I can manage that."
In five years, he would be back from Elina’s galaxy and be ready to ascend.
The only way to get information from the Cult of Wisdom is to become a respected member.
Kent had not yet made any advances or had any ambition to become a member.
However, when the issue with the Dark Queen surfaced, he knew he had to join them.
This would give him access to some hidden knowledge not available to just anyone.
From what he had learned about the Cult of Wisdom, even the Universe Council usually comes to them for information.
So they know a lot, and he wants his hands on all of it.
"Another thing, have you heard of a Unique Planet called Brymrr?"
His next destination is the home of the Lord Genesis, which is Planet Brymrr.
It was where he grew up and started walking the path of the sword.
So he plans on returning home after being away for billions of years.
"Planet Brymrr is or was once the home world of a legendary swordsman who lived during the Divine Era.
From what I learned over the years, a Sword Supreme rules over it now.
Recently, word even started to spread that she has awakened and returned home after being away for billions of years."
Kent furrowed his brow.
"This Sword Supreme, do you happen to know her name?"
"Unfortunately, no.
But I know she is a dangerous person and the only god in the universe to have attained the rank of a Sword Supreme without actually reaching the rank of a Supreme.
There are some other rumours about her, but most are just people trying to make her appear more mysterious."
Crimson Dagger paused and gave Kent a hard look.
"Don’t tell me you plan on going there."
Kent laughed.
"What, you think I am that crazy?
I just want to have a look and perhaps seek out a friend of mine or maybe an enemy from the past.
Regardless, I have to go there, so if you have something else to say, now is the best time."
"Unbelievable."
In the end, Crimson Dagger started telling him all the dangers of a Unique world, specifically, the dangers of Planet Brymrr.
He offered to accompany him, but Kent said no.
His reason is simple.
If he were to appear in such a place with a Supreme as his bodyguard, he would draw too much attention.
So he will go alone.
If there is a danger that he can’t wiggle his way out of, Vexthra will be on call to come to his aid.
He could have decided to wait and first go to Elina’s galaxy before seeking out Inaya.
However, knowing the kind of danger waiting for him, he knew he had to use this journey to prepare for what awaited him at the Star Gateway.

chapters.title: Chapter 1440: Parting Ways Again
paragraphs: Kent and Crimson Dagger spent quite some time together learning more about Planet Brymrr. After he had revealed all he knew, they proceeded to discuss the mission he had given the Midnight Shadows.
He made sure Crimson Dagger understood the importance of such a mission.

From all he knew, every Era has its own danger. The Primordial Era brought its dangers, and so did the Divine Era. This means this Era will also bring its dangers, so the remnants of the past must be handled.
This means the Void Beasts, Spatial Beasts, and now the Dark Creatures must be taken care of before the danger meant for this Era arrives.
If they had to face several enemies at the same time, then his years of preparation would all be for nothing.
So he gave this mission to the Midnight Shadows.
Of course, he planned to add the Night Riders to it, since just as there are remnants of the Dark Creatures, there are also the Shadow Beings who appeared during the Shadow Era.

At one point, the Midnight Shadows would have to resume their battle with the Shadow Creatures. But since Crimson Dagger understood the mission at hand, he promised to reach out to every last Faceless Agent and all Midnight Shadows.
It is all hands on deck, so they have to be ready and available for anything.
"Before I forget, the Pill Council reached out after your name appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet," Crimson Dagger suddenly said.
"Oh, my name appeared on the Pill Dao Tablet?" Kent was a bit stunned.
He hadn’t had the chance to go anywhere after his recent breakthrough in alchemy, so he wasn’t aware he had made such a monumental breakthrough.
"You aren’t aware, huh?" Crimson Dagger sighed. "Your name is trending again in the universe. This time, every alchemist, both good and bad ones, wants their hands on you."
"Is that so?"
"I am afraid that is the case, so be careful out there. The Pill Council came to me to help them protect you. They know you are in a high world, but they had no idea which planet you are on.
So for now, they want me to protect you. But seeing you are more than capable, I believe I have nothing to worry about."
"That is indeed true. I can protect myself. But since they asked for your help, tell them you have everything under control."

Crimson Dagger nodded, and a few minutes later, they walked out of the Midnight Temple. After leaving the area, they headed deeper into the forest. A few minutes later, they arrived before a simple cave.
"Although there is no restriction on me here, which means I can spend as much time as I want here, now that I have a mission, I must head back to the Supreme Realm to get things in motion."
A few minutes later, Crimson Dagger left, and Kent returned to the Midnight Temple. He gave Adin some more instructions before leaving.
After leaving the Midnight Temple, Kent headed back to the Soul Tower and entered the Void Temple right away.
He wanted to form his second Flame Core before heading to Planet Brymrr. So with all resources ready, he entered seclusion.
The first floor of the Void Temple has a flame source that came directly from a Primordial Flame, so he got right on it and started working to form his second Flame Core.
Days quickly passed.
Back inside the 9th floor of the dungeon, everyone was working hard to improve their strength.
The three rewards Vexthra distributed turned out to be something much bigger than anything they had initially thought.
While the plan was to wait for Unity to emerge from the cocoon, they discovered they themselves needed time to train as well.
The Limit Breaker Key allowed them all to break one limit. Of course, it was just a single limit, but after they broke it, they became so powerful that everyone was shocked.
Naturally, that happened thanks to the Innate Talent Awakening Pill they took right after. Some awakened innate abilities, while a few awakened other innate talents.
Kaizo even awakened an innate treasure called Lightning Conduit. It comes in the form of an augmenter, which he can use to enhance his gauntlet and increase the damage output of his punches.
Kaizo wasn’t the only one who awakened a treasure. Others did too, and that joy made them take the next treasure seriously.
This was the first time they received a Bloodline Strengthening Elixir. So far, all of them are locked in a suspended animation state after taking the elixir.

Something mystical is happening to them, and that can be seen from the aura coming out of their bodies. Every last one of them had already awakened their bloodlines, so this elixir is basically strengthening them.
But as to how much effect it would have on them, that will be revealed when the process is over.
Meanwhile, Axiom and his two pals continued their massacre across the entire planet. In just two weeks, they had killed hundreds.
In fact, despite Planet Kenai being a prison for some of the dangerous criminals in the immortal realm, when it comes to matters of right and wrong, Axiom and his pals don’t care.
They had no time to listen to their pleading. To them, the more they pleaded, the more they wanted to kill them.

It got to the point that, despite the rivalry between the criminals on Planet Kenai, they started working together to stop the three dangerous-looking humans who seemed to take pleasure in killing them.
But despite their efforts, the three Void Beasts are just too monstrous. They have the upper hand, considering Axiom is an Immortal Monarch with Nine Immortal Qi.
There is just no way several True Immortals coming together will be able to stop them. Even if he was alone in this unholy campaign, there is just no way they could stop him.
So with Kailan and Kol backing him, nobody on the planet could stop them. So they continued, and for the better part of their mission, they had a good harvest.
But 25 days into their massacre, a powerful pressure fell on them just when they were closing in on a cave. The three of them came to a stop and started to resist the pressure.
Axiom had it easy, but his pals were a bit pressured since the pressure was much heavier than they could brush off. This can only mean the danger coming wasn’t one that could be underestimated.
But instead of finding ways to escape, they stayed, and a few seconds later, a dragon lady walked out from the cave holding a baby.
She has pinkish-silver hair that falls down her back. She is also clad in clean armor made from a very durable material, something a criminal sent to such a gory place shouldn’t have.
The moment their eyes landed on her, they all frowned. For the first time since they began their massacre, they hesitated to attack someone.
This made them wonder just why that was.
The dragon lady is an Immortal Lord, and judging by how effortlessly she manages to bring the three of them to a halt, she is no simple Immortal Lord.
She stopped 40 meters from the three Void Beasts, and for a minute, she said nothing. She only kept her eyes on them as if reading their thoughts.
"My name is Eirdis, Queen of the Flame Jade Dragon Race. This is my daughter, Xandira."

chapters.title: Chapter 1441: Queen Eirdis
paragraphs: For a moment, Axiom, Kailan, and Kol became stunned, unsure of what to say.
All they could do was stare at the dragon lady holding the baby for a full minute before Kol asked,
"Why are you telling us your names? Is this your way of begging us not to kill you?"

"No. I know you came to kill me. After all, I was sent here, so naturally, I can be considered a criminal. But before I die, I want to make sure you know my name and plead that you spare my daughter’s life."

Kol said nothing, and neither did his friends, Kailan and Axiom. The frowns on their faces, however, continued to deepen. The longer they stared at Queen Eirdis, the more they felt the need to hold back from hurting either her or her daughter.
This feeling left them wondering just why that was. It doesn’t make any sense to them.
"Why should we spare your daughter? For all we know, she is also a criminal," Kailan asked, but even he didn’t like the taste of the words he spoke, and neither did his friends.
They had followed Chaos for years and learned his ways. One rule he had always followed: never to hurt children or the innocent. So asking why they shouldn’t hurt a baby was the lowest he could go.
Queen Eirdis looked at the three Void Beasts for a few minutes before she said something that left them stunned.
"I am a descendant of the Chaos Dragon, and so is my daughter."
Axiom looked at his friends, stunned. Name-dropping the Chaos Dragon was right on the nose, so they knew they had to proceed with caution.
After a few minutes, he waved his hand, and the pressure that had been suppressing them vanished. This caused Queen Eirdis to take a step back.
"Relax, lady, we won’t hurt you, but you have to come with us."
"Where to?"

"To meet the people who can confirm if you are telling the truth or not." Axiom pointed forward, and the void opened. Before entering, he turned to Queen Eirdis and warned her, "A word of advice. If you are lying, then you had better come clean now before it is too late."
He gave her a minute to recount what she said, but she stood by her words. Axiom sighed, then walked into the crack in the void. Kol followed, then Kailan went after him.
Queen Eirdis stood there for a few minutes before walking into the crack as well. After she entered, it closed behind her.
The next time it opened, it was 100 meters from where Vexthra and her team were training. A few of them were done with their training, so the moment the void opened, they turned toward it.
Seeing Axiom walk out, they sighed. However, when Queen Eirdis walked out, their attention was shifted to her.
"Who is that?" Kaizo was quick to ask.
"Everyone, this is Queen Eirdis and her daughter, Xandira." Axiom paused for a moment. "She said she is a descendant of the Chaos Dragon."
They all widened their eyes, mirroring the reaction Axiom and his pals went through.
"Did I just hear that right?" Elaine asked, standing up from her lotus posture. The rest of her sisters, who had finished their training, followed her lead and also stood up.
"Are you really a descendant of the Chaos Dragon?" she asked, walking toward the Queen and her daughter, who was sound asleep in her arms.
"Yes."
"How is that possible?" Suddenly, Vexthra’s voice rang out in everyone’s ears. It appeared she had also completed her training.
"The Primordial Chaos Dragon had no descendants because he never married. So how can he have descendants?"
The question instantly made everyone become suspicious of the lady. Subconsciously, they all started preparing to attack if she turned out to be a fake.
But what she said next shocked them.
"He indeed never had a family, but his bloodline did. During the Primordial Era, he blessed a young dragon by giving him a drop of his blood essence.
Maybe he knew what he was doing, or maybe he didn’t know his blood would have such an effect. However, this young dragon, after taking his blood, transformed, becoming a version of the Chaos Dragon.
Over the years, his power grew, and for eras, he passed down his bloodline to a single member of his family.
It had finally reached my turn, but two years ago, some members of my family, alongside some members from a very powerful dragon family, colluded to capture me and..."
Queen Eirdis paused and looked at her baby.
"From the first member of my family to ever get the Chaos Dragon bloodline to date, none have gone beyond the God grade. However, my daughter was born with a Supreme-grade Chaos bloodline."
"So they wanted to take it from her and give it to someone else?" Vexthra asked, and Queen Eirdis nodded.
"You have to believe me. I wouldn’t lie about such a matter."

Nobody said anything for a few more minutes before Mara asked, "How then are you in this godforsaken place? The last I learned, only criminals are sent here, so why are you here, and with a baby at that?"
"This is the only place I could think of to keep myself alive long enough to ensure my daughter grows up and awakens her bloodline fully."

"Smart move..." Vexthra nodded, but then a question popped into her mind. "Where is the one who received the blood in the first place? I am sure they would be happy to learn someone down his bloodline had awakened a Supreme-grade bloodline."
Queen Eirdis sighed before answering, "I don’t know. But there are rumours going around in the family that he vanished billions of years ago after having a falling out with the Universe Council."
"The Universe Council again, huh? They really are bold," Velyra muttered, her expression calm, though a look of craziness could be seen behind her red pupils.
"Looks like it."
After learning what the Universe Council did to Kent in the past, they are all angry and would probably do everything in their power to pay them back in every painful way.

They had caused Kent pain in the past, and so there is nothing that can stop them from having their revenge. Now that they’ve heard what Queen Eirdis said, they have more motivation to bring their A game in the future.
They remained standing there, unsure of how to proceed.
Although Queen Eirdis seemed to be telling the truth, the mere fact that she was in such a horrible place, meant only for criminals, made them hesitate to believe her.

However, seeing the baby in her arms, they knew they had to make a decision. After some quick thinking, Vexthra decided to take them to the Tower City, where Avotha and Vargus would keep an eye on her.
The last thing they wanted was for her to cause trouble. Once Kent is done forming his second Flame Core, he will find out if she is indeed telling the truth or not.
Of course, while there is not much she can do considering the Tower is always active, making sure she is aware she is being watched for now will put everyone at peace.
Thankfully, a couple of days later, Kent successfully formed his second Flame Core.

chapters.title: Chapter 1442: Second Flame Core Formed
paragraphs: [Inside Kent’s Soul Sea - Blood Platform]

By the outside world’s time, Kent had been in seclusion for three and a half weeks. However, considering he entered the Void Temple while inside the tower, he had actually been in seclusion for months.
In the end, spending that much time wasn’t wasted.
Inside his soul sea, he stood calm, his gaze fixed on the large red core now hovering inside the second blood gate.

The first core was formed from a green flame source, so it came out green. However, the second came from a red flame source. Regardless, seeing that he had formed his second flame core successfully made him happy.
"Finally," he muttered.
All over his soul sea, the power of an absolute flame could be felt. This meant that aside from his Ice element, his Flame element had now also reached the absolute stage.
But that isn’t all.
Before entering seclusion, he had only 120,000 flame veins. However, now that he has formed his second flame core, more flame veins are being created.

So as he stood on the platform, looking up at the red flame core, he could feel his strength growing. That, and the fact that he could sense his flame was now at the absolute stage, gave him some sense of satisfaction.
According to what Agni told him, once he manages to form his second flame core, he would be able to use the [Finger of Destruction] even more.
Of course, Kent knew the dangers involved with using such a technique, but he could not deny its power.
Of course, he created his own to compensate for moments he can’t use the [Finger of Destruction].
However, if push came to shove, he knew he could count on that technique and his flame cores to harness its true power.
Until today, he could only use about 10% of its power. However, with his second flame core formed and more flame veins forming, he was sure to push past 50%.
That would surely give him the power to overwhelm even stronger opponents.
Aside from that, there was also his speed, which he could enhance using the flame veins. So far, he could tell that against an Immortal King, their speeds were matched.
Of course, many factors could be considered when determining how fast he can move. In most cases, if the right requirements are met, even a Core Immortal could match his speed.
There are several beings out there who specialize in agility.

An example is the Flame Roc Race that Kaelith is from. They could be considered one of the fastest races in the universe. A person from such a race would be able to easily overpower him in speed, even if the gap between them wasn’t much.

So adding more flame veins would boost his speed and give him an extra edge. And adding his Jade Void Wings, there was a good chance that if he were to face Noctyrr again, he would be able to outrun him.
Kent left his soul sea but didn’t leave the Void Temple. While his core was already formed, he still had the flame veins slowly accumulating, so he remained inside to allow them to form.
Five days later, the 340,000th flame vein was created, and the process stopped again. This meant he had to form a third flame core before he could proceed.
While that was a bummer, the fact that he now had 340,000 flame veins under his command took away the sadness of not being able to form more.
He went from 120,000 flame veins to 340,000. That was more than he could ask for, so he took the win, knowing that one day, he would be able to go even higher.

"This is a win for me. Asking for more would just be me being selfish," he smiled slightly and stood up. He examined his body, then, after confirming he was fine, exited the Void Temple and quickly returned to his soul universe.

Considering how the tower can be restricted easily, he knew he had to keep important things like the void temple inside his soul universe, where, regardless of any restrictions, he could easily access it.
Afterward, he entered the Harem Tower to freshen up. When he arrived there, he saw his wives weren’t back, so he asked the tower to update him on what he had missed.
[While the master was away, the legion and the master’s wives remained on the 9th floor of the Planet Killer Dungeon, where they consumed the rewards from the mission.
Afterward, continued waiting for Lady Unity to finish her transformation. She had yet to come out of the cocoon, so they were waiting for her.
Also, there is someone inside the tower city claiming to be your descendant.]
"Wait, what?" Kent nearly tripped and fell when he heard the last sentence.
"Repeat that again, tower."
[Her name is Queen Eirdis. Sir Axiom, Kailan, and Kol found her when they were roaming Planet Kanei. She has a young daughter, Xandira, who is only 18 months old.

According to her, she is your descendant, born of someone you once gave your blood essence to. I checked her bloodline, and while it is not the same as yours, it indeed has Chaos Essence, meaning she is telling the truth.]
"Oh, that is unexpected but a bit expected." Kent sighed, then a smile appeared on his face.
During the Primordial Era, while roaming in the Blood System, Chaos met a young dragon who had also lost everything at the hands of the Forsaken Race.

It was the first time Chaos connected with someone after he lost Elina to the same vile Forsaken Race. They traveled for a few years since this young dragon also wanted to grow stronger and get revenge.
His dedication touched Chaos. However, while he would have loved to have him by his side, this young dragon was just too weak. He would have died before meeting the first Forsaken being.

However, despite knowing all this, he still wanted to train and become stronger. Chaos tried many ways to persuade him to go on and live a life away from revenge and bloodshed, but this young dragon remained steadfast.

In the end, Chaos decided to bestow his blood upon him and leave him to his fate. The last time they met was that fateful evening when he gave a drop of his blood to the young dragon—something he had never done before.
He had never heard from him again, nor did he bother to even look for him. So hearing that someone was claiming to be his descendant made him remember his longtime friend.
"Did she say anything about where the original wielder of the bloodline is?"
[Yes. According to her, there are rumors flying around that he vanished billions of years ago after offending someone from the Universe Council.]
"Hmmm. Then again," Kent clicked his tongue, a bit annoyed at hearing about the Universe Council.
After learning he was the one who killed the Night Riders and the role the Universe Council played in that, his dark heart had already registered them as enemies.
Hearing their name again only added to the hatred he had for them.
"Let me freshen up and then meet with this person. Who knows, maybe the family I never knew I needed has finally started finding their way back to me, even if destiny is being her usual bitchy self."
Somewhere far away, Lady Destiny smirked, then unwrapped a new lollipop and started sucking on it as she had her mud bath.

chapters.title: Chapter 1443: Meeting Queen Eirdis and Xandira
paragraphs: After freshening up, Kent moved to the Mountain Garden, where, surprisingly, for the first time ever, there was no one there.
Gaia and her band of troublemakers were away working on the portal, and while Vexthra and the team were also away from the tower, there was nobody left to enjoy the comfort of the Mountain Garden.
He stayed there for a few minutes before walking away. Soon, he arrived on the streets of Gaiaville, where everyone he met smiled and greeted him.
Although his wives had been managing the cities, everyone brought inside knew the reason they were now living in peace and luxury was because of Kent, so they were grateful to him.
Seeing them happy also makes him happy.
He made his way toward a building on the outskirts of Gaiaville. That was where Queen Eirdis and her daughter Xandira were staying.
When he drew near, he sensed Avotha and Vargus drinking tea in a house not far from where the mother and her daughter lived.
"You guys can leave. I will take it from here," Kent transmitted to them. They nodded and left, returning to the 9th floor of the dungeon, where they informed Vexthra and the others.
Kent, on the other hand, made his way toward the building. Just as he was drawing near the house, he saw a dragon lady playing with a baby in a small garden infront of the house.
He came to a sudden stop, his gaze narrowing a bit. Even without being told, the moment he laid eyes on Queen Eirdis and her daughter, he knew they were related to him by blood.
And judging by how the lady also turned and looked at him, he knew she also felt what he felt. Their bloodlines seem to resonate with each other.
This, in a strange way, put a smile on his face. He had no idea why, but he was happy to sense someone resonate with his blood.
He resumed his steps and, a few moments later, arrived in the garden, staring at the mother and her daughter.
Xandira, who was not even a year old, opened her eyes and turned to face Kent, which instantly melted his heart.
"What an adorable little lady," Kent crouched down and opened his palm. Queen Eirdis tried to distance herself, but before she could, Xandira reached for Kent’s arm.

This caused her to panic, but seeing how eager her daughter was to take his arm and the fact that Kent was far weaker than her put her mind at ease. She also sensed the terrifying people keeping an eye on her had left just when Kent arrived.
This means the person she had been waiting for is Kent.

In the end, she handed Xandira to Kent, who smiled, scooped her up, and started swaying her from side to side. Under her stunned gaze, Xandira started laughing, something she had never done since she was born.

Although she was a bit young to know when to be happy and when to be sad, and because she was also born in a horrifying place, they had some quiet nights in the past where, as a mother, she tried several times to make her happy.
However, she never even smiled, not even once.
So, going as far as laughing and making a giggling sound in another man’s arms sure came as a shock to her.
"Adorable." Kent laughed and said, "I never knew I was a baby person until I met her."
Queen Eirdis forced a smile, then she asked, "Please, who are you?"
Although she could sense the connection between them, she had always felt some connection to people who shared her bloodline, so sensing it with Kent didn’t put her mind at ease.
If anything, she wanted to know if Kent wasn’t one of the people after her life. Of course, that was her last theory after spending about three weeks inside this place.
"Oh, pardon my rudeness. My name is Kent Madson, but a very long time ago, I was called the Primordial Chaos Dragon."
"What?" Queen Eirdis widened her eyes, while Xandira laughed happily, getting spun around.
"A-Are you saying..."
"Yes. I gave my blood to Elikai, who, since you and this little lady are now here, meant he had succeeded in absorbing and making it his own. I am proud of him."

Queen Eirdis swallowed her saliva, a bit in shock. She never in her wildest dreams expected to meet her ancestor. Her family only talked about the legendary feats of the Chaos dragon, passed down from one generation to another.
So, actually meeting Chaos wasn’t something he expected.
But now that she did, and when the realization kicked in, she dropped to her knees, or at least she tried to.

"No need for that." Kent stopped her from kneeling. "The fact that you are here shows we share a destiny. So don’t kneel to me. You and Xandira are here now, which means it is meant to be so. Be happy, because from now onward, you will be living with my entire family and me."
"As for you, little lady, when you come of age and can use your bloodline, I will teach you so many amazing things that only the Chaos dragon can do."
Xandira giggled as if to say Sure.
Queen Eirdis looked at her daughter and Kent for a while before a smile appeared on her face. "Thank you for giving us a home. I will do my best to repay you in any way I can."
"Just raise Xandira well, and that will cover everything. I can sense she has a much higher concentration of my blood in her veins, so she will one day become a legendary dragon."
Queen Eirdis nodded. It was the reason why she had to flee with her egg long before it hatched.
It can take thousands of years for a dragon egg to hatch.
So when it was discovered that her unborn child had a supreme-grade Chaos bloodline, she knew she had to run.
Every last minute while on the run was spent making sure her daughter was safe and sound. So now that they had found a peaceful home, she would pour all the love she had into her.
Kent spent the entire day with Xandira and her mother. The majority of it was spent playing with the adorable baby dragon. She was just too cute for Kent to bring himself to leave.
He also used some of it to tell Queen Eirdis about her ancestor, the one whose lineage she came from.
Although Kent would never reveal it to anyone, the reason he gave Elikai his blood essence was because of Elina.
She had always wanted to become a dragon. However, Chaos opposes her desire, thinking that it would be too dangerous to give her his blood essence.

However, he lost her at the hands of the forsaken race. From time to time, he would wonder whether the story would have been different if he had gone ahead and given his blood essence to her, as she wanted.
Although she was a decent warrior, being a dragon back then was a privilege many would have loved to have.
Dragons or Beastkins had more power than normal humans. So if she had been a dragon back then, maybe she could have survived the Forsaken Race attack.
That was the main reason he gave Elikai his blood. In a way, he wanted to see if he had been too overprotective that instead of doing the needful, he held back, and that cost him everything.
Meeting Queen Eirdis and Xandira, he knew he had indeed made a mistake by not giving Elina his blood essence.

But while that stung, the mere fact that Elikai survived and built a legacy also made him happy. After all, if Elikai had survived the Primordial Era, then it meant he had gotten his revenge and even had time to build a family.

chapters.title: Chapter 1444: Preparing to Leave
paragraphs: After struggling for hours to leave, since he just couldn’t bring himself to put down Xandira, she finally fell asleep, so Kent decided to leave before she woke up.
The last thing he wanted was to find himself holding her again. She was just too adorable to the point that he wouldn’t mind spending weeks with her.
But since he had other things to get back to, he knew he had to leave the moment she fell asleep.
So after giving the adorable Xandira back to her mother, he decided to leave
"I will be going away for a while, so you and Xandira might not be seeing me for some time. However, once I get back, I will come over to spend some time with you two."
Queen Eirdis nodded.
"Also, as I said, if you need anything, just say the word, and it will be delivered."
After a few more words, he vanished into thin air. The next time he appeared, he was standing inside the Sword Tower.

Now that his second flame core had been formed, the next item on his schedule was to go back home to Planet Brymrr. His reason for going there, of course, was to seek out Inaya, who he was sure was the ruler Crimson Dagger talked about.
He had no idea how he would contact her just yet. However, he knew if he wanted an audience with her, he would have to go to Planet Brymrr, where he grew up.
Once he managed to make contact with her, his objectives for going would be addressed.

First, he wanted to see what had happened between them in the past. This was because he wanted to meet the last requirement so he could finally awaken his Sword Realm and break through to the Sword Emperor stage.

He may have the knowledge of a Sword Legend thanks to his past memories, but his skills were still limited by his rank. So he wanted to become a Sword Emperor and, if possible, reach the Sword Monarch stage before entering the Star Gateway.
Although he would still have access to Heavenly Sword Energy even at the Sword Monarch stage, his understanding of the sword would improve greatly, and he could harness his Sword Realm in combat.
That would be much better than staying at the Sword King stage, where he can’t do much.
The second item on his schedule was to ask for a favor. If he somehow manages to meet with Inaya and doesn’t end up dead, he would try his luck asking for a big favour.
The Heart Demon Curse, according to Gaia, could only be broken if his fate was 100%. As it happened, someone had taken a part of his fate during the Primordial Era.

Unfortunately, she had been trapped in a Calamity Zone that only swordsmen could enter. He was too weak to enter, and so were his friends and legion. So he needed someone who had ventured in there before to help him rescue Safira.
Lastly, he just wanted to spend the last few months before his big journey exploring the world where his legacy as Lord Genesis began.
If possible and not too late, he would love to find out more about his father’s background. He was a slave whose mother died the day he was born, so he never got to know her.

After he escaped, he was more focused on becoming powerful enough to rescue his family, still trapped in the slave mine. Later, when he became famous, the need to seek out his father never crossed his mind.

His focus was one ascending higher in the realm of swordsmanship. However, now that he had achieved that goal and even had a second chance, he would want to know more about his father and possibly find out more about his mother.
Although he was bound to meet immortals, demigods, gods, and even Supremes since he was heading to a Unique Planet, he knew he had no choice but to go.
So he started to prepare, making sure he had everything in place before leaving.
First was his appearance.

While it would be great to go as Kent Madson, he knew from how popular he had become; doing so would just be putting a target on his back. There was no way he could have any freedom if everyone knew he was the legendary Kent Madson.
So he needed a disguise. Luckily, he was once known as Jest, a handsome swordman whose legend had shaped the world of swordsmen.

So he tapped into the Soul Universe, and after a few tweaks, his appearance changed into that of his past self. He made sure every last detail was captured, ensuring his good looks spoke for him, since that was the only thing he could count on to get him into places not many could.
In the past, that was how Jest managed to roam the many worlds he had been to. He is a charmer, so getting into places was rather easy for him.
Of course, he also picked this face as a way to easily catch Inaya’s attention. There is just no way she wouldn’t recognise him.
After changing into a fine set of battle armor made to look more stylish than functional, he was left with only one thing.
He extended his hand, and his sword, Gaap, appeared.
"It is going to be a wild journey, buddy. You have to bring your A game, or else we will be cooked for breakfast."
The sword vibrated to tell him he had nothing to worry about. He lifted it and placed it on his back. Ropes came from his clothes and wrapped around it, forming a perfect sword sheath.
After making sure he had his appearance covered, he entered the Harem Tower, where he hoarded some fruits into his space ring. He had once roamed Planet Brymrr and knew just how large it was.
Also, it was now a Unique World, so there was no telling how much it had expanded over the years.
That was why he needed snacks for the journey. Once that was handled, he returned to the 9th floor of the dungeon, where everyone was still waiting for Unity to be done with her cultivation.
When he first appeared, none of them recognized him. However, that only lasted for a few seconds before his wives saw through his disguise.
"How did you figure it out?" he asked, curious to know.
"I have seen a statue of your old self before, so I just pictured you much younger and less handsome," Vexthra was the first to respond.

"I recognized the hilt of your sword. It scares me, so there is just no way I wouldn’t recognize it," Val said, and most of her sisters nodded, showing they also recognized him because of the hilt of his sword.

He knew if worst came to worst, his goddess wives would come in handy. Even against a Supreme, Vexthra could hold her own long enough for him to escape.
So he would not hesitate to call for help.
"Kaizo, keep everyone safe while I am gone, will you?"
"Rest assured, Master, I will keep them all safe for you," Kaizo beat his chest, causing everyone to roll their eyes. They just couldn’t understand why Kent held that brute in such high regard.

chapters.title: Chapter 1445: Unknown Forest
paragraphs: Long before it became a Unique Planet, Brymrr was already vast. To travel from one end to the other, even an Immortal Lord would have to fly for 100 years.
Thankfully, there were teleportation formations, which could take one from one city to another. This had, in the past, lessened how much time it took to travel across the planet.
However, after the transformation into a Unique Planet, it continued to expand, becoming even more vast.
But aside from its expansion, it also brought many changes.
One of those changes was the numerous forests that came out of nowhere, teeming with all kinds of hidden dangers.
Over the years, many such forests were named, and restrictions were placed on them to prevent ignorant people from throwing their lives away by venturing inside.
However, while many were named, many remained unnamed.
Because of that, they are known as Unknown Forests. Nobody has any idea what dangers are hidden within because not many are brave enough to venture in there to find out.
Kent, unfortunately, found himself in one of such forests after entering the portal. It opened on a small island inside a forest so vast that his Soul Map could not see much.
Luckily, the moment he used the Soul Map, much of the island came within his scanning range, so he knew he was safe for now.
"Really, why didn’t you just send me to the bottom of the ocean and be done with it?" Kent cursed at the Planet Teleporter before putting it away.
While it is convenient to have such a treasure, the mere fact that he is now stranded on an island, surrounded by nothing but water, is just not something he expected.
In the past, the planet teleporter sent him to places much closer to civilization. However, today, he is stranded on an island surrounded by nothing but water.
But if that isn’t enough, even after crossing the water, he would appear in the main forest, and from there, he would have to make his way out.
But if there is an island inside this forest, then what else would be waiting for him on the other side?
Kent decided not to discourage himself.

Instead, he focused on knowing more about the island and the forest in general. Luckily for him, he had once made a deal with the Enchantress, so he activated his Heavenly Jade Eye, which was actually a blend of three Innate Eyes.
One of them had to do with knowing something about anything. Mostly, when he arrives on a new planet, he can scan it, and the eye will show him what it knows.
Kent didn’t want to go above and beyond, so he only scanned the island.
[Unknown Forest Discovered]
[You are currently on the red island inside an Unknown Forest on planet Brymrr. The forest spans 2,506,000 km in radius. It is home to a variety of beasts and demons.

The red island is the resting place of the Sea Serpent, a mutated snake that underwent a race change after passing the Beast Mutation Tribulation. It is an Immortal Monarch-stage beast that comes to relax on the island every night.
It is advisable to leave before it arrives since it hates to share its space with anyone.]
"Oh, that is unexpected," Kent muttered, his expression turning dark.
Kent scanned the island again but saw nothing that suggested it was the resting place of a serpent. However, to be more careful, he extended his search to look for elemental patterns.
As expected, somewhere about 40,000 km away, he saw a 1,000-meter-wide mud pond. He focused deeper and saw that this mud pond linked directly to the sea.
This showed that the pond is the gateway it takes to come to the island. Knowing this, he decided to expand the search.
"Tower, scan the sea and tell me what you can find. Also, what is the distance between the island and the forest?"

[Way ahead of you, Master. I have scanned the 800,000 km radius around the island and found that, aside from the Sea Serpent, there are other beasts hidden in the water. The Sea Serpent is the ruler of the Central Sea. It is also the strongest.
But aside from it, there are seven others. If the Master is to travel north, the Great Bone Shark will be a problem. Due south, the Metal Dolphin and Electric Whale will be a problem.

Due east, the Green Scale Octopus Queen and Three-Headed Sea Lion would attack without delay. Finally, due west, there are the Poison Crab King and Hypnotic Jellyfish. All seven are Immortal Emperors.
Also, the distance between you and the forest due east is 470,000 km. The other sides will take 600,000 km of travel to escape the sea.]
"So the best choice is to head east, where there is a high chance I will be attacked by the Green Scale Octopus Queen and Three-Headed Sea Lion."

[Yes, Master. However, the Master would have to make a decision in the next three hours since the sun will be going down by then, and it would be too late to escape from the Sea Serpent if you are not gone by then.]
Kent took a deep breath.
He was not afraid yet.
After all, he could call on his Soul Warriors to aid him. However, before doing that, he needed to analyze his options first.
There are seven Immortal Emperor-level beasts and one Immortal Monarch-stage beast. Even if he wanted to, he would have a hard time taking any of them on.

Although he had defeated an Immortal Emperor before, that was because the beast in question was not its true self. It was supposed to be a Calamity Beast, but because of the restrictions on it, it was barely considered a pseudo-Calamity Beast.
However, these ones are the real deal. Even the Sea Serpent had undergone a Beast Mutation Tribulation and passed. That is akin to forming a Chaos Heart and undergoing a Dragon Tribulation.
So he had to think carefully because even with Calix, Kenna, and Bello helping him, he wouldn’t have it easy.
"Tower, what do you think I should do? I have a year to spend here, so I can burn a few days."
[The Master is here to train and prepare for his journey through the Star Gateway. Since that is the case, it is advisable to at least measure the Master’s strength against these powerful beasts.
Also, the Master has yet to see what the Soul Warriors can do and how best to synchronize with them in battle. So spending a few days here challenging these beasts seems like a logical idea.
Of course, the Master would have to know that they have a territorial advantage, so a simple mistake can prove fatal. That aside, challenging these beasts is a good move.]
Kent sat down and started to think about what he should do. What the Tower said is indeed logical, but he must also consider some factors.

After a few minutes of thought, he came up with a plan. "Right now, I don’t know how to contact Inaya, so every second spent not searching for her is a second wasted. That said, there is also no telling how long it will take me to traverse the forest and find my way to civilization.
However, I also cannot waste this chance. I am here to train after all, so this sounds like a good chance for me.
I will take the route due east and face the Green Scale Octopus Queen and Three-Headed Sea Lion. Once I find Inaya and I still have time, I will come back."
After saying that, his dragon wings appeared, and he took flight, heading toward the east, where a great battle awaited him.

chapters.title: Chapter 1446: Battle At Sea
paragraphs: If Kent knew where he had to go to find Inaya, he wouldn’t have passed up on a chance to have some of the best battles he would ever have currently at his stage.

The Sea Serpent sounded like a powerful opponent that, if he could face in battle, would help him know where he was lacking and better prepare for the Star Gateway, where even a True Immortal-stage spatial beast is a danger to the average Immortal Monarch human.
Putting emphasis on the spatial beasts he would be facing, he knew he must handle all other things before coming back.
So he left.
Once he found Inaya and had managed to survive her wrath, he would come back.
However, he wasn’t leaving without some fun. He took the path leading east, so he was bound to meet the Green Scale Octopus Queen and Three-Headed Sea Lion.
"I wonder how strong they would be."

His curiosity started to get the best of him as he rapidly flew toward the east. The allure of testing how much more powerful he had become after forming the second Flame Core was eating away at his patience.
Thankfully, it didn’t take long for him to sense movements underwater.
By then, he had done about half of the trip. But the moment he sensed the movements, he slowed down, keeping his attention on every small change.
At first, nothing happened, which made him wonder if the Green Scale Octopus Queen and Three-Headed Sea Lion were afraid of him.
However, that changed when the sea suddenly surged, and two towering beasts appeared. The thought of whether or not they were afraid of him was wiped from his mind when he laid eyes on them.
He expected large and terrifying beasts to appear, but this level of size was just too much.
The sea did not merely part; it rose as though it had a life of its own.
At once, an ominous feeling enveloped Kent, causing him to activate a few thousand Blood Runes to stay grounded.

Water surged upward like a mountain being forced from the depths, spiralling violently as waves twisted around one another. The sky darkened from the sheer mass of it, and for a brief moment, Kent felt as though the ocean itself had decided to stand.
Then the first one emerged.

A colossal body broke through the surface — green scales glistening like polished jade under the dying sunlight. Eight massive tentacles followed, each one thicker than ancient oak tree trunks, lined with serrated suction ridges that shimmered with faint emerald light. Her eyes — two massive vertical slits — locked onto Kent midair.
The Green Scale Octopus Queen appeared, and her gaze was fixed on the tiny human standing before her.
Beside her, the sea detonated again.

Three massive heads burst out of the water at once, jaws snapping, fangs like curved swords dripping with saltwater. The body that followed was that of a monstrous sea lion, easily over three thousand meters long.
Each head bore different markings — one scarred and battle-worn, one smooth and silver-lined, and the last crowned with jagged bone protrusions.
"Can I even kill these monstrosities with a sword?" Kent muttered, his body feeling the pressure from merely standing before the two beasts.

It took him a few seconds to come to the conclusion that he could not fight them with a sword. The Three-Headed Sea Lion alone was about three thousand meters large. There was no way a sword could penetrate its skin.
Maybe if he were a Sword Monarch with an active Sword Realm, he could hold his own against them. Of course, that might also be possible if he were to face only the Three-Headed Sea Lion.
The Green Scale Octopus Queen was a whole different danger on her own.
"Time to see how I will fare as a dragon against beasts." Kent ditched the sword and decided to fight like a dragon.
He transformed, and while his size was nothing compared to the two beasts, the moment he roared, they felt the danger.
One tentacle moved at a surprisingly fast angle, arriving before him in an instant. However, he anticipated that move, so he moved just in time, narrowly evading it.

He moved, and with a deadly slash, he attacked the Three-Headed Sea Lion. But the lion was also waiting for him, so the moment his claw went in for a deadly blow, a metallic tail came from the side, striking Kent on the side.
He was sent flying toward the water.
The Green Scale Octopus Queen took advantage of that and attacked with two tentacles. One caused the water to surge and form into thousands of water spears.
The other moved in a sweeping motion, sealing the space around Kent. This move completely rendered Kent stuck in one place. He had nowhere to move, and the spears made of water were coming too.
Luckily, the seal was not affecting his Soul Map, so, looking at the right spot where he could get the most out of it, he teleported using the Soul Map, appearing behind the Three-Headed Sea Lion.

His maw opened, and red flames churned, instantly heating the air around them. The lion moved its body, and while it had no chance to dodge the breath attack that Kent was planning, what it did next left him stunned.
Just when the red flame erupted from his mouth, the sea froze, and then layers of ice appeared between him and the lion.

His breath attack landed on it, shattering a couple of layers in an instant. However, before he could make any progress with the rest of the layers, a powerful tentacle slammed into his side, sending him flying into the water.
Pain shot through his body, causing him to let out a roar that echoed in the water. He moved swiftly, and before the tentacles could reach him inside the water, he shot back up into the air.
The Three-Headed Sea Lion followed with a breath attack of its own. However, instead of fire, ice came out. This made Kent wonder just what the other heads could do.

The ice breath attack came, but this time, Kent was quick to activate the [Chaos Scale Shield]. The attack landed on it but couldn’t break through. He was on the move the next second, evading another tentacle attack.
With his speed amplified, he keeps weaving his way out of one attack after another.
Suddenly, the sea surged, and the water rose into the air, enveloping all three of them. Kent came to a stop, spreading his senses to check if a third opponent had arrived.
He quickly found out that it wasn’t the case. Someone else entirely was the cause.
Looking deeper into the sudden surge, what he discovered was just out of this world. In an instant, he saw the lion as the most difficult opponent yet.
He concluded without a shred of doubt that it was not an opponent he could defeat with just his dragon form.

Rising from the bed of the sea was a bone-like spear ending with a metallic spike. Around it, seven immortal Qi revolved, each exuding a power that far exceeded what Kent expected from an Immortal Emperor-level beast.
Turning to his left, he saw one head of the lion glowing silver, its eyes shining like crystal.
If at first the octopus was the opponent he feared, then the lion is on another level now.
The lion is the most dangerous creature he has ever met in his life. He can tell it by just looking at how much pressure it was exerting at the moment.

sentences.text: If Kent knew where he had to go to find Inaya, he wouldn’t have passed up on a chance to have some of the best battles he would ever have currently at his stage.

The Sea Serpent sounded like a powerful opponent that, if he could face in battle, would help him know where he was lacking and better prepare for the Star Gateway, where even a True Immortal-stage spatial beast is a danger to the average Immortal Monarch human.
Putting emphasis on the spatial beasts he would be facing, he knew he must handle all other things before coming back.
So he left.
Once he found Inaya and had managed to survive her wrath, he would come back.
However, he wasn’t leaving without some fun.
He took the path leading east, so he was bound to meet the Green Scale Octopus Queen and Three-Headed Sea Lion.
"I wonder how strong they would be."
His curiosity started to get the best of him as he rapidly flew toward the east.
The allure of testing how much more powerful he had become after forming the second Flame Core was eating away at his patience.
Thankfully, it didn’t take long for him to sense movements underwater.
By then, he had done about half of the trip.
But the moment he sensed the movements, he slowed down, keeping his attention on every small change.
At first, nothing happened, which made him wonder if the Green Scale Octopus Queen and Three-Headed Sea Lion were afraid of him.
However, that changed when the sea suddenly surged, and two towering beasts appeared.
The thought of whether or not they were afraid of him was wiped from his mind when he laid eyes on them.
He expected large and terrifying beasts to appear, but this level of size was just too much.
The sea did not merely part; it rose as though it had a life of its own.
At once, an ominous feeling enveloped Kent, causing him to activate a few thousand Blood Runes to stay grounded.
Water surged upward like a mountain being forced from the depths, spiralling violently as waves twisted around one another.
The sky darkened from the sheer mass of it, and for a brief moment, Kent felt as though the ocean itself had decided to stand.
Then the first one emerged.
A colossal body broke through the surface — green scales glistening like polished jade under the dying sunlight.
Eight massive tentacles followed, each one thicker than ancient oak tree trunks, lined with serrated suction ridges that shimmered with faint emerald light.
Her eyes — two massive vertical slits — locked onto Kent midair.
The Green Scale Octopus Queen appeared, and her gaze was fixed on the tiny human standing before her.
Beside her, the sea detonated again.
Three massive heads burst out of the water at once, jaws snapping, fangs like curved swords dripping with saltwater.
The body that followed was that of a monstrous sea lion, easily over three thousand meters long.
Each head bore different markings — one scarred and battle-worn, one smooth and silver-lined, and the last crowned with jagged bone protrusions.
"Can I even kill these monstrosities with a sword?" Kent muttered, his body feeling the pressure from merely standing before the two beasts.
It took him a few seconds to come to the conclusion that he could not fight them with a sword.
The Three-Headed Sea Lion alone was about three thousand meters large.
There was no way a sword could penetrate its skin.
Maybe if he were a Sword Monarch with an active Sword Realm, he could hold his own against them.
Of course, that might also be possible if he were to face only the Three-Headed Sea Lion.
The Green Scale Octopus Queen was a whole different danger on her own.
"Time to see how I will fare as a dragon against beasts." Kent ditched the sword and decided to fight like a dragon.
He transformed, and while his size was nothing compared to the two beasts, the moment he roared, they felt the danger.
One tentacle moved at a surprisingly fast angle, arriving before him in an instant.
However, he anticipated that move, so he moved just in time, narrowly evading it.
He moved, and with a deadly slash, he attacked the Three-Headed Sea Lion.
But the lion was also waiting for him, so the moment his claw went in for a deadly blow, a metallic tail came from the side, striking Kent on the side.
He was sent flying toward the water.
The Green Scale Octopus Queen took advantage of that and attacked with two tentacles.
One caused the water to surge and form into thousands of water spears.
The other moved in a sweeping motion, sealing the space around Kent.
This move completely rendered Kent stuck in one place.
He had nowhere to move, and the spears made of water were coming too.
Luckily, the seal was not affecting his Soul Map, so, looking at the right spot where he could get the most out of it, he teleported using the Soul Map, appearing behind the Three-Headed Sea Lion.
His maw opened, and red flames churned, instantly heating the air around them.
The lion moved its body, and while it had no chance to dodge the breath attack that Kent was planning, what it did next left him stunned.
Just when the red flame erupted from his mouth, the sea froze, and then layers of ice appeared between him and the lion.
His breath attack landed on it, shattering a couple of layers in an instant.
However, before he could make any progress with the rest of the layers, a powerful tentacle slammed into his side, sending him flying into the water.
Pain shot through his body, causing him to let out a roar that echoed in the water.
He moved swiftly, and before the tentacles could reach him inside the water, he shot back up into the air.
The Three-Headed Sea Lion followed with a breath attack of its own.
However, instead of fire, ice came out.
This made Kent wonder just what the other heads could do.
The ice breath attack came, but this time, Kent was quick to activate the [Chaos Scale Shield].
The attack landed on it but couldn’t break through.
He was on the move the next second, evading another tentacle attack.
With his speed amplified, he keeps weaving his way out of one attack after another.
Suddenly, the sea surged, and the water rose into the air, enveloping all three of them.
Kent came to a stop, spreading his senses to check if a third opponent had arrived.
He quickly found out that it wasn’t the case.
Someone else entirely was the cause.
Looking deeper into the sudden surge, what he discovered was just out of this world.
In an instant, he saw the lion as the most difficult opponent yet.
He concluded without a shred of doubt that it was not an opponent he could defeat with just his dragon form.
Rising from the bed of the sea was a bone-like spear ending with a metallic spike.
Around it, seven immortal Qi revolved, each exuding a power that far exceeded what Kent expected from an Immortal Emperor-level beast.
Turning to his left, he saw one head of the lion glowing silver, its eyes shining like crystal.
If at first the octopus was the opponent he feared, then the lion is on another level now.
The lion is the most dangerous creature he has ever met in his life.
He can tell it by just looking at how much pressure it was exerting at the moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 1447: A Dragon’s Power
paragraphs: The silver head on the lion lifted slightly, and the immortal Qi around the bone-like spear began to rotate faster, humming with a resonance that shook the surrounding water.
The Immortal Qi seems to increase the power of the spear with every rotation.
Kent felt a subtle pressure come from beneath the water.
At the same time, the pressure in the air thickened instantly, pressing down on him from all directions. Even in his dragon form, he felt his scales strain under the invisible weight.

The spear rose fully from the seabed, its length stretching for thousands of meters, carved with ancient runes that pulsed with silver light. The seven streams of immortal Qi moved in unison and slowly started locking onto the spear.
The moment the final stream of Qi locked into place around it, the Three-Headed Sea Lion let out a howl that rippled through both water and sky.
Kent’s pupils narrowed.
He moved—or at least tried to move back. He tried to move his body, but he couldn’t. This caused his pupils to shrink further, forcing his gaze back to the giant spear.
That was when he sensed where the danger was coming from.
"This is not just a weapon," he muttered. "This is a manifested domain."
Before he could react further, the spear tilted forward and shot toward him. It did not travel like a thrown object; it pierced through space itself, leaving a distorted silver trail behind.
The surrounding water froze mid-motion, locking the battlefield into a rigid, crystalline prison.
Kent twisted his body midair and activated his Chaos Scale Shield again, reinforcing it with blood runes.
He knew he had to act fast, so he did. However, the outcome was one he never saw coming.
The spear struck the shield with a deafening explosion, shattering three layers instantly and sending shockwaves that split the ocean surface below.
He was blasted backward, scales cracking in several places as blood seeped between them.
"Impossible," Kent exclaimed, watching as his chaos scale shield cracked and shattered under the deadly strike of the spear.

Although he knew his scale shield could crack and even shatter when struck by something extremely powerful, he never expected it to break this easily, not when he had invested over 40,000 blood seals to augment it.
In the past, he had some close encounters where his shields were overpowered, but that was when he chose not to augment them.
Now, it seems he had finally seen something that must be corrected.
’I need to form my chaos heart fast,’ he said inwardly, ’Although it is just a domain, I shouldn’t have lost that easily.’
This failure made him understand just how deadly domains could be. Inside a domain, the owner could do just about anything, provided the conceptualization allowed it.
But when, instead of using the domain itself, it was actually compressed into a weapon, it meant the domain was not being hurled at him, and that was just too dangerous.
The result was his scales shattering and being pushed back by the deadly attack.

But before he could stabilize himself, the Green Scale Octopus Queen moved again. Four tentacles lashed out simultaneously, weaving together into a spiraling formation that trapped him within a tightening vortex.
The water within the vortex began to compress, crushing inward with immense pressure. Kent felt his bones creak despite his dragon form being his strongest.
Above him, the spear rotated once more, gathering even greater force, preparing for a second strike that would not merely injure—but obliterate him.
Kent’s mind raced, but panic did not take root. The last thing he wanted was panic. Just a slight mistake could cost him his edge.
So instead of panicking, an eerie calm settled over him as his dragon blood burned hotter within his veins. If this were a manifested domain, then brute force alone would not be enough.
’This is not your first time facing a manifested domain, Kent,’ he said to himself, almost as if he were trying to remind himself of something.
’Just figure out how it works, and it will be game over.’
ROAR
He roared, and crimson-gold flames erupted across his scales, forcing the surrounding water to vaporize instantly. He knew his flames alone would not be enough, so he activated a Nirvana Flame.
Steam exploded outward, disrupting the compression long enough for him to flex his wings and expand his body with raw draconic power.
Although he had no Chaos energy, when he activated all 80,000 blood runes and 250,000 flame veins, his power rose, causing the very air to quake.
The vortex itself trembled.

Above, the immortal Qi spun faster, channeling even more energy into the spear. This added force gave the bone spear the energy to descend again, this time carrying the weight of the frozen sea itself.
The sky cracked with a silver fracture as the spear pierced downward as if it were formed from death Qi.
Kent inhaled deeply.
His first Flame Core ignited as well.

The air around him warped violently as his two blazing cores synchronized within his body. A draconic aura burst outward in a ring of fire, melting the ice domain and forcing the sea back into motion. With a thunderous flap of his wings, he shot upward directly toward the falling spear.
Instead of dodging, he met it head-on.
He knew what had to be done to break the Lions’ advantage over him.
His claws wrapped around the shaft of the bone spear, and for a single breath, the world went silent.
The overwhelming power of the spear and Kent’s terrifying strength met in a deadly collision, and the result spoke for itself.
The spear came to a deadly halt, something that shouldn’t be possible, not when the spear was literally a manifestation of a domain.
Below, the Three-Headed Sea Lion widened the eyes of its silver head in disbelief as the dragon, though smaller, actually brought its spear to a halt despite seven immortal Qi supporting it.
The Green Scale Octopus Queen tightened her tentacles again, but for the first time since the battle began, the two beasts realized they were not the ones with the upper hand.
The dragon was far more dangerous than they believed, and that could be seen from what happened next.
Kent mere stopped the spear. As to how to cancel the domain, he knew he had to call on a third party.
Just when the spear was stopped, Kent let out a deadly roar and pushed forward, sending the spear moving back.
The lion tried to command it to move forward; however, before it could make any progress, a stunning beauty clad in black and pink armor appeared and stood atop the blunt end of the spear.

She flashed Kent a smile and then, with a simple step, vanished into the void. For a moment, nothing happened. However, that changed when the spear suddenly trembled and cracks formed along its surface.

Before long, the cracks traveled along its length, and with one powerful roar, it shattered. The impact was immediate as the lion let out a terrifying howl before waves of blood poured from its mouth.
Getting his domain severed left it completely wounded in the soul.
Kent did not attack.
He flew upward, and just when he was high enough, Kenna appeared and sat on his back, crossing her legs.
In a seductive tone, she spoke, "Master, I want to devour the three-headed lion’s soul, but I am too weak. Can you help me?"
She could probably do it on her own since she had already wounded its soul. However, to ensure she is happy, Kent decided to play her game.

"Why not?" Kent, still in his dragon form, raised his right claw and activated a technique with a gentle tap. However, that gentle gesture turned into a terrifying sight that immediately locked onto the lion.
RUMBLE
Lightning flashed across the sky, and a colossal fist, forged from metallic gold, emerged from the clouds. It locked onto the lion and moved, causing the air to shake.
Sitting atop Kent’s dragon body, Kenna giggled and spun her dagger.
The lion, sensing the danger coming, created a shield, hoping to block the giant fist. However, when its metallic might landed on it, the sea exploded, and the lion was sent crashing to the bottom.
"All yours."
Kenna giggled again and vanished. The next second, she found herself inside the lion’s soul sea.
Meanwhile, Kent finally turned toward the octopus.
